       ego_drive_at_start,
       path_fraction: path_fraction_at_end,
       lat_offset: overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object,
       lon_offset: (ego_time_gap_to_object_before_turn*ego_speed))

                override(s1, run_mode: best_effort)
                lane(lane_num, from: curb)
            ego_drive_with_shape: sut.car.drive() with:
                shape(quantity: position, request: both, 
                    shape_object: esa_turn_shape)

        plain_object_movement_path: serial():
            end_pos: stationed_objects.move(
                    object_position_end, 
                    start_position: object_position_start)
    with: duration([10..30]s)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sut::ego_passing_parked_vehicles
# In this scenario, Ego is passing parked vehicles 
# Configurable parameters: distance_between_parked_vehicles, lateral_distance_between_ego_and_parked_vehicles

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/common/metrics_checks/ego_standstill_watcher.osc"

extend sut.ego_passing_parked_vehicles:

    max_time_ego_stops: time with:
        keep(default it == 10s)
    watcher standstill_watcher is standstill_watcher(vehicle: sut.car,
        standstill_threshold: 3.5kph, max_interval_time :max_time_ego_stops)

    ego_distance_to_parked_vehicles_after_passing: length with:
        keep(default it == 20m)
    event ego_stops_for_max_time is @standstill_watcher.i_end if \
        (standstill_watcher.data.end_time - standstill_watcher.data.start_time \
        >= max_time_ego_stops)
    
    event ego_passes_objects is @clk if \
        sut.car.road_distance_to_global_coordinates(left_parked_vehicle.objects[gen_number_of_parked_vehicles-1].state.global_position.coord, center, lon, lane) < \
            -ego_distance_to_parked_vehicles_after_passing


     
    left_parked_vehicle: common_plain_object_group with:
        keep(default it.objects.size() == gen_number_of_parked_vehicles)
        keep(it.objects_kind == stationary_vehicle)
        
    right_parked_vehicle: common_plain_object_group with:
        keep(default it.objects.size() == gen_number_of_parked_vehicles)
        keep(it.objects_kind == stationary_vehicle)

    lon_distance_between_left_parked_vehicles : length with:
        keep(it == 10m + gen_distance_between_parked_vehicles)
        
    left_parked_vehicle_position: msp_position
    right_parked_vehicle_position: msp_position

    left_parked_vehicle_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(default it.min_lat_offset == gen_ego_lat_distance_to_parked_vehicles)
        keep(default it.max_lat_offset == gen_ego_lat_distance_to_parked_vehicles)
        keep(default it.min_distance_between_objects == gen_distance_between_parked_vehicles)
        keep(default it.max_distance_between_objects == gen_distance_between_parked_vehicles)
    
    right_parked_vehicle_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(default it.min_lat_offset == -gen_ego_lat_distance_to_parked_vehicles)
        keep(default it.max_lat_offset == -gen_ego_lat_distance_to_parked_vehicles)
        keep(default it.min_distance_between_objects == gen_distance_between_parked_vehicles)
        keep(default it.max_distance_between_objects == gen_distance_between_parked_vehicles)

    top.plain_object_group_position_along_road(\
        left_parked_vehicle_position_params,left_parked_vehicle,
        road_with_lanes, lon_offset: parked_vehicle_lon_offset,leftmost_lane: true)
    
    top.plain_object_group_position_along_road(\
        right_parked_vehicle_position_params,right_parked_vehicle,
        road_with_lanes, lon_offset: parked_vehicle_lon_offset,rightmost_lane: true)

    # The road should be long enough to accommodate the parked vehicles plus a buffer at start and end
    keep(road_with_lanes.length > (distance_to_first_parked_vehicle*2 + \
        lon_distance_between_left_parked_vehicles * \
        gen_number_of_parked_vehicles))


    on @phase_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles.start:
        number_of_parked_vehicles_left = left_parked_vehicle.objects.size()
        number_of_parked_vehicles_right = right_parked_vehicle.objects.size()

        # Checking only minimum values of each group because min and max are equal, so every obj must be at a constant distance from each other
        distance_between_parked_vehicles_left = left_parked_vehicle_position_params.each_distance_between_objects.reduce(it < result ? it : result)
        distance_between_parked_vehicles_right = right_parked_vehicle_position_params.each_distance_between_objects.reduce(it < result ? it : result)

        # Checking only minimum values of each group because min and max are equal, so every obj must be at a constant lat_offset from Ego
        # Getting math.abs from right vehicle group because their offset is -1 * the constant we're sampling 
        ego_lat_distance_to_parked_vehicles_left = left_parked_vehicle_position_params.each_lat_offset.reduce(it < result ? it : result)
        ego_lat_distance_to_parked_vehicles_right = math.abs(right_parked_vehicle_position_params.each_lat_offset.reduce(it < result ? it : result))


    do phase_essence: first_of:
        ego_passing_parked_vehicles: serial():

            phase_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_ego_lane_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles_start: lane(middle: true, at: start)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_ego_along_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles_start: along(road_with_lanes, 
                        start_offset: ego_longitudinal_position_on_road_at_start,
                        at: start)
                    intent_ego_along_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles_end: along(road_with_lanes, 
                        start_offset: distance_to_first_parked_vehicle * 4 +\
                             lon_distance_between_left_parked_vehicles * \
                             gen_number_of_parked_vehicles, tolerance: 60m,
                            at: end)
                    intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    # best effort for lateral as Ego might try to bypass the vehicles with a different
                    # lateral offset
                    intent_assist_ego_lateral_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles_start: lateral(distance: ego_lateral_offset_at_start, line:left, at:start, run_mode: best_effort)

                left_parked_vehicle_at_essence: left_parked_vehicle.group_exists(
                    left_parked_vehicle_position_params)
                right_parked_vehicle_at_essence: right_parked_vehicle.group_exists(
                    right_parked_vehicle_position_params)
                                        
            with:
                intent_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles)

        phase_essence_scenario_stopper_1: serial():
            wait @ego_stops_for_max_time
            log_info("Ending the scenario as Ego was standing still for > $(max_time_ego_stops)")

        phase_essence_scenario_stopper_2: serial():
            wait @ego_passes_objects
            log_info("Ending the scenario as Ego passed by the parked vehicles")


extend sut.ego_passing_parked_vehicles_test:

    do phase_test: serial():

        # invoke the default base ego warm up scenario for the adjacent_vehicles family
        phase_ego_warm_up: stationary_vehicles_family_ego_warm_up()

        # invoke adjacent_vehicles scenario
        phase_scenario: ego_passing_parked_vehicles()

        # invoke the default base post scenario for the adjacent_vehicles family
        phase_post: stationary_vehicles_family_post()

extend sut.vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_similar_speed_stationary_objects_with_traffic: 
    # Ego complete stand_still time
    max_time_ego_stops: time with:
        keep(default it == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_stand_still_time)

    watcher standstill_watcher is standstill_watcher(vehicle: sut.car,
        standstill_threshold: 0kph, max_interval_time :max_time_ego_stops)

    event ego_stops_for_max_time is @standstill_watcher.i_end if \
        ((standstill_watcher.data.end_time - standstill_watcher.data.start_time) >= max_time_ego_stops)
    
    event clock is (sut.car.state != null)

    var last_vehicle: int
    keep(last_vehicle == gen_number_of_adjacent_traffic_group_vehicles-1)

    # Bypassing distance between Ego and object after which scenario will end
    ego_bypassing_object_end_distance : length with:
        keep(default it == 5m)
    
    var ego_bypassed_bool: bool = false

    # Condition to end scenario once Ego passes object
    event ego_bypassed is @clock if ego_bypassed_bool==true
        
    on @top.clk:
        if sut.car.road_distance(to_object: \
            vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_object_at_essence.stationary_object_group.\
            objects[last_vehicle],reference: closest, to_reference: closest,
            direction: lon, route_type: road) < -ego_bypassing_object_end_distance:
                set ego_bypassed_bool = true
    
    # adjacent_traffic_group with normal_driver_model
    normal_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model
    keep(normal_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(normal_driver_model.change_lane_eagerness == 0)
    
    keep(normal_driver_model.target_speed == \
        vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_object_at_essence.\
        vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_at_essence_vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_objects.gen_neighbor_vehicle_speed)

    keep(adjacent_traffic_group.cars.size() == 
        gen_number_of_adjacent_traffic_group_vehicles)

    keep(adjacent_traffic_group.reference_car_index == 0)

    for car in adjacent_traffic_group.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == normal_driver_model)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.enabling_policy == always_enabled)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon == \
            gen_adjacent_traffic_group_safety_distance_lon)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.min_response_time == \
            gen_adjacent_traffic_group_min_response_time)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.\
            lon_ca_cautious_factor == \
            gen_adjacent_traffic_group_lon_ca_cautious_factor)
 
    for params in adjacent_traffic_group.members_params:
        keep(params.min_initial_ttc == gen_adjacent_traffic_group_min_initial_ttc)




    do phase_essence: first_of:
        phase_essence_vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_object_traffic: parallel(overlap: equal):
            vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_object_at_essence: vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_similar_speed_stationary_objects(neighbor_vehicle: neighbor_vehicle)

# sut::vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl
# In this  scenario a neighbor_vehicle is overtaking the 
# `Ego` on an adjacent lane. During the overtake the `neighbor_vehicle` can change it's velocity, 
#  can overtake while braking the speed limit, can overtake 
#  where overtaking is not allowed and can optionally
#  perform a lateral swirling
#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    . gen_ego_speed_at_start - Speed of Ego
#    . gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start - Speed of neighbor_vehicle relative to Ego at start
#    . gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end - Speed of neighbor_vehicle relative to Ego at end
#    . gen_leading_time_neighbor - Leading time gap of Neighbor Vehicle from Ego  
#    . gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver - The neighbor_vehicle maneuvers either with or without swirl. This
#      will set the gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude to 0m if it is without_swirl and
#      gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude as greater than 0m if it is with_swirl.
#    . gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude - Amplitude of the neighbor_vehicle parameter should be 0m or
#      greater than 0m if gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver parameter is without_swirl or with_swirl cases, 
#      respectively.

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/adjacent_vehicles/adjacent_vehicles_family_base/adjacent_vehicles_family_base_top.osc"

enum neighbor_vehicle_maneuver_type: [without_swirl, with_swirl]

scenario sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl \
        inherits adjacent_vehicles_family_base(with_swirl == true):

    keep(default scenario_str == "vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl")
    # The neighbor_vehicle maneuver either with_swirl or without swirl
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end.neighbor_vehicle_maneuver", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver: neighbor_vehicle_maneuver_type with:
        keep(default it in [with_swirl, without_swirl])
    var neighbor_vehicle_maneuver: neighbor_vehicle_maneuver_type
    # The gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude will be 0m if
    # gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver is without_swirl
    keep(gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver == (without_swirl) => \
        (gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude == 0m) and 
        (gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start == 0s) and
        (gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end == 0s))

    # The gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude will greater 0m if
    # gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver is with_swirl
    keep(gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver == (with_swirl) => \
        (gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude > 0m))

    # The neighbor_vehicle speed parameters
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start.neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl: speed with:
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_relative_speed_range)
    var neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl: speed

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_approach_start.neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start : speed with:
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_relative_speed_range)
    var neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start : speed

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_end.neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end: speed with:
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_relative_speed_range)   
    var neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end: speed
    
    leading_distance_ego: length
    keep(default leading_distance_ego in [-7..7]m)

    # The neighbor_vehicle time gap from the Ego
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_approach_end.leading_time_neighbor", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_leading_time_neighbor")
    gen_leading_time_neighbor: time
    keep(default gen_leading_time_neighbor in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)
    var leading_time_neighbor: time
    
    # The neighbor_vehicle side relative to Ego
    keep(gen_neighbor_vehicle_side in [right,left])

    # The neighbor_vehicle swirling parameters
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end.neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude: length with:
        keep(default it == 1m)
    var neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude: length

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end.neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start: time with:
        keep(default it == 3s)
    var neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start: time
    
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end.neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end: time with:
        keep(default it == 3s)
    var neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end: time

    swirl_shape_duration: time
    keep(swirl_shape_duration in [5..7]s)
    lane_section: lane_section

    duration_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_post_phase_duration)

    duration_at_essence_approach: time with:
        keep(it in [3..10]s)
    duration_tolerance_at_essence_approach: time with:
        keep(it == 2s)

    duration_tolerance_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: time with:
        keep(it == 2s)

scenario sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl_test inherits neighbor_vehicle_family_test:

    pass

    keep(default scenario_str == "vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl_test")

instruction:
Create an implementation file for vehicle overtaking with optional swirl scenario, including:
- Mathematical models for vehicle dynamics, acceleration profiles, and swirling motion

# Copyright (C) 2025 Foretellix Ltd (“Foretellix”)
# This source code file is licensed to you under Foretellix’ End User License
# Agreement, you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You are not allowed to distribute it to any third party without Foretellix’
# written approval.

# you do it at your own risk, and Foretellix will no longer supply any
# support or maintenance services for this source code.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
extend sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl:
    # In this scenario, since we cannot react to the ego's actions during shape, 
    # we assume that ego might accelerate due to the fact it has a free lane
    # since we need to overtake ego, we will add an acceleration delta to shape to endure the swirling
    # vehicle accelerates slightly harder
    neighbor_vehicle_rel_acceleration_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl: acceleration with:
        keep (default it == 1mpsps) 

    lateral_shift_shape: lateral_shift_shape_ref_vehicle_rel_acc with:
        keep(it.transform == lane_relative)
        keep(it.power_value_cpp == 20.0)
        keep(it.width_value_cpp == 1.0)
        keep(it.sin_wave_intensity_value_start_cpp == 0.5)
        keep(it.sin_wave_intensity_value_end_cpp == 1.2)
        keep(it.sin_period_start == gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start)
        keep(it.sin_period_end == gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end)
        keep(it.swirl_vehicle == neighbor_vehicle)
        keep(it.shape_duration == swirl_shape_duration)
        keep(it.ref_vehicle == sut.car)
        keep(it.rel_acceleration == neighbor_vehicle_rel_acceleration_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl)
        keep(it.lat_offset == gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude)
    do phase_essence: serial():
        # Intial phase - neighbor_vehicle on the adjacent lane of Ego
        emit ego_drive_start
        phase_essence_approach: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_approach: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_ego_speed_at_essence_approach_start: speed([gen_ego_speed_at_start-2kph..gen_ego_speed_at_start+2kph], 
                    tolerance: 4kph, at: start)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_approach: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_approach_start: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_neighbor_vehicle_at_essence_approach: neighbor_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence_approach_start: speed(gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start, faster_than: sut.car,
                    at: start)
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence_approach_start: lane(side_of: sut.car, side: gen_neighbor_vehicle_side, at: start)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_approach: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_approach_end: lateral(0meter, line: center, tolerance: 0.5m, at: end)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_position_at_essence_approach_end: position(time: gen_leading_time_neighbor, \
                    behind: sut.car, at: end, measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_essence_approach_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_approach, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_approach)

        # The neighbor_vehicle drives with an optional swirl on the adjacent lane
        phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_neighbor_vehicle_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: neighbor_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start: speed(gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl, 
                    faster_than: sut.car, at: start,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                # a hint to the planner for the fact that the swirling vehicle will accelerate
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end: speed(gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl + \    
                    (neighbor_vehicle_rel_acceleration_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl*swirl_shape_duration), 
                        faster_than: sut.car, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)    
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_shape_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: shape(quantity: position, request: both, \
                    shape_object: lateral_shift_shape)
                #A hint for planning, making sure that swirl is not happening in junction turns 
                #(otherwise, swirl vehicle gets out of control)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: lane(side_of: sut.car, side: gen_neighbor_vehicle_side, run_mode: best_effort)

        emit ego_lane_change_event
        # The neighbor_vehicle reaches [10..]m ahead of the Ego
        phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: parallel(overlap: equal): 
            drive_ego_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_neighbor_vehicle_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: neighbor_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_start: lane(side_of: sut.car, side: gen_neighbor_vehicle_side, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_start: lateral(0meter, line: center, tolerance: 1.5m, at: start, \
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_end: speed(gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end, 
                    at: end, faster_than: sut.car,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_position_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_start: position(distance: [10..]m, tolerance: 2m, ahead_of: sut.car, \
                    at: start, measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl)

        emit ego_drive_end


    event phase_essence_approach_start is @phase_essence_approach.start
    event phase_essence_approach_end is @phase_essence_approach.end
    event phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start is @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl.start
    event phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_active is phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start_bool and not phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end_bool
    event phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end is @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl.end
    event phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_end is @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl.end

    var phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start)
    var phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end)

    var swirling_period_start_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start)
    event swirling_period_sample is @top.clk if (not phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end_bool and \ 
        swirling_period_start_bool and neighbor_vehicle.prev_state != null)
    var lat_count : int = 10
    var prev_cycle_time : time
    var start_time : time = sample(top.time, @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start)
    var first_adjusted_lat_offset: length
    var neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period: time

    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max: statistics(sample_type: length, measurement: maximum)

    var neighbor_vehicle_swirl_amplitude_sd_tolerance: length = 0.1m  
    var neighbor_vehicle_max_lat_speed_tolerance : speed = 0.5mps

    neighbor_vehicle_lateral_shift_shape_amplitude_sd: statistics(sample_type: length, measurement: standard_deviation)
    neighbor_vehicle_max_lat_speed: statistics(sample_type: speed, measurement: maximum)

    def reached_lane_count_record() is:
        # Offset used to ensure negative lateral offsets are avoided
        const avoid_negative_lat_offset : length = 10m
        const lat_offset_tolerance : length = 0.01m
        var current_lat_value : length = neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
        var previous_lat_value : length = neighbor_vehicle.prev_state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
        if lat_count == 10: 
            first_adjusted_lat_offset = neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
            lat_count = 0
            
        if lat_count == 0 and  math.abs(first_adjusted_lat_offset-current_lat_value) >= lat_offset_tolerance: 
            if current_lat_value > first_adjusted_lat_offset:
                lat_count = -1
            if current_lat_value < first_adjusted_lat_offset:
                lat_count = 1
        else:   
            if lat_count == 1 and current_lat_value > previous_lat_value:
                    # The first peak occurs at four times the period
                    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period  = 4*(top.time - start_time)
                    swirling_period_start_bool = false  
            elif lat_count == -1 and current_lat_value < previous_lat_value:
                    # The first peak occurs at four times the period
                    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period  = 4*(top.time - start_time)
                    swirling_period_start_bool = false

    on @swirling_period_sample:
        call reached_lane_count_record()

    on @phase_essence_approach_start:
        neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start = neighbor_vehicle.state.speed - sut.car.state.speed
        if (sut.car.road_distance(neighbor_vehicle, center, center, lat, road) < 0m):
            neighbor_vehicle_side = right
        elif (sut.car.road_distance(neighbor_vehicle, center, center, lat, road) > 0m):
            neighbor_vehicle_side = left

    on @phase_essence_approach_end:
        leading_time_neighbor = neighbor_vehicle.get_time_gap(sut.car)

    on @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start:
        neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl = neighbor_vehicle.state.speed - sut.car.state.speed

    on @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_active:
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max.add_sample(math.abs(neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset))
        neighbor_vehicle_lateral_shift_shape_amplitude_sd.add_sample(neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset)
        neighbor_vehicle_max_lat_speed.add_sample((math.abs(neighbor_vehicle.state.road_speed.lat)))

    on @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end:
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start = neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period/2
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end = neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period/2
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude = neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max.compute()

        if (neighbor_vehicle_lateral_shift_shape_amplitude_sd.compute() >= neighbor_vehicle_swirl_amplitude_sd_tolerance) and (neighbor_vehicle_max_lat_speed.compute() >= neighbor_vehicle_max_lat_speed_tolerance):
            neighbor_vehicle_maneuver = with_swirl   
        else:
            neighbor_vehicle_maneuver = without_swirl

    on @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_end:
        neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end = neighbor_vehicle.state.speed - sut.car.state.speed

extend vehicle.global_checkers:
    # Deactivate the off-road check, aligning with the intended objective of the scenario.
    override(off_road_checker, run_mode: freeze)


extend sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl_test:

    do phase_test: serial():

        # invoke the default base ego warm up scenario for the adjacent_vehicles family
        phase_ego_warm_up: neighbor_vehicle_family_ego_warm_up(neighbor_vehicle: neighbor_vehicle)

        # invoke adjacent_vehicles scenario
        phase_scenario: vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl(neighbor_vehicle: neighbor_vehicle)

        # invoke the default base post scenario for the adjacent_vehicles family
        phase_post: neighbor_vehicle_family_post(neighbor_vehicle: neighbor_vehicle)

                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_post_accompany: lateral(0meter, line: center, tolerance: 1.5m,

                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_post_accompany: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_essence_post_accompany_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_post_accompany)

        emit ego_drive_end

    # Deactivate the off_road check at the start of the phase_essence_accompany, aligning with the intended objective of the scenario.
    on @phase_essence_accompany.start:
        override(neighbor_vehicle.global_checkers.off_road_checker,freeze)


    # Auxiliar function and events to calculate swirling period start and end
    var phase_essence_accompany_start_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_accompany.start)
    var phase_essence_accompany_end_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_accompany.end)
    var swirling_period_start_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_accompany.start)
    event swirling_period_sample is @top.clk if (not phase_essence_accompany_end_bool and \ 
        swirling_period_start_bool and neighbor_vehicle.prev_state != null)
    var lat_count : int = 10
    var prev_cycle_time : time
    var start_time : time = sample(top.time, @phase_essence_accompany.start)
    var first_adjusted_lat_offset: length
    var neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period: time

    def reached_lane_count_record() is:
        # Offset used to ensure negative lateral offsets are avoided
        const avoid_negative_lat_offset : length = 10m
        const lat_offset_tolerance : length = 0.01m
        var current_lat_value : length = neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
        var previous_lat_value : length = neighbor_vehicle.prev_state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
        if lat_count == 10: 
            first_adjusted_lat_offset = neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
            lat_count = 0
            
        if lat_count == 0 and  math.abs(first_adjusted_lat_offset-current_lat_value) >= lat_offset_tolerance: 
            if current_lat_value > first_adjusted_lat_offset:
                lat_count = -1
            if current_lat_value < first_adjusted_lat_offset:
                lat_count = 1
        else:   
            if lat_count == 1 and current_lat_value > previous_lat_value:
                    # The first peak occurs at four times the period
                    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period  = 4*(top.time - start_time)
                    swirling_period_start_bool = false  
            elif lat_count == -1 and current_lat_value < previous_lat_value:
                    # The first peak occurs at four times the period
                    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period  = 4*(top.time - start_time)
                    swirling_period_start_bool = false

    on @swirling_period_sample:
        call reached_lane_count_record()

    on @phase_essence_accompany.end:
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start = neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period/2
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end = neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period/2
    
    
    # Sampling metrics for coverage    
    on @phase_essence_approaching.start: 
        ego_time_gap_to_neighbor_vehicle_at_start = sut.car.get_time_gap(neighbor_vehicle)

    on @phase_essence_approaching.end:
        neighbor_vehicle_lon_distance = math.abs(sut.car.road_distance(neighbor_vehicle,closest_compound,closest_compound,lon,road))
        if (sut.car.road_distance(neighbor_vehicle, center, center, lon, road) > 0m):
            neighbor_vehicle_relative_position_to_ego = neighbor_vehicle_ahead_of_ego
        else:
            neighbor_vehicle_relative_position_to_ego = neighbor_vehicle_behind_ego


    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max: statistics(sample_type: length, measurement: maximum)
    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_min: statistics(sample_type: length, measurement: minimum)

    on @accompany_phase_active:
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max.add_sample(neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset)
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_min.add_sample(neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset)

    on @phase_essence_accompany.end:
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude = neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max.compute() - neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_min.compute()

extend issue_kind: [ego_did_not_move]
extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru:

    # Configuring parameters for the crossing VRU group scenario
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_size_group == gen_vru_group_size)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_crossing_variant == gen_crossing_variant)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_group_side_at_start == gen_vru_group_1_side_at_start)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_trigger_time == gen_trigger_time)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_move_vru_group_duration_1 == vru_group_move_duration)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_move_vru_group_duration_2 == vru_group_move_duration)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start == vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end == vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.vru_group_end_position_params.min_lat_offset == 0m)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.vru_group_end_position_params.max_lat_offset == 0m)

    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_size_group == gen_vru_group_size)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_crossing_variant == gen_crossing_variant)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_group_side_at_start == gen_vru_group_2_side_at_start)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_trigger_time == gen_trigger_time)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_move_vru_group_duration_1 == vru_group_move_duration)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_move_vru_group_duration_2 == vru_group_move_duration)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start == vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end == vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.vru_group_end_position_params.min_lat_offset == 0m)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.vru_group_end_position_params.max_lat_offset == 0m)
    keep(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.ego_path.in_road.min_lanes >= 1)

    # Relative VRU move angle to road at the start
    vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start: angle with:
        keep(default it in [90..150]degree)

    # Relative VRU move angle to road at the end
    vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end: angle with:
        keep(default it in [30..90]degree)
    
    # VRU group move duration
    vru_group_move_duration: time 
    keep(default vru_group_move_duration in [3..5]s)

    # Trigger event for move of VRU group to start
    event move_trigger_event_1 is (sut.car.state.speed > 1kph)
    event move_trigger_event_2 is @ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
        ego_enters_junction if sut.car.state.speed > 1kph

    # Longitudinal distance of vru_group_1 to ego, w.r.t internal_road
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_group_lon_offset_to_ego_start_at_crossing == \
        -1*(crossing_vru_group_1.vru_group_end_position_params.\
        max_distance_between_objects * crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_size_group))

    # Longitudinal distance of vru_group_2 to ego
    vru_group_2_lon_offset_to_ego_at_start: length with:
        keep(default it == 0m)
        keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_group_lon_offset_to_ego_start_at_crossing == \
             vru_group_2_lon_offset_to_ego_at_start)

    # These angles are defined to avoid VRU colliding with Ego, In cases,
    # If VRU is traveling in opposite direction to the Ego (Ex:
    # go_and_return variant)
    keep(gen_crossing_variant == go_and_return and \
        gen_vru_group_1_side_at_start == right =>
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start in [80..90]degree and \
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end in [90..100]degree)    
    keep(gen_crossing_variant == go_and_return and \
        gen_vru_group_1_side_at_start == left =>
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start in [90..100]degree and \
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end in [80..90]degree)    
    keep(gen_crossing_variant == go_and_return and \
        gen_vru_group_2_side_at_start == left =>
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start in [90..100]degree and \
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end in [80..90]degree)
    keep(gen_crossing_variant == go_and_return and \
        gen_vru_group_2_side_at_start == right =>
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start in [80..90]degree and \
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end in [90..100]degree)

    # Enable collision avoidance for Ego
    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.enabling_policy == \
        always_enabled)


    # Main do
    do phase_essence: first_of:
        phase_essence_ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru: parallel(start_to_start: 0s, overlap: any):
                
            ego_traverse_junction_at_essence: ego_traverse_junction()

            crossing_vru_group_1_at_essence: serial:
                wait @move_trigger_event_1
                crossing_vru_group_1: top.crossing_vru_group(ref_drive: \
                    ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
                    vehicle_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
                    drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road)
                    
            crossing_vru_group_2_at_essence: serial:
                wait @move_trigger_event_2
                crossing_vru_group_2: top.crossing_vru_group(ref_drive: \
                    ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
                    vehicle_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
                    drive_vehicle_at_essence_out_road)
        with:
            intent_essence_duration: duration(gen_essence_duration, 
            run_mode: best_effort)

        # Scenario stopping condition - Ego standstill
        phase_essence_scenario_stopper: serial:
            wait @ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.ego_stops_for_max_time
            log_info("Ego speed was slower than " +\
                "$(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.standstill_threshold_speed) " +\
                "for longer than " +\
                "$(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.max_time_ego_stops)")

    in ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.vehicle_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
        drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
        pass
        lane(outer.gen_ego_lane_at_ego_inroad_drive, from: curb, 
        run_mode: best_effort)

    on @ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.ego_stops_for_max_time:
        call sut_warning(ego_did_not_move, 
            " The Ego stopped for $(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.max_time_ego_stops)")

    keep(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.vehicle_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
        gen_essence_internal_road_duration in [2..5]s)

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru_main:
    do phase_main: serial:
        phase_ego_warm_up: ego_traverse_junction_ego_warm_up()
        phase_essence: ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru()
        phase_post: ego_traverse_junction_post()

    # To avoid lane change after warm_up
    in phase_ego_warm_up.drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up with:
        lane(outer.phase_essence.gen_ego_lane_at_ego_inroad_drive, from: curb,
        run_mode: best_effort)

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/vehicle_traverse_junction/vehicle_traverse_junction_top.osc"

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle: 
    
    # Path of vehicle
    vehicle_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction 

    vehicle_one_way_road_path: one_way_road
    ego_one_way_road_path: one_way_road
    
    vehicle_time_gap_to_junction_at_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_junction)

    vehicle_path_direction: drive_direction 
    
    # Constraints both the vehicles the same junction_id
    keep(default ego_path.internal_road.junction_id == vehicle_path.internal_road.junction_id)

    # Calculating distance to junction for both vehicles    
    ego_distance_to_junction_at_start: length 

    vehicle_distance_to_junction_at_start: length

    do phase_essence: first_of:
        phase_essence_ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle: parallel(overlap:equal):
            ego_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(
                vehicle: sut.car,
                vehicle_path: ego_path,
                one_way_road_path: ego_one_way_road_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_ego_speed_at_start,
                gen_vehicle_distance_to_junction_at_start: ego_distance_to_junction_at_start,
                gen_vehicle_traversal_direction: gen_ego_traversal_direction) 

            vehicle_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(
                vehicle: vehicle,
                vehicle_path: vehicle_path,
                one_way_road_path: vehicle_one_way_road_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_vehicle_speed_at_start,
                gen_vehicle_distance_to_junction_at_start: vehicle_distance_to_junction_at_start,
                gen_vehicle_traversal_direction: vehicle_path_direction)
        
        phase_essence_scenario_stopper: serial:
            wait @vehicles_stopped_in_inroad
            log_info("Ego and vehicle stopped in the in_road for > $(max_time_vehicles_wait)")

    override_intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end: \
    override(vehicle_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, run_mode: best_effort)

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_main:
    do phase_main: serial:
        phase_ego_warm_up: ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_ego_warm_up(\
            vehicle: vehicle)

        phase_essence: ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle(\
            vehicle: vehicle)

        phase_post: ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_post(\
            vehicle: vehicle)

import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/ftx/ftx_group_driver_model.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru/ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru_top.osc"

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_and_crossing_vru_and_traffic_sign:

    # Road element defintion for Ego drive with traffic sign at the junction
    signed_junction: road_with_sign
    keep(signed_junction.sign_type == gen_traffic_sign_type)
    
    # The number of vehicles in random_traffic_vehicle_group is assigned
    random_traffic_group: common_route_car_group with(reference_car: sut.car):
        keep(it.cars.size() == gen_number_of_vehicles_in_random_traffic)
        keep(it.reference_car_index == 0) 
    random_traffic_group_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model

    keep(random_traffic_group_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(random_traffic_group_driver_model.target_speed == gen_traffic_group_target_speed)

    # Setting the behavior model of each vehicle in random traffic
    # vehicle group as ftx_driver 
    for vehicle in random_traffic_group.cars:
        keep(vehicle.initial_bm == random_traffic_group_driver_model)
    
    do phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):

        ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru_at_essence: ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru()
        drive_random_traffic_group_at_essence: random_traffic_group.group_drive()

    ego_at_sign: in ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru_at_essence.\
        ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.vehicle_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
        drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
            intent_ego_along_at_essence_internal_road_start: along(
                outer.signed_junction, at: start)

    
extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_and_crossing_vru_and_traffic_sign_main:

    do phase_main: serial():
        phase_ego_warm_up: ego_traverse_junction_ego_warm_up()
        phase_essence: ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_and_crossing_vru_and_traffic_sign()
        phase_post: ego_traverse_junction_post()

    # To avoid lane change after warm_up
    in phase_ego_warm_up.drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up with:
        lane(outer.phase_essence.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru_at_essence.\
        gen_ego_lane_at_ego_inroad_drive, from: curb,
        run_mode: best_effort)

# In this scenario, The Ego approaches a junction on a random junction leg
# and random lane with a configurable time gap, Each other Vehicle

    vehicle_4: vehicle

# Copyright (C) 2025 Foretellix Ltd (“Foretellix”)
# This source code file is licensed to you under Foretellix’ End User License
# Agreement, you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You are not allowed to distribute it to any third party without Foretellix’

# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/vehicle_traverse_junction/vehicle_traverse_junction_top.osc"

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles:
    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event

    # Initial other Vehicle time gap
    vehicle_1_time_gap: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_junction)
    vehicle_2_time_gap: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_junction)
    vehicle_3_time_gap: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_junction)
    vehicle_4_time_gap: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_junction)
    vehicle_5_time_gap: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_junction)

    ego_speed_at_end: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_speed_range)
    
    keep(max_time_vehicles_wait  == 30s)

    var vehicle_1_speed_at_start: speed
    var vehicle_2_speed_at_start: speed
    var vehicle_3_speed_at_start: speed
    var vehicle_4_speed_at_start: speed
    var vehicle_5_speed_at_start: speed

    # Junction paths
    vehicle_1_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction 
    vehicle_2_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction 
    vehicle_3_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction 
    vehicle_4_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction 
    vehicle_5_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction  

    road_with_sign_track: sut.car.track_road_element(road_with_sign, trigger: all)

    # Sampling the speed of the Vehicle's at start
    on @start: vehicle_1_speed_at_start = vehicle_1.state.speed
    on @start: vehicle_2_speed_at_start = vehicle_2.state.speed
    on @start: vehicle_3_speed_at_start = vehicle_3.state.speed
    on @start: vehicle_4_speed_at_start = vehicle_4.state.speed
    on @start: vehicle_5_speed_at_start = vehicle_5.state.speed

    # Constraints all the vehicles the same junction_id
    keep(vehicle_1_path.internal_road.junction_id == ego_path.internal_road.\
        junction_id) 
    keep(vehicle_2_path.internal_road.junction_id == ego_path.internal_road.\
        junction_id) 
    keep(vehicle_3_path.internal_road.junction_id == ego_path.internal_road.\
        junction_id) 
    keep(vehicle_4_path.internal_road.junction_id == ego_path.internal_road.\
        junction_id) 
    keep(vehicle_5_path.internal_road.junction_id == ego_path.internal_road.\
        junction_id) 
   
    ego_distance_at_start: length with:
        keep(it == gen_ego_speed_at_start*gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start)
    vehicle_1_distance_at_start: length with:
        keep(it == gen_vehicle_1_speed_at_start*vehicle_1_time_gap)
    vehicle_2_distance_at_start: length with:
        keep(it == gen_vehicle_2_speed_at_start*vehicle_2_time_gap)
    vehicle_3_distance_at_start: length with:
        keep(it == gen_vehicle_3_speed_at_start*vehicle_3_time_gap)
    vehicle_4_distance_at_start: length with:
        keep(it == gen_vehicle_4_speed_at_start*vehicle_4_time_gap)
    vehicle_5_distance_at_start: length with:
        keep(it == gen_vehicle_5_speed_at_start*vehicle_5_time_gap)


    keep(gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start - vehicle_1_time_gap == gen_joint_arrival_time or \
        gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start - vehicle_2_time_gap == gen_joint_arrival_time or \
        gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start - vehicle_3_time_gap == gen_joint_arrival_time or \
        gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start - vehicle_4_time_gap == gen_joint_arrival_time or \
        gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start - vehicle_5_time_gap == gen_joint_arrival_time)

    # Distance offset used in scenario
    distance_offset: length with:
        keep(it == 20m)
    
    # The scenario ends when Ego travels 5s outside the junction
    drive_time_after_junction: time with:
        keep(it == 10s)
    
    # Event definition to define the sampling clock
    event clock is sut.car.state != null 

    var out_road_start_position := sample(ego_path.internal_road.get_position_on_road(\
        ego_path.internal_road.length), @start)
    
    event ego_junction_drive_on_out_road_event is @clock if map.distance_from_ref_position(
        sut.car.state.msp_pos.road_position, out_road_start_position) in [-0.5..0.5]m

    event ego_exited is @ego_junction_drive_on_out_road_event 
    var ego_exited_bool: bool = sample(true, @ego_exited)
    var triggered_clock: time = sample(top.time, @ego_exited)
    event exit_timer is ego_exited_bool == true
    event scenario_stopper is @exit_timer if (top.time - triggered_clock == drive_time_after_junction)

    distance_tolerance: length with:
        keep(default it == 20m)
        
    do phase_essence: first_of:
        phase_essence_ego_traverse_junction_with_multiples_vehicle: parallel(overlap: equal):
       
            ego_traverse_junction_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(\
                vehicle: sut.car,
                vehicle_path: ego_path,
                gen_vehicle_traversal_direction: gen_ego_traversal_direction,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_ego_speed_at_start) 

            vehicle_1_traverse_junction_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(\
                vehicle: vehicle_1,
                vehicle_path: vehicle_1_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_vehicle_1_speed_at_start)
            
            vehicle_2_traverse_junction_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(\
                vehicle: vehicle_2,
                vehicle_path: vehicle_2_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_vehicle_2_speed_at_start)
            
            vehicle_3_traverse_junction_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(\
                vehicle: vehicle_3,
                vehicle_path: vehicle_3_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_vehicle_3_speed_at_start)
            
            vehicle_4_traverse_junction_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(\
                vehicle: vehicle_4,
                vehicle_path: vehicle_4_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_vehicle_4_speed_at_start)
            
            vehicle_5_traverse_junction_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(\
                vehicle: vehicle_5,
                vehicle_path: vehicle_5_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_vehicle_5_speed_at_start)

        phase_essence_scenario_stopper : serial():
            wait @scenario_stopper
            log_info("Ego drove for $(drive_time_after_junction) 
            after exiting junction")

    override_intent_vehicle_1_along_at_essence_in_road_end:\ 
        override(vehicle_1_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end ,
             run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_vehicle_2_along_at_essence_in_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_2_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end , 
            run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_vehicle_3_along_at_essence_in_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_3_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end , 
            run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_vehicle_4_along_at_essence_in_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_4_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end , 
            run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_vehicle_5_along_at_essence_in_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_5_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end , 
            run_mode: disable)

    override_intent_vehicle_1_along_at_essence_out_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_1_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, 
            run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_vehicle_2_along_at_essence_out_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_2_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, 
            run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_vehicle_3_along_at_essence_out_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_3_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, 
            run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_vehicle_4_along_at_essence_out_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_4_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, 
        run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_vehicle_5_along_at_essence_out_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_5_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, 
            run_mode: best_effort)

    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, \
        vehicle_1_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, \
        vehicle_2_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, \
        vehicle_3_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, \
            vehicle_4_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end,\
         vehicle_5_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, 0s)

    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, \
        vehicle_1_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, \
        vehicle_2_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, \
        vehicle_3_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, \
        vehicle_4_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, \
        vehicle_5_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, 0s)

    
    in vehicle_1_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
        intent_assist_vehicle_1_along_at_essence_in_road_start: along(\
                outer.vehicle_1_path.in_road, 
                end_offset: [0m..outer.vehicle_1_distance_at_start], 
                at: start,
                run_mode: best_effort)

    in vehicle_2_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
        intent_assist_vehicle_2_along_at_essence_in_road_start: along(\
            outer.vehicle_2_path.in_road, 
            end_offset: [0m..outer.vehicle_2_distance_at_start], 
            at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

    in vehicle_3_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
        intent_assist_vehicle_3_along_at_essence_in_road_start: along(\
            outer.vehicle_3_path.in_road, 
            end_offset: [0m..outer.vehicle_3_distance_at_start], 
            at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

    in vehicle_4_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
        intent_assist_vehicle_4_along_at_essence_in_road_start: along(\
            outer.vehicle_4_path.in_road, 
            end_offset: [0m..outer.vehicle_4_distance_at_start], 
            at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

    in vehicle_5_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
        intent_assist_vehicle_5_along_at_essence_in_road_start: along(\
            outer.vehicle_5_path.in_road, 
            end_offset: [0m..outer.vehicle_5_distance_at_start], 
            at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

    in ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_out_road with:

        intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_out_road: speed(\
                outer.ego_speed_at_end, run_mode: best_effort)

extend sut.vehicle_traverse_junction:

    override_intent_assist_vehicle_distance_at_essence_in_road:\
        override(intent_assist_vehicle_distance_at_essence_in_road,
        run_mode: disable)
    
    keep(gen_essence_in_road_duration in [5..30]s)
    keep(gen_essence_out_road_duration in [5..40]s)

extend ftx_driver:

    keep(collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lat == 0.5)

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles_main:

    do phase_main: serial():
    
        phase_warm_up: ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles_ego_warm_up(
            vehicle_1: vehicle_1,
            vehicle_2: vehicle_2,
            vehicle_3: vehicle_3,
            vehicle_4: vehicle_4,
            vehicle_5: vehicle_5)

        phase_essence: ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles(
            vehicle_1: vehicle_1,
            vehicle_2: vehicle_2,
            vehicle_3: vehicle_3,
            vehicle_4: vehicle_4,
            vehicle_5: vehicle_5)

        phase_post: ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles_post(
            vehicle_1: vehicle_1,
            vehicle_2: vehicle_2,
            vehicle_3: vehicle_3,
            vehicle_4: vehicle_4,
            vehicle_5: vehicle_5)

# ego::ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group

# approach the junction to perform a turn protected by a traffic light. 
# Here, the traffic vehicles follow the path of the crosspath_vehicle.
# The crosspath_vehicle and traffic vehicles enter from the 
# left or right leg of the Ego. Both the crosspath_vehicle and the traffic vehicles 
# go straight to the out road, but the Ego can take any of the junction's exits
#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
# . gen_ego_speed_at_start - Ego speed at in_road drive
# . gen_crosspath_vehicle_speed_at_start - Crosspath_vehicle speed at start
# . gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start - Ego time gap to the junction at start
# . gen_joint_arrival_time - Joint arrival time of Ego and crosspath_vehicle
# . gen_ego_traversal_direction - Ego junction drive direction
# . gen_cross_path_vehicle_entry_side - Crosspath_vehicle entry side
# . gen_cross_path_traffic_group_min_initial_ttc - Minimum initial TTC of cross_path_traffic_group
# . gen_number_of_cross_path_traffic_group_vehicles - Number of vehicles in cross_path_traffic_group
# . gen_traffic_light_transition_delay - Delay between the traffic light state transition
# . gen_crosspath_vehicle_junction_behavior - Whether crosspath_vehicle's junction behavior is enabled

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle/ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group/ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/traffic_light_controller_common/tl_controller_top.osc"

    crosspath_vehicle: vehicle

    cross_path_traffic_group: single_lane_car_group with(\
        reference_car: crosspath_vehicle)

scenario sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light_with_circles inherits \
    ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light (tl_state_type == unprotected):

        # Delay between the traffic light state transition
        @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light_with_circles.tl_state_change_on_both_sides.traffic_light_transition_delay", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light_with_circles.start.gen_traffic_light_transition_delay")

scenario sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light_with_arrows inherits \

        gen_crosspath_vehicle_junction_behavior: bool with:

extend gen_config:
    set strategies = [s5]

enum tl_state_type: [protected, unprotected]

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light:

    tl_state_type: tl_state_type

    ego_tl_transitions_start_index: int with:
        keep(default it == 0)
    crosspath_tl_transitions_start_index: int with:
        keep(default it == 2)
    
    # The timing of the traffic light states of Ego and
    # crosspath_vehicle
    ego_green_time: time with: keep(default it == 8s)
    ego_yellow_time: time with: keep(default it == 4s)
    ego_red_time: time with: keep(default it == (ego_green_time + ego_yellow_time))
    ego_tl_cycle: time with: keep(default it == ego_green_time + \
        ego_yellow_time + ego_red_time)

    crosspath_green_time: time 
    crosspath_yellow_time: time 
    crosspath_red_time: time
    crosspath_tl_cycle: time with: keep(default it == crosspath_green_time + \
        crosspath_yellow_time + crosspath_red_time)

    keep(default crosspath_green_time == ego_green_time)
    keep(default crosspath_yellow_time == ego_yellow_time)
    keep(default crosspath_red_time == ego_red_time)   

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light_with_circles:

    keep(ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_at_essence.\
        ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_at_essence.\
        ego_internal_road.direction != left or \
        ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_at_essence.\
        ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_at_essence.\
        ego_internal_road.valid_tl_go_exclusive == false)

    for car in ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_at_essence.\
        cross_path_traffic_group.cars:
        keep(car.ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == gen_crosspath_vehicle_junction_behavior)
        
    keep(ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_at_essence.\
        crosspath_vehicle.ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable \
        == gen_crosspath_vehicle_junction_behavior)

    do ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_at_essence: \
        sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group(\
            crosspath_vehicle: crosspath_vehicle,
            cross_path_traffic_group: cross_path_traffic_group) with: 

            ego_tl: one_tl_five_semantic_cross_path_unprotected(\
                tl_internal_road: it.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_at_essence.ego_internal_road, 
                repeat_always: true,
                first_duration: ego_red_time, 
                second_duration: gen_traffic_light_transition_delay, 
                third_duration: ego_green_time, 
                fourth_duration: ego_yellow_time,
                tl_transitions_start_index: ego_tl_transitions_start_index)
            crosspath_tl: one_tl_five_semantic_cross_path_unprotected(\
                tl_internal_road: it.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_at_essence.crosspath_vehicle_path.internal_road, 
                repeat_always: true, 
                first_duration: crosspath_red_time,
                second_duration: gen_traffic_light_transition_delay, 
                third_duration: crosspath_green_time,
                fourth_duration: crosspath_yellow_time,
                tl_transitions_start_index: crosspath_tl_transitions_start_index)

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light_with_arrows:
    for car in ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_at_essence.\
        cross_path_traffic_group.cars:
        keep(car.ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == gen_crosspath_vehicle_junction_behavior)
        
    keep(ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_at_essence.\
        crosspath_vehicle.ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == gen_crosspath_vehicle_junction_behavior)

    ego_green_arrow_time: time with: keep(default it == 8s)
    ego_yellow_arrow_time: time with: keep(default it == 4s)
    ego_red_arrow_time: time with: keep(default it == ego_green_arrow_time + ego_yellow_arrow_time)

    keep(crosspath_green_time == ego_green_arrow_time)
    keep(crosspath_yellow_time == ego_yellow_arrow_time)
    keep(crosspath_red_time == ego_red_arrow_time)
    
    keep(ego_tl_transitions_start_index == 0)
    keep(crosspath_tl_transitions_start_index == 0)

     # An internal road with direction 'left' for traffic light with left arrow 
    ego_left_internal_road: internal_road with: 
        keep(it == ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_at_essence.\
            ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_at_essence.\
            ego_internal_road)
    ego_straight_internal_road: internal_road

    keep(ego_left_internal_road.junction_id == ego_straight_internal_road.junction_id\
        and ego_left_internal_road.in_one_way_road_id == \
        ego_straight_internal_road.in_one_way_road_id and \
        ego_left_internal_road.direction in [sharp_left, left, slight_left] \
        and ego_straight_internal_road.direction == straight)

    do ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_at_essence: \
            sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group(\
                crosspath_vehicle: crosspath_vehicle,
                cross_path_traffic_group: cross_path_traffic_group) with: 
          
                ego_tl_arrow: one_tl_five_semantic_cross_path_protected(\
                    tl_internal_road: ego_left_internal_road, 
                    repeat_always: true,
                    first_duration: ego_green_arrow_time, 
                    second_duration: ego_yellow_arrow_time, 
                    third_duration: gen_traffic_light_transition_delay,
                    fourth_duration: ego_red_arrow_time,
                    tl_transitions_start_index: ego_tl_transitions_start_index)
                crosspath_tl: one_tl_five_semantic_cross_path_unprotected(\
                    tl_internal_road: it.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_at_essence.crosspath_vehicle_path.internal_road, 
                    repeat_always: true,

extend sut.vehicle_traverse_junction:

    # The distance between the vehicle and the junction at the end
    vehicle_distance_from_junction_at_end: length with:
        keep(default it in [5..40]m)

    # Tolerance for distance of the vehicle from the junction at start/end
    distance_tolerance: length with:
        keep(default it == 20m)
        
    # To ensure the vehicle drives on a one-way road during the in-road phase
    one_way_road_path: one_way_road
    
    junction_offset: length with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_junction_dist_offset)

    # Path of the vehicle
    vehicle_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction
    keep(vehicle_path.internal_road.junction_category == complex)

    # The junction behavior of the vehicle is enabled by default
    keep(default vehicle.ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == true) 
    
    event clock is @top.clk if (vehicle.state != null and vehicle_path != null)
    
    event vehicle_on_in_road_end is @clock if (
        map.distance_from_ref_position(
        vehicle.state.msp_pos.road_position, 
        vehicle_path.in_road.get_position_on_road(\
        vehicle_path.in_road.length)) <= 1m)

    on @vehicle_on_in_road_end:
        override(intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end, 
        run_mode: best_effort)

    # The distance between Ego and out road start after which
    # the along modifier in out road can be disabled
    ego_out_road_distance: range of length
    keep(default ego_out_road_distance in [-10..-9]m)

    # Override the along as vehicle may enter in the next junction
    # if out road is short
    event vehicle_on_out_road_start is @clock if (
        map.distance_from_ref_position(
        vehicle.state.msp_pos.road_position, 
        vehicle_path.out_road.get_position_on_road(\
        0m)) in ego_out_road_distance)

    on @vehicle_on_out_road_start:
        override(intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, 
        run_mode: best_effort)

    # Constraining the direction of junction drive to be equal to
    # 'gen_vehicle_traversal_direction' parameter
    keep(gen_vehicle_traversal_direction == left => \
    vehicle_path.internal_road.direction in [slight_left, left, sharp_left])
    keep(gen_vehicle_traversal_direction == right => \
    vehicle_path.internal_road.direction in [slight_right, right, sharp_right])
    keep(gen_vehicle_traversal_direction == straight => \
    vehicle_path.internal_road.direction == straight)

    do phase_essence: serial():

        # Vehicle drives on an in-road
        phase_essence_in_road: serial:
            drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road: vehicle.drive() with :
                intent_assist_vehicle_speed_at_essence_in_road_start: speed(\
                    gen_vehicle_speed_at_start, at: start,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road: along(
                    one_way_road_path, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_vehicle_distance_at_essence_in_road: distance(
                    gen_vehicle_distance_to_junction_at_start, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)    
                intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end: along( 
                    vehicle_path.in_road, end_offset: junction_offset, at: end,
                    tolerance: distance_tolerance)
        with:
            intent_essence_in_road_duration: duration( 
                gen_essence_in_road_duration, 
                tolerance : gen_duration_tolerance)

        # vehicle drives through the junction, it can even stop if
        # there is any obstacle, so override the modifier
        phase_essence_internal_road: serial:
            drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road: vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_vehicle_along_at_essence_internal_road_end:\
                    along(vehicle_path.internal_road, at: end, 
                     run_mode: best_effort) 
        with:
            intent_essence_internal_road_duration: duration(
                gen_essence_internal_road_duration, 
                tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance)

                    
        # vehicle drives on out road 
        phase_essence_out_road: serial:
            drive_vehicle_at_essence_out_road: vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end: along(
                    vehicle_path.out_road, at: end, 
                    start_offset: vehicle_distance_from_junction_at_end, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end: along(
                    vehicle_path.out_road, at: end)
        with:
            intent_assist_essence_out_road_duration: \
                duration(gen_essence_out_road_duration, run_mode: best_effort )
