# The scenario needs more time to complete as the distance
# travelled by Ego is approx >700m due to this the
# time is updated from default 100s to 150s
extend test_config:
    set max_test_time = 150s

extend sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation:

    # Side of symbol vehicles
    symbol_vehicle_side: av_road_side with:
        # Decide on which side of the road the symbol_vehicles will be placed,
        # depending on the sign of the arrow attenuator:
        # - when arrow is pointing left, it means that symbol_vehicles must be on
        #    the rightmost lane (1 from curb)
        # - when arrow is pointing right, it means that the symbol_vehicles must
        #    be on the leftmost lane (1 from center)
        keep(gen_side_of_symbol_vehicle == rightmost => shadow_vehicle_1.attenuator_kind ==\
            left_arrow_board and it == curb)
        keep(gen_side_of_symbol_vehicle == leftmost => shadow_vehicle_1.attenuator_kind ==\
            right_arrow_board and it == center)

    # Path attributes
    ego_path: one_way_road
    keep(ego_path.min_lanes >= 2)
         
    # Offset
    distance_offset: length
    keep(distance_offset == 5m)
    distance_tolerance: length
    keep(distance_tolerance == 20m)
    speed_offset: speed
    keep(default speed_offset == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_offset)
    ego_passed_work_vehicle_time: time
    keep(ego_passed_work_vehicle_time == 5s)
    lane_section_offset: length
    keep(lane_section_offset == 50m)
    
    ego_time_gap_to_work_vehicle_at_essence_end: time
    keep(ego_time_gap_to_work_vehicle_at_essence_end in [6..10]s)
    # Ego start offset is provided to Ego at start
    # and shadow_vehicle_2 so as to take 
    # appropriate offset and place shadow_vehicle_2
    # and Ego.
    ego_start_offset: length

    # Msp position of shadow_vehicle_2
    shadow_vehicle_2_start_msp_position: msp_position

    # Positioning the shadow_vehicle_2 relative to ego_path
    # The shadow_vehicle_2 is placed behind shadow_vehicle_1 with
    # gen_shadow_vehicle_2_lon_distance_to_ego
    # The shadow_vehicle_2 is placed by 1m lat offset from lane marking
    shadow_vehicle_2_lat_offset: length with:
        keep(it == -1 * ((shadow_vehicle_2.get_width()/2.0) + 2m))
    shadow_vehicle_2_placement: position_along_road(\
        shadow_vehicle_2_start_msp_position, ego_path,
        lon_offset: ego_start_offset + gen_shadow_vehicle_2_lon_distance_to_ego + \
            (shadow_vehicle_2.get_length()/2),
        lat_offset: shadow_vehicle_2_lat_offset)

    # Lane section attributes
    lane_section: lane_section

    # Ego complete stand_still time. The Ego will be compared
    # with this value and if Ego standstills for given time
    # then scenario will end
    ego_complete_stand_still_time: time with:
        keep(default it == 10s)

    do phase_essence : first_of:
        phase_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation: parallel(overlap: equal):
            # shadow_vehicle_1 and work_vehicle is either on
            # leftmost/rightmost with defined speed as
            # gen_shadow_vehicle_1_and_work_vehicle_speed. The shadow_vehicle_1 starts
            # moving by having a position of
            # [gen_shadow_vehicle_1_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_2_at_start +
            # gen_shadow_vehicle_2_lon_distance_to_ego] +/- distance_offset from Ego
            # The work_vehicle is placed ahead of shadow_vehicle_1 by
            # gen_work_vehicle_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_1_at_start +/- distance_offset.
            drive_ego_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation_start:\
                    speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, 
                        run_mode: best_effort) 
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation:\
                keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation:\
                keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation_start:\
                along(ego_path, at: start, start_offset: ego_start_offset, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                # The ego_path have relative distance from Ego to work_vehicle
                # and tolerance of lane_section_offset as Ego should move ahead of 
                # work_vehicle by [6..10]s
                intent_ego_along_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation_start:\
                along(ego_path, end_offset: [gen_shadow_vehicle_2_lon_distance_to_ego +\
                    gen_shadow_vehicle_1_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_2_at_start + \
                    gen_work_vehicle_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_1_at_start..\
                    gen_shadow_vehicle_2_lon_distance_to_ego +\
                    gen_shadow_vehicle_1_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_2_at_start + \
                    gen_work_vehicle_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_1_at_start + \
                    lane_section_offset],
                    at: start, tolerance: distance_tolerance)
                # The Ego should move ahead of work_vehicle at the end of the scenario
                # by more than 5s due to which a range of time as ego_time_gap_to_work_vehicle_at_essence_end 
                # with 1s tolerance is given
                intent_ego_position_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation_end:\
                position(time: ego_time_gap_to_work_vehicle_at_essence_end,
                    ahead_of: work_vehicle, at: end, measure_by: nearest, 
                        time_tolerance: 1s)
            drive_shadow_vehicle_1_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation: shadow_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                intent_shadow_vehicle_1_lane_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation_start:\
                lane(1, from: symbol_vehicle_side, at: start)
                intent_assist_shadow_vehicle_1_speed_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation_start: speed(
                    gen_shadow_vehicle_1_and_work_vehicle_speed, 
                    at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_shadow_vehicle_1_position_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation_start:\
                position(distance: \
                    [gen_shadow_vehicle_1_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_2_at_start + \
                    gen_shadow_vehicle_2_lon_distance_to_ego - distance_offset..\
                    gen_shadow_vehicle_1_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_2_at_start + \
                    gen_shadow_vehicle_2_lon_distance_to_ego + distance_offset],
                    ahead_of: sut.car, measure_by: nearest, at: start, 
                        tolerance: distance_tolerance)
                intent_assist_shadow_vehicle_1_along_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation_start:\
                along(ego_path, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_shadow_vehicle_1_keep_speed_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation:\
                keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_shadow_vehicle_1_keep_lane_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation:\
                keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_work_vehicle_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation: work_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_work_vehicle_along_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation_start:\
                    along(ego_path, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_work_vehicle_lane_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation_start:\
                    lane(same_as: shadow_vehicle_1, at: start)
                intent_assist_work_vehicle_speed_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation_start: speed(
                    gen_shadow_vehicle_1_and_work_vehicle_speed, 
                    at: start,run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_work_vehicle_position_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation_start:\
                position(distance: \
                    [gen_work_vehicle_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_1_at_start - distance_offset..\
                    gen_work_vehicle_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_1_at_start + distance_offset],
                    ahead_of: shadow_vehicle_1, measure_by: nearest, at: start, 
                        tolerance: distance_tolerance)
                intent_assist_work_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation:\
                keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_work_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation:\
                keep_lane()
            
            # The shadow_vehicle_2 is placed at shadow_vehicle_2_start_msp_position
            intent_shadow_vehicle_2_position_at_essence_ego_approach_mobile_operation: shadow_vehicle_2.\
                exists_at(shadow_vehicle_2_start_msp_position)

        serial:
            wait @ego_passed_work_vehicle
            log_info("The Ego passed the work_vehicle"+\
                " with a time gap of more than 5s.")
        serial:
            wait @ego_did_not_pass_work_vehicle

        phase_essence_scenario_stopper: serial:
            wait @ego_following_shadow_vehicle_1_event
            log_info("$(self): ending scenario after Ego is following "+\
                "shadow_vehicle_1 for "+\
                "$(ego_complete_stand_still_time).")
        phase_essence_ego_stopped_scenario_stopper: serial:
            wait @ego_stopped
            log_info("$(self): ending scenario after Ego stopped for"+\
                "$(ego_complete_stand_still_time).")


extend sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation_rightmost_main:

    # If gen_side_of_symbol_vehicle == rightmost then 
    # shadow_vehicle_2 lat_reference is towards right
    keep(phase_essence.shadow_vehicle_2_placement.rightmost_lane == true)
    keep(phase_essence.shadow_vehicle_2_placement.lat_reference == right)
    
extend sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation_leftmost_main:
    # If gen_side_of_symbol_vehicle == leftmost then 
    # shadow_vehicle_2 lat_reference is towards left
    keep(phase_essence.shadow_vehicle_2_placement.leftmost_lane == true)
    keep(phase_essence.shadow_vehicle_2_placement.lat_reference == left)

extend sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation_main:
    do phase_main: serial():
        phase_ego_warm_up: construction_sites_base_warm_up(
            shadow_vehicle_2: shadow_vehicle_2,
            shadow_vehicle_1: shadow_vehicle_1,

        phase_post: construction_sites_base_post(
            shadow_vehicle_2: shadow_vehicle_2,
            shadow_vehicle_1: shadow_vehicle_1,
            work_vehicle: work_vehicle)

        # It cuts out at distance of gen_cut_out_vehicle_distance_to_traffic_signal_at_essence_end to traffic signal

    var cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_to_traffic_signal_at_passing_lane_marking: time

extend sut.vehicle_cut_out_exposing_object:
    # Overlap of stationary object on cut out vehicle path details
    overlap_side: int
    keep(gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end == left => overlap_side == 1)
    keep(gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end == right => overlap_side == -1)

    number_of_lanes_to_change: int with:
        keep(default it == 1)

    overlap_offset: overlap_offset with:
        keep(it.angle_between_ego_and_object == yaw_angle_at_essence)
        keep(it.object_width == stationary_object.get_width())
        keep(it.object_length == stationary_object.get_length())

    # Placement of object with respect to Ego
    keep(overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object == (
        ((sut.car.get_width())*overlap_percentage_between_ego_and_object*0.01)-
        ((overlap_offset.overlap_offset_coord() + sut.car.get_width())/2)))

    keep(cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.enable == false)

    top.position_along_drive(object_position, vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence,
        path_fraction: path_fraction,
        lat_offset: overlap_side*overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object,
        lon_offset: gen_cut_out_vehicle_distance_to_object_at_essence_start)


    # Attributing gen variables from subscenario to its father (cut-out main) scenario
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.road == road)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_ego_speed_at_start == gen_ego_speed_at_start)

    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start == gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start == gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_start == gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_start)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end)
    

    on @vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event
    on @vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event


    # Metrics being covered that are specific from this scenario
    var cut_out_vehicle_distance_to_object_at_essence_start: length = sample(
        cut_out_vehicle.road_distance(stationary_object, closest, closest, lon, lane), @phase_essence_start_event)
    var cut_out_vehicle_distance_to_object_at_essence_end: length = sample(
        cut_out_vehicle.road_distance(stationary_object, closest, closest, lon, lane), @phase_essence_end_event)
    var exposing_object_pos := sample(object_position.road_position, @start)
    var cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_to_exposing_object_at_passing_lane_marking: time = sample(
        cut_out_vehicle.get_time_gap(stationary_object), @cut_out_vehicle_passes_lane_marking)
    var ego_rel_lon_distance_to_object_at_essence_end: length = sample(\
        sut.car.road_distance(stationary_object, closest, closest, lon, lane), @phase_essence_end_event)

    const ego_along_start_offset: range of length = [10..20]m

    # Keeping the duration of the essence phase short to avoid cut_out_vehicle impeding ego's maneuvers
    gen_essence_exposing_object_duration: time with:
        keep(default gen_essence_exposing_object_duration in [1..5]s)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.gen_duration_at_essence == gen_essence_exposing_object_duration)
    gen_duration_at_essence_passing_object: time with:
        keep(default gen_duration_at_essence_passing_object in [2..15]s)
    gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence_passing_object: time with:
        keep(default gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence_passing_object == gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)
        
    min_distance_ego_has_to_travel: length with:
        keep(it > gen_cut_out_vehicle_distance_to_object_at_essence_start + 2*phase_essence_scenario_stopper.ego_bypassing_object_end_distance)
    min_distance_ego_has_to_travel_tolerance: length = 3 * phase_essence_scenario_stopper.ego_bypassing_object_end_distance
        
    do phase_essence: first_of:
        phase_essence_vehicle_cut_out_exposing_object: serial:
            phase_essence_exposing_object: parallel(overlap: equal):
                # Call main scenario for vehicle_cut_out 
                vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object: vehicle_cut_out(cut_out_vehicle: cut_out_vehicle,
                    road: road)

                # The stationary_object is positioned at the start of the scenario
                stationary_object_at_essence_exposing_object: stationary_object.exists_at(object_position) with:

            # This is necessary so that the ego can pass the newly exposed stationary_object 
            phase_essence_passing_object: parallel(overlap: equal):
                    drive_ego_at_essence_passing_object: sut.car.drive() with:
                        intent_ego_position_at_essence_passing_object_end: distance(min_distance_ego_has_to_travel, tolerance: min_distance_ego_has_to_travel_tolerance)
                        intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_passing_object: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    
                    drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence_passing_object: cut_out_vehicle.drive() with:
                        intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_passing_object: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                        intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_passing_object: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                        intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_avoid_collisions_at_essence_passing_object: avoid_collisions(false, run_mode: best_effort)
            with: intent_essence_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_essence_passing_object, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence_passing_object)

        phase_essence_scenario_stopper: object_scenario_stopper(object_position: object_position)
    
    on @phase_essence_exposing_object.start:
        cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.enable = false
        call cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.update_config()

    on @phase_essence_exposing_object.end:
        cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.enable = true
        call cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.update_config()
    
    in vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_object.drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence with:
        override_intent_cut_out_vehicle_lane_side_of_ego_at_essence_end: override(intent_cut_out_vehicle_lane_side_of_ego_at_essence_end, run_mode: disable)
        intent_cut_out_vehicle_change_lane_at_essence_end: change_lane(outer.number_of_lanes_to_change, side: gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end)


extend sut.vehicle_cut_out_exposing_object_test:
    # Connect @phase_scenario.phase_essence_start_event implementaton to the base event phase_essence_start_event

# sut.reconsidered_cut_out
# In this scenario, the EGO and cut_out_vehicle are traveling in the same lane. 
# The cut_out_vehicle aborts a cut-out and does cut-out to the opposite side.
#
# In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    . gen_cut_out_vehicle_change_speed_during_aborted_cut_out_phase (Speed change  
#      of cut_out_vehicle during aborted_cut_out_phase)
#    . gen_cut_out_vehicle_change_speed_during_reconsidered_cut_out_phase (Speed  
#      change of cut_out_vehicle during reconsidered_cut_out_phase)
#    . cut_out_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start (The cut_out_vehicle lateral offset  
#      at the start of the scenario)
#    . cut_out_vehicle_lat_offset_at_end (The cut_out_vehicle lateral offset  
#      at the end of the scenario)

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/vehicle_cut_out_family/vehicle_cut_out/vehicle_cut_out_top.osc"

scenario sut.reconsidered_cut_out inherits vehicle_cut_out_family_base:

    keep(default scenario_str == "reconsidered_cut_out")
    keep(cut_out_scenario_type == reconsidered_cut_out)
    # Number of lanes 
    road: one_way_road
    keep(road.min_lanes > 2)
    
    gen_duration_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out: time with:
        keep(default it in [1..6]s)

    gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out: time with:
        keep(default it == 2s)

    gen_duration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out: time with:
        keep(default it in [1..4]s)

    gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence_aborted_cut_out: time with:
        keep(default it == 2s)

    gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_relative_speed_range)
    keep(gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out >= 5kph)

    # Speed of ego at start of aborted_cut_out_phase
    gen_ego_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start: speed with:
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_speed_range)
    keep(gen_ego_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start >= 10kph)

    # Lateral distance between any point of the cut_out_vehicle that crossed \
    # the lane and the center of the lane markings.
    # Maximum values is determined to be 0.9m, where the reconsidered cut-out \
    # maneuver is successful.  
    gen_cut_out_vehicle_lat_dist_to_lane_marking_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end: length with:
        keep(default it in [0..0.9]meter)

scenario sut.reconsidered_cut_out_test inherits vehicle_cut_out_family_base_test:

    keep(default scenario_str == "reconsidered_cut_out_test")
    keep(cut_out_scenario_type == reconsidered_cut_out)

extend sut.reconsidered_cut_out:

    # Time gap between ego and cut_out_vehicle at start of \
    # aborted_cut_out_phase
    cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_aborted_cut_out_phase_start: range of time
    keep(cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_aborted_cut_out_phase_start in \
    ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)

    cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_tolerance_to_ego_at_aborted_cut_out_start: time
    keep(cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_tolerance_to_ego_at_aborted_cut_out_start == 1s)

    cut_out_vehicle_along_end_offset_at_reconsidered_cut_out: length with:
        keep(default it in [15..]m)

    # Reference line to define lateral distance 
    # Constraints to make sure the reference line of lateral distance is 
    # opposite of the aborted cut out side
    cut_out_vehicle_direction_at_essence_aborted_cut_out: line
    keep(gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end == left => \
        cut_out_vehicle_direction_at_essence_aborted_cut_out == right)
    keep(gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end == right => \
        cut_out_vehicle_direction_at_essence_aborted_cut_out == left)

    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.cut_out_scenario_type == reconsidered_cut_out)

    keep(road == vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.road)
    keep(gen_duration_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out == vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.gen_duration_at_essence)
    keep(gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out == vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)
    keep(gen_ego_speed_at_start == vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.gen_ego_speed_at_start)
    keep(gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end == vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end)
    keep(gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end == vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end)
    keep(gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start == vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start)
    keep(gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start == vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start)
    keep(gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end == vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end)

    # Connect @phase_essence.start implementaton to the base event phase_essence_start_event
    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event
    # Connect @phase_essence.end implementaton to the base event phase_essence_end_event
    on @phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event

    do phase_essence: serial():

        # The cut_out_vehicle aborts a cut-out maneuver
        phase_essence_aborted_cut_out: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start:\
                    speed(gen_ego_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start, at: start, \
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_lane_at_essence_aborted_cut_out:\
                    lane(middle: true)
            drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence_aborted_cut_out: cut_out_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out:\
                    speed(gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out, faster_than: sut.car, \
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start:\
                    position(time: cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_aborted_cut_out_phase_start, \
                        ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, time_tolerance: cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_tolerance_to_ego_at_aborted_cut_out_start, measure_by: nearest, \
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                control_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end:\
                    lateral(gen_cut_out_vehicle_lat_dist_to_lane_marking_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end, \
                        line: cut_out_vehicle_direction_at_essence_aborted_cut_out, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_aborted_cut_out:\
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            duration(gen_duration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence_aborted_cut_out)
        
        # The cut_out_vehicle reconsidered the cut-out maneuver
        vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out: vehicle_cut_out(cut_out_vehicle: cut_out_vehicle)

    in vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence with:
        override(control_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_start, run_mode: disable)
        override(intent_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start, run_mode: disable)
        override(intent_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_start, run_mode: disable)
        override(intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start, run_mode: disable)
        override(intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end, run_mode: disable)
        override(control_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end, run_mode: disable)
        override(intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end, run_mode: disable)
        override(intent_cut_out_vehicle_lane_side_of_ego_at_essence_end, run_mode: disable)
        intent_cut_out_vehicle_change_lane_side_of_ego_at_essence_end:\
            change_lane(1, gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end)
        intent_cut_out_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_end:\
            keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)

    # The aborted_cut_out_phase event
    event phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_start is @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out.start
    event phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_end is @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out.end

    var phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_started := sample(true, @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_start)
    set phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_started = false
    var phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_ended := sample(true, @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_end)
    set phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_ended = false

    event phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_active is (phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_started and \
        not phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_ended)

    # The reconsidered_cut_out_phase event
    event phase_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_end is @vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.end
    event phase_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start is @vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.start

    var phase_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_started := sample(true, \
        @phase_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start)
    set phase_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_started = false
    var phase_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_ended := sample(true, \
        @phase_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_end)
    set phase_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_ended = false

    event phase_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_active is (phase_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_started \
        and not phase_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_ended)

    var cut_out_vehicle_lat_offset_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start_measured: length
    var lane_width_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start : length
    var cut_out_vehicle_lat_dist_to_lane_marking_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start: length
    var cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out: acceleration
    var cut_out_vehicle_lat_dist_to_ego_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start: length
    var cut_out_vehicle_overlap_dist_with_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start: length 
    var cut_out_vehicle_lat_overlap_with_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start: float
    var cut_out_vehicle_overlap_dist_with_ego_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_end: length
    var cut_out_vehicle_lat_overlap_with_ego_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_end: float
    var cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start : speed
    var cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end : speed
    var cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start: speed
    var cut_out_vehicle_lane_offset_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start: length
    var cut_out_vehicle_lane_offset_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end: length
    var duration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out: time
    var duration_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out: time
    var ego_time_gap_to_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start: time
    var cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start: speed
    var cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end: speed
    var cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_end: speed
    var ego_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start: speed
    var cut_out_vehicle_speed_change_at_essence_aborted_cut_out: speed
    var cut_out_vehicle_speed_change_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_phase: speed
    var cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out: speed
    var cut_out_vehicle_lat_dist_to_lane_marking_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end: length
    var lane_width: length

    cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_collect: statistics(sample_type: acceleration, measurement: average)
    cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_collect: statistics(sample_type: speed, measurement: average)

    on @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_start:
        cut_out_vehicle_overlap_dist_with_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start = math.abs(sut.car.road_distance_to_global_coordinates(cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.global_position.coord, center, lat, lane)) - (sut.car.get_width()/2 + cut_out_vehicle.get_width()/2)
        cut_out_vehicle_lat_overlap_with_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start = (cut_out_vehicle_overlap_dist_with_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start * 100)/sut.car.get_width()
        cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start = cut_out_vehicle.state.speed
        cut_out_vehicle_lane_offset_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start = cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset
        ego_time_gap_to_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start = sut.car.get_time_gap(cut_out_vehicle)
        cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start = cut_out_vehicle.state.speed - sut.car.state.speed
        ego_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start = sut.car.state.speed
        cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_collect.add_sample(cut_out_vehicle.state.speed - sut.car.state.speed)

    on @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_active:
        cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_collect.add_sample(cut_out_vehicle.state.local_acceleration.lon)

    on @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_end:
        cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out = cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_collect.compute()
        cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end = cut_out_vehicle.state.speed
        cut_out_vehicle_speed_change_at_essence_aborted_cut_out = cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start - cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end
        cut_out_vehicle_lane_offset_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end = cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset
        duration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out = phase_essence_aborted_cut_out.duration
        cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end = cut_out_vehicle.state.speed - sut.car.state.speed
        cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_collect.add_sample(cut_out_vehicle.state.speed - sut.car.state.speed)
        cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out = cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_collect.compute()
        lane_width = map.get_lane_width(cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lane, cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lon_offset)
        if cut_out_vehicle_direction_at_essence_aborted_cut_out == left:
            cut_out_vehicle_lat_dist_to_lane_marking_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end = lane_width/2 - cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset - cut_out_vehicle.bbox.width/2
        if cut_out_vehicle_direction_at_essence_aborted_cut_out == right:
            cut_out_vehicle_lat_dist_to_lane_marking_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end = lane_width/2 + cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset - cut_out_vehicle.bbox.width/2
        
    on @phase_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start:
        cut_out_vehicle_lat_offset_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start_measured = cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset
        lane_width_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start = map.get_lane_width(cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lane, cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lon_offset)
        cut_out_vehicle_lat_dist_to_lane_marking_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start = math.abs(cut_out_vehicle_lat_offset_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start_measured) + 0.5 * (cut_out_vehicle_width-lane_width_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start)
        cut_out_vehicle_lat_dist_to_ego_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start = sut.car.road_distance_to_global_coordinates(cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.global_position.coord, center, lat, lane)
        cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start = cut_out_vehicle.state.speed

    on @phase_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_end:
        cut_out_vehicle_overlap_dist_with_ego_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_end = math.abs(sut.car.road_distance_to_global_coordinates(cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.global_position.coord, center, lat, lane)) - (sut.car.get_width()/2 + cut_out_vehicle.get_width()/2)
        cut_out_vehicle_lat_overlap_with_ego_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_end = (cut_out_vehicle_overlap_dist_with_ego_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_end * 100) /sut.car.get_width()
        cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_end = cut_out_vehicle.state.speed
        cut_out_vehicle_speed_change_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_phase = cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_start - cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out_end
        duration_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out = vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_reconsidered_cut_out.duration

extend sut.reconsidered_cut_out_test:

    # Connect @phase_scenario.phase_essence_start_event implementaton to the base event phase_essence_start_event
    on @phase_scenario.phase_essence_start_event: emit phase_essence_start_event
    # Connect @phase_scenario.phase_essence_end_event implementaton to the base event phase_essence_end_event
    on @phase_scenario.phase_essence_end_event: emit phase_essence_end_event

    do phase_test: serial():

        # invoke the default base ego warm up scenario for the cut-out family
        phase_ego_warm_up: vehicle_cut_out_family_base_ego_warm_up(cut_out_vehicle: cut_out_vehicle)

        # invoke reconsidered_cut_out scenario
        phase_scenario: reconsidered_cut_out(cut_out_vehicle: cut_out_vehicle)

        # invoke the default base post scenario for the cut-out family
        phase_post: vehicle_cut_out_family_base_post(cut_out_vehicle: cut_out_vehicle)

    keep(phase_scenario.gen_ego_speed_at_start == gen_ego_speed_at_start)
    keep(phase_scenario.gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end)
    keep(phase_scenario.gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end)
    keep(phase_scenario.gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start == gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start)
    keep(phase_scenario.gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start == gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start)
    keep(phase_scenario.gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end)

# Copyright (C) 2025 Foretellix Ltd (“Foretellix”)
# This source code file is licensed to you under Foretellix’ End User License

# limitations under the License.
extend sim_config:
    set default_tl_color = green

extend sut.aborted_vehicle_cut_out:
    
    # The cut-out vehicle junction behavior and junction entry lane 
    # behavior are disabled because the cut-out vehicle stops during
    # the maneuver execution.
    keep(cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.junction_entry_lane_behavior.enable == false)

    number_of_lanes_to_change: int with:
        keep(default it == 1)
    abort_cut_out_side: av_side
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end == left => abort_cut_out_side == right)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end == right => abort_cut_out_side == left)

    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.road == road)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.gen_duration_at_essence == gen_duration_at_essence_vehicle_cut_out)

    #The cut_out_scenario_type is being used here to avoid errors related to the checks
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.cut_out_scenario_type == aborted_cut_out)
     
    # Increased the lateral offset to achieve a close aborted cut out to the Ego's lane
    # If the 'gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end' is left use a negative offset and 
    # if it is right use a positive offset
    keep(default vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end in [-1.4..1.4]m)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end == left =>  \
        vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end in [-1.4..-1.1]m)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end == right => \
        vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end in [1.1..1.4]m)

    do phase_essence: serial():
        vehicle_cut_out_at_essence: vehicle_cut_out(cut_out_vehicle: cut_out_vehicle)
        phase_essence_aborted_cut_out: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_aborted_cut_out:\
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out:\
                    keep_speed(run_mode:best_effort)
            
            drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence_aborted_cut_out: cut_out_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_cut_out_vehicle_change_lane_at_essence_aborted_cut_out:\
                    change_lane(number_of_lanes_to_change, side: abort_cut_out_side)
                control_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end:\
                    lateral(gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_aborted_end, line: center, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_aborted_cut_out_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence_aborted_cut_out)

    in vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence with:
        override(intent_cut_out_vehicle_lane_side_of_ego_at_essence_end, run_mode: disable)
        intent_cut_out_vehicle_change_lane_side_of_ego_at_essence_end:\
            change_lane(1, gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end)

    # The phase_essence_vehicle_cut_out events
    event phase_essence_vehicle_cut_out_start is @vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.phase_essence_start_event
    event phase_essence_vehicle_cut_out_end is @vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.phase_essence_end_event

    # The phase_essence_aborted_cut_out events
    event phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_end is @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out.end
    event phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_start is @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out.start

    var phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_started := sample(true, @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_start)
    set phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_started = false
    var phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_ended := sample(true, @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_end)
    set phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_ended = false

    event phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_active is (phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_started and \
        not phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_ended)

    var cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out: acceleration
    cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_collect: statistics(sample_type: acceleration, measurement: average)

    var cut_out_vehicle_lat_distance_to_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start: length
    var cut_out_vehicle_overlap_percentage_to_ego_at_essence_vehicle_cut_out_start: float
    var cut_out_vehicle_overlap_percentage_to_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end: float
    var duration_of_essence_aborted_cut_out: time
    var cut_out_vehicle_lat_distance_to_lane_marking_at_essence_vehicle_cut_out_end: length
    var cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start: speed
    var cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end: speed
    var cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_aborted_end: length

    # CPP function for calculating the overlap percentage
    overlap_fraction: overlap_fraction

    on @phase_essence_vehicle_cut_out_start:
        call overlap_fraction.overlap_fraction(cut_out_vehicle)
        cut_out_vehicle_overlap_percentage_to_ego_at_essence_vehicle_cut_out_start = overlap_fraction.overlap_percentage

    on @phase_essence_vehicle_cut_out_end:
        cut_out_vehicle_lat_distance_to_lane_marking_at_essence_vehicle_cut_out_end = math.abs(cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset)

    on @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_start:
        cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start = cut_out_vehicle.state.speed
        cut_out_vehicle_lat_distance_to_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_start = math.abs(sut.car.road_distance_to_global_coordinates(cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.global_position.coord, center, lat, lane))

    on @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_active:
        cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_collect.add_sample(cut_out_vehicle.state.local_acceleration.lon)

    on @phase_essence_aborted_cut_out_end:
        cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end = cut_out_vehicle.state.speed
        call overlap_fraction.overlap_fraction(cut_out_vehicle)
        cut_out_vehicle_overlap_percentage_to_ego_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_end = overlap_fraction.overlap_percentage
        cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out = cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence_aborted_cut_out_collect.compute()
        duration_of_essence_aborted_cut_out = phase_essence_aborted_cut_out.duration
        cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_aborted_end = cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset

    # Since the scenario has partial lane change disable the 'no_lane_change' check
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence.check_for_lane_change == false)
    
extend sut.aborted_vehicle_cut_out_test:

    do phase_test: serial():

        # invoke the default base ego warm up scenario for the cut-out family
        phase_ego_warm_up: vehicle_cut_out_family_base_ego_warm_up(cut_out_vehicle: cut_out_vehicle)

        # invoke aborted_vehicle_cut_out scenario
        phase_scenario: aborted_vehicle_cut_out(cut_out_vehicle: cut_out_vehicle)

        # invoke the default base post scenario for the cut-out family
        phase_post: vehicle_cut_out_family_base_post(cut_out_vehicle: cut_out_vehicle)

extend sut.vehicle_cut_out_exposing_vehicle:

    var essence_phase_started := sample(true, @phase_essence_start_event)
    set essence_phase_started = false
    var essence_phase_ended := sample(true, @phase_essence_end_event)
    set essence_phase_ended = false

    event essence_phase_active is (essence_phase_started and \
        not essence_phase_ended)

        

    keep(cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.junction_entry_lane_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(exposed_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(cut_out_vehicle.ftx_driver.keep_on_driving_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(exposed_vehicle.ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == false)

    # Cut-out side for Ego at the end
    ego_cut_out_side: av_side

    event clock is (sut.car.state != null and cut_out_vehicle.state != null)

    var exposed_vehicle_rel_lon_dist_to_cut_out_vehicle: length = sample(
        exposed_vehicle.road_distance(\
        cut_out_vehicle, closest, closest, direction: lon, route_type: lane),
            @clock)

    var lane_shift_end: bool = sample( true, 
        @cut_out_vehicle.switch_lane_end)

    var ego_switch_lane_start: bool = sample( true, 
        @sut.car.switch_lane_start)

    var ego_speed_at_cut_out: speed = sample(sut.car.state.speed,
        @phase_essence_end_event)

    # Event trigger when cut_out_vehicle switch lane ends and ends
    # when the Ego starts to switch the lane.
    event ego_switch_lane_event is lane_shift_end and not ego_switch_lane_start

    # Event trigger when Ego moves ahead of exposed_vehicle(bumper to front)
    event ego_and_exposed_vehicle_at_same_lon_pos is @clock if(\
        sut.car.road_distance(exposed_vehicle, front_center, back_center, direction:lon, route_type:road)) < 0m

    var ego_and_exposed_vehicle_same_lon_pos_bool: bool = sample(\
        true, @ego_and_exposed_vehicle_at_same_lon_pos)

    # Event trigger condition:
    # 1. The Ego is in the same longitudinal position as the exposed vehicle.
    # 2. If cut_out_vehicle has passed the exposed_vehicle.
    event ego_passed_exposed_vehicle is @clock if \
       ( ego_and_exposed_vehicle_same_lon_pos_bool == true
        and exposed_vehicle_rel_lon_dist_to_cut_out_vehicle > 0m )

    # The Event checks the following:
    # 1. If Ego and exposed_vehicle are in the same lane
    # 2. The relative speed of Ego and exposed_vehicle
    # is less than 0.5mps
    event ego_following_exposed_vehicle is @ego_switch_lane_event if \
        (sut.car.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lane.index_in_road ==\
        exposed_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lane.index_in_road)and\
        math.abs(sut.car.state.speed - exposed_vehicle.state.speed) <= 0.5mps
    
    var ego_following_exposed_vehicle_time: time = sample(\
        top.time, @ego_following_exposed_vehicle)
    
    var ego_following_exposed_vehicle_bool: bool = sample(\
        true, @ego_following_exposed_vehicle)

    # Ego following exposed_vehicle and cut_out_vehicle passed exposed vehicle event
    # Checks if ego_following_exposed_vehicle_bool is true
    # Checks if ego_following_exposed_vehicle_time + 5s (buffer time to follow) is 
    # less than top.time and also if cut_out_vehicle has passed the exposed_vehicle 
    event ego_following_exposed_vehicle_event is @clock if (\
        ego_following_exposed_vehicle_bool==true and top.time\
        > (ego_following_exposed_vehicle_time + 5s) and \
        (sut.car.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lane.index_in_road ==\
        exposed_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lane.index_in_road) and\
        exposed_vehicle_rel_lon_dist_to_cut_out_vehicle > 0m )


    gen_exposed_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start: speed with: 
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_relative_speed_range)
    gen_exposed_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start_tolerance: time with:
        keep(default it == 2s)
    gen_exposed_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end_tolerance: time with:
        keep(default it == 2s)
    gen_exposed_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end: time with: 
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)

    number_of_lanes_to_change: int with:
        keep(default it == 1)
    
    # The cut_out phase duration is increased
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.gen_duration_at_essence in [5..20]s)

    # Attributing gen variables from subscenario to its father (main) scenario
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start == gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start == gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_start == gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_start)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end == gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end)
    keep(vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.road == road)

    on @vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event
    on @vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event


    # Main scenario block
    do phase_essence: first_of:

        phase_essence_exposing_vehicle: parallel(overlap: equal):
            # Call main scenario for vehicle_cut_out
            vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle: vehicle_cut_out(cut_out_vehicle: cut_out_vehicle)

            drive_exposed_vehicle_at_essence_exposing_vehicle: exposed_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_exposed_vehicle_lane_at_essence_exposing_vehicle_start: lane(same_as: sut.car, at: start)
                intent_assist_exposed_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_exposing_vehicle: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_exposed_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_exposing_vehicle_start: speed(gen_exposed_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start,
                    faster_than: sut.car, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                control_exposed_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_exposing_vehicle_start: lateral(gen_exposed_vehicle_lateral_at_essence,
                    line: center, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_exposed_vehicle_rel_position_at_essence_exposing_vehicle_start: position(time: gen_exposed_vehicle_time_gap_to_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence_start,
                    time_tolerance: gen_exposed_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start_tolerance,
                    ahead_of: cut_out_vehicle, measure_by: nearest, at: start)
                
                intent_assist_exposed_vehicle_speed_at_essence_exposing_vehicle_end: speed(gen_exposed_vehicle_speed_at_essence_end, at: end,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                control_exposed_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_exposing_vehicle_end: lateral(gen_exposed_vehicle_lateral_at_essence,
                    line: center, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_exposed_vehicle_rel_position_at_essence_exposing_vehicle_end: position(time: gen_exposed_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end,
                    ahead_of: cut_out_vehicle, measure_by: nearest, track: projected, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
    
   

        serial: 
            wait @ego_following_exposed_vehicle_event
            log_info("Ego adapted relative speed of exposed vehicle")
            log_info("cut_out_vehicle passed the exposed_vehicle after cutting out")

        serial: 
            wait @ego_passed_exposed_vehicle
            log_info("Ego passed the exposed_vehicle after changing the lane")
            log_info("cut_out_vehicle passed the exposed_vehicle after cutting out")
    
    set ego_switch_lane_start = false
    set lane_shift_end = false
    set ego_following_exposed_vehicle_bool = false
    set ego_and_exposed_vehicle_same_lon_pos_bool = false


    intent_cut_out_vehicle_drive_at_essence: in vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence with:
        override_intent_cut_out_vehicle_lane_side_of_ego_at_essence_end: override(intent_cut_out_vehicle_lane_side_of_ego_at_essence_end, run_mode: disable)
        intent_cut_out_vehicle_change_lane_at_essence_end: change_lane(outer.number_of_lanes_to_change, side: gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end)
    
    in vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.drive_ego_at_essence with:
        intent_ego_along_at_essence: along(outer.road)

    in vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_exposing_vehicle.drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence with:
        intent_cut_out_vehicle_along_at_essence: along(outer.road)

    # Metrics being sampled and registered in cover file
    var exposed_vehicle_rel_position_to_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence_start: time = sample(\
            cut_out_vehicle.get_time_gap(exposed_vehicle), @phase_essence_start_event)       
    var exposed_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start:= sample(exposed_vehicle.state.speed, \
            @phase_essence_start_event)
    var exposed_vehicle_speed_at_essence_end:= sample(exposed_vehicle.state.speed, \
            @phase_essence_end_event)
    var exposed_vehicle_lateral_at_essence:= sample(
            exposed_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset,
            @phase_essence_end_event)
    var ego_rel_dist_to_exposed_vehicle_at_phase_essence_end_event:= sample(
            sut.car.road_distance(exposed_vehicle,closest_compound,closest_compound,lon,lane), @phase_essence_end_event)
    var cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_to_exposed_vehicle_at_passing_lane_marking: time = sample(\
            cut_out_vehicle.get_time_gap(exposed_vehicle), @cut_out_vehicle_passes_lane_marking)
    


extend sut.vehicle_cut_out_family_base_ego_warm_up:
    exposed_vehicle: vehicle

    do parallel(overlap: equal):
        previous_do()

extend sut.vehicle_cut_out_exposing_vehicle_test:
    # Connect @phase_scenario.phase_essence_start_event implementaton to the base event phase_essence_start_event
    on @phase_scenario.start: emit phase_essence_start_event

        )

# Copyright (C) 2025 Foretellix Ltd (“Foretellix”)
# This source code file is licensed to you under Foretellix’ End User License
# Agreement, you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You are not allowed to distribute it to any third party without Foretellix’
# written approval.
# If you choose to modify this code (in compliance with the license terms),
# you do it at your own risk, and Foretellix will no longer supply any
# support or maintenance services for this source code.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

# To set the traffic light as green
extend sim_config:
    set default_tl_color = green

extend sut.random_object_group_crossing_street:

    on @phase_essence_objects_crossing.start: emit phase_essence_start_event
        
    crossing_random_object_group_initial_position: msp_position
    crossing_random_object_group_dest_position: msp_position

    # Offset attributes
    time_offset: time with:
        keep(it == 0.5s)
    crossing_random_object_group_movement_time_offset: time with:
        keep(it == 1s)

    # Path attributes
    ego_path: one_way_road 

    road: road_curvature with:
        keep(it.min_radius >= 20m)
    
    lane_section: lane_section

    # Constraining the lon offset with respect to Ego's speed 
    # if the gen_ego_speed_at_start is high and 
    # gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lon_offset has a lower value then
    # random_object_group will not be able to cross Ego's trajectory.
    keep(gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lon_offset < 10m => \
    gen_ego_speed_at_start < 18kph)

    # Random object group movement default duration
    crossing_random_object_group_movement_duration: time with:
        keep(default it in [2..5]s)
    

    # The crossing_random_object_group_complete_distance should always be positive so 
    # depending on side of crossing object group it is made as positive
    crossing_random_object_group_complete_distance: length with:
        keep(gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lat_offset < 0m => \
            it == -gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lat_offset)
        keep(gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lat_offset > 0m => \
            it == gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lat_offset)
        keep(gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lat_offset == 0m => \
            it == gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lat_offset)

    # Trigger time is the time at which the random object group will 
    # cross the center of the Ego's path approximately at the same time 
    # as Ego is planned to cross that point.
    # Default value is given as [2..7]s and calculated by distance/speed
    crossing_random_object_group_movement_trigger_time: time
    keep(default crossing_random_object_group_movement_trigger_time in [2..7]s)
    keep(crossing_random_object_group_complete_distance in \
        [(crossing_random_object_group_movement_trigger_time - time_offset)*\
            gen_crossing_random_object_group_speed..\
                (crossing_random_object_group_movement_trigger_time \
                    + time_offset)*gen_crossing_random_object_group_speed])

    # Sample longitudinal distance (in seconds) between Ego and random object group
    # If the Ego speed is 0kph then the time to meet Ego is infinite. 
    # So making up to this infinite time, value is given as 10000s as there
    # is no term as such as max_duration
    # If gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lon_offset < 
    # gen_crossing_random_object_group_end_lon_offset
    # then random_object_group time to meet to Ego should be 
    # calculated by start_lon_offset and vice versa
    def time_to_meet_ego()-> time is:
        var crossing_random_object_group_time_to_meet_to_ego_1: time = 10000s
        if sut.car.state != null and sut.car.state.speed != 0kph:
            if gen_crossing_random_object_group_end_lon_offset > \
            gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lon_offset:
                crossing_random_object_group_time_to_meet_to_ego_1 = \
                    ((sut.car.distance_to_point_along_path \
                    (ref_start_pos.lane_position)- \
                    sut.car.get_length()/2) / sut.car.state.speed)
            else: 
                crossing_random_object_group_time_to_meet_to_ego_1 = \
                    ((sut.car.distance_to_point_along_path \
                    (ref_end_pos.lane_position)- \
                    sut.car.get_length()/2) / sut.car.state.speed)
        return crossing_random_object_group_time_to_meet_to_ego_1
    
    # Sampling the time_to_meet_ego native method so as to
    # get crossing_random_object_group_time_to_meet_to_ego
    var crossing_random_object_group_time_to_meet_to_ego := \
    sample(time_to_meet_ego(), @top.clk)

    # To ensure that random object group is completely crossing the path of Ego
    keep(gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lat_offset < 0m => \
        gen_crossing_random_object_group_end_lat_offset in \
        [5..10]m)
    keep(gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lat_offset > 0m => \
        gen_crossing_random_object_group_end_lat_offset in \
        [-10..-5]m)
    keep(gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lat_offset == 0m => \
        gen_crossing_random_object_group_end_lat_offset in \
        [-10..-5]m)

    # To ensure that random object group is not on Egos lane at start
    keep(gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lat_offset in [-10..-2]m or \
         gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lat_offset in [2..10]m )

    # Start and end position of random object group
    ref_start_pos: msp_position
    ref_end_pos: msp_position
    random_object_group_end_pos: plain_object_group_position_params
    random_object_group_start_pos: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(it.min_distance_between_objects == 1meter)
        keep(it.max_distance_between_objects == 2meter)
    
    # Positioning of random object relative to drive_ego_at_essence_objects_crossing
    top.position_along_drive(ref_start_pos, drive_ego_at_essence_objects_crossing, 
        lon_offset: gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lon_offset, 
            lat_offset: gen_crossing_random_object_group_start_lat_offset)
    top.position_along_drive(ref_end_pos, drive_ego_at_essence_objects_crossing, 
        lon_offset: gen_crossing_random_object_group_end_lon_offset, 
            lat_offset: gen_crossing_random_object_group_end_lat_offset)

    # Positioning the group as per reference position
    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(random_object_group_start_pos, 
        random_object_group, ref_start_pos)
    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(random_object_group_end_pos, 
        random_object_group, ref_end_pos)

    # The event triggers when crossing_random_object_group_time_to_meet_to_ego < 
    # crossing_random_object_group_movement_trigger_time
    event crossing_random_object_group_trigger_movement_event is @top.clk if \
        (crossing_random_object_group_time_to_meet_to_ego < \
            crossing_random_object_group_movement_trigger_time)
            
    # Ego reached the crossing_random_object_group distance parameter
    # When the ego's rear is at exactly same as crossing random object front
    # periphery assuming crossing random object is placed at 0 degree yaw
    # the method 'distance_to_point_along_path' gives a distance equal to
    # 'sut.car.compound_object.get_length()/2 + crossing_random_object.get_length()/2'.
    # So using the same distance as reference to make sure that ego has passed the  
    # random object group's position 
    ego_scenario_ends_distance: length
    keep(ego_scenario_ends_distance == -1*(sut.car.compound_object.get_length()/2))
    
    # Conditional event to check if VUT stopped completely
    event vut_stand_still is @clock if sut.car.is_standing_still() == true \
        and sut.car.prev_state.speed > 0kph
    
    # Wait time for VUT after vut_stand_still
    time_delay: time 
    keep(default time_delay == 5s)

    var vut_stand_still_time: time = sample(top.time, @vut_stand_still)
    var vut_stand_still_bool: bool = sample(true, @vut_stand_still)
    set vut_stand_still_bool = false
    event vut_stopped is @clock if (vut_stand_still_bool == true and top.time \
        > (vut_stand_still_time+time_delay))

    var vut_stand_still_with_delay: bool = sample(true, @vut_stopped)
    set vut_stand_still_with_delay = false

    distance_offset: length
    keep( default distance_offset == 20m)

    # The random_object_group_movement_end_time samples the time when the
    # random object group stop moving (the end of its movement).
    var random_object_group_movement_end_time: bool = sample(
        true ,@crossing_random_object_group_movement.end)

    # Event is triggered if the start position is greater than end position
    event random_object_group_start_pos_is_greater_than_end_pos_event is @start\
        if ((sut.car.distance_to_point_along_path(ref_start_pos.lane_position))\
         > (sut.car.distance_to_point_along_path(\
        ref_end_pos.lane_position)))

    var random_object_group_start_pos_is_greater_than_end_pos: bool = sample(
        true, @random_object_group_start_pos_is_greater_than_end_pos_event)
    set random_object_group_start_pos_is_greater_than_end_pos = false

    # The random object group moves diagonally as well, considering end 
    # and start positions of the random group.If the start position is greater
    # than end position then the start position value is compared with 
    # ego_scenario_ends_distance.The distance_offset and Ego's half length is 
    # added to make sure scenario won't stop when Ego is at start or end position
    # when the random object group travels straight. 
    var ego_rel_distance_from_object_pos_cal: length
    on @top.clk:
        if (random_object_group_start_pos_is_greater_than_end_pos == true):   
            ego_rel_distance_from_object_pos_cal = (sut.car.distance_to_point_along_path(
            ref_start_pos.lane_position) + distance_offset + (sut.car.get_length()/2))  
        else:
            ego_rel_distance_from_object_pos_cal = (sut.car.distance_to_point_along_path(
            ref_end_pos.lane_position) + distance_offset + (sut.car.get_length()/2))

    # Event to check if the Ego passed crossing random object and the vru's 
    # destination position, both the condition are synced to the distance 
    # parameter 'ego_scenario_ends_distance' and if the random object group
    # reached the end position or if the Ego is on stand still.
    event scenario_ends is @clock if (vut_stand_still_with_delay == true or \
        ego_rel_distance_from_object_pos_cal < ego_scenario_ends_distance \
        and random_object_group_movement_end_time == true)

    # Main do of the scenario is of 'first_of' configuration
    
    do phase_essence: first_of: 

        phase_essence_objects_crossing: parallel(start_to_start: 0s, overlap: any):
            # The Ego starts moving with the speed specified by gen_ego_speed_at_start. 
            # A random object group appears at a given lat and lon offset 
            # of the Ego and crosses the lane at gen_crossing_random_object_group_speed.
            drive_ego_at_essence_objects_crossing: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_objects_crossing_start: speed(
                    gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_objects_crossing: keep_lane(
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_objects_crossing: keep_speed(
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                # The end offset is taken as [70..] meter as the Ego's  
                # longitudinal distance to random object group is [1..100] meter
                #  and the group is placed at the crossing phase. So if Ego 
                # starts by [20..40]kph (max start speed of Ego) in 5s
                # (min duration without tolerance) to avoid placement of 
                # random object group at lane ending tolerance of 20m is taken
                intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_objects_crossing_start: along(lane_section, 
                    end_offset: [70..]m, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_along_ego_path_at_essence_objects_crossing: along(
                    ego_path, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_along_road_at_essence_objects_crossing: along(
                    road, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_essence_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_essence, 
                tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)

            # In this phase the random object group waits for a event to appear and then
            # it crosses the path of Ego.
            crossing_random_object_group_at_essence_objects_crossing: serial():
                wait @crossing_random_object_group_trigger_movement_event
                crossing_random_object_group_movement: random_object_group.group_move(
                    random_object_group_end_pos,
                    start_position_params: random_object_group_start_pos, 
                    duration: [crossing_random_object_group_movement_duration - \
                        crossing_random_object_group_movement_time_offset..crossing_random_object_group_movement_duration + \
                        crossing_random_object_group_movement_time_offset])
        
        # Scenario stopping event is passed here to wait
        # Once the event occurs, the scenario stops.
        phase_essence_scenario_stopper: serial:
            wait @scenario_ends
            log_info("Ending scenario since Ego drive passed crossing random object group")

extend sut.random_object_group_crossing_street_main:
    do phase_main: serial:
        phase_ego_warm_up: interfering_object_family_base_ego_warm_up()
        phase_essence: random_object_group_crossing_street()
        phase_post: interfering_object_family_base_post()

    # Cut in vehicle attributes

# Copyright (C) 2025 Foretellix Ltd (“Foretellix”)
# This source code file is licensed to you under Foretellix’ End User License
# Agreement, you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.

# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

# Traffic lights to be green always
extend sim_config:
    set default_tl_color = green

extend sut.non_smooth_vehicle_cut_in:

    event phase_post_non_smooth_cut_in_end_event is @phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in.end

    on @phase_post_non_smooth_cut_in_end_event:
        cut_in_vehicle_swirling_amplitude = cut_in_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max.compute() - cut_in_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_min.compute()

    # Hint for the solver - [0..100]kph
    # This variable should be consistent with
    # gen_ego_speed_at_start in [0..100]kph
    # cut_in_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start in [-10..10]kph
    # So as to satisfy
    #     cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start: speed with:
    #          keep(default it in
    #             [gen_ego_speed_at_start..
    #                 gen_ego_speed_at_start + cut_in_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start])
    keep(default gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)

    var phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_start: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in.start)
    var phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_end: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in.end)
    event phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_active is phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_start and not phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_end
    event phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_start_event is @phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in.start
    event phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_end_event is @phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in.end


    # Checking the starting time periofd and ending time period of swirling
    var swirling_drive_start : bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_start_event)
    event swirling_period_sample is @top.clk if (not phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_end and \ 
        swirling_drive_start and cut_in_vehicle.prev_state != null)
    var lat_count : int = 10
    var prev_cycle_time : time
    var start_time : time = sample(top.time, @phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_start_event)
    var first_adjusted_lat_offset: length
    def reached_lane_count_record() is:
        # Offset used to ensure negative lateral offsets are avoided
        const avoid_negative_lat_offset : length = 10m
        const lat_offset_tolerance : length = 0.01m
        var current_lat_value : length = cut_in_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
        var previous_lat_value : length = cut_in_vehicle.prev_state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
        if lat_count == 10: 
            first_adjusted_lat_offset = cut_in_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
            lat_count = 0
            
        if lat_count == 0 and  math.abs(first_adjusted_lat_offset-current_lat_value) >= lat_offset_tolerance: 
            if current_lat_value > first_adjusted_lat_offset:
                lat_count = -1
            if current_lat_value < first_adjusted_lat_offset:
                lat_count = 1
        else:   
            if lat_count == 1 and current_lat_value > previous_lat_value:
                    # The first peak occurs at four times the period
                    cut_in_vehicle_swirling_period  = 4*(top.time - start_time)
                    swirling_drive_start = false  
            elif lat_count == -1 and current_lat_value < previous_lat_value:
                    # The first peak occurs at four times the period
                    cut_in_vehicle_swirling_period  = 4*(top.time - start_time)
                    swirling_drive_start = false

    on @swirling_period_sample:
        call reached_lane_count_record()

    cut_in_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max: statistics(sample_type: length, 
        measurement: maximum)
    cut_in_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_min: statistics(sample_type: length, 
        measurement: minimum)

    on @phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_active:
        cut_in_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max.add_sample(cut_in_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset)
        cut_in_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_min.add_sample(cut_in_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset)

    # Lane section
    lane_section: lane_section

    # Shape for non smooth cut in. The shape tries to make a swirl, cut in
    # vehicle moves from adjacent lane to Ego's lane line and comes
    # back to the cut in vehicle start lane depending on lateral offset
    lateral_shift_shape: lateral_shift_shape with:
        keep(it.transform == lane_relative)
        keep(it.swirl_vehicle == cut_in_vehicle)
        keep(it.lat_offset == gen_cut_in_vehicle_swirling_amplitude)
        keep(it.sin_period == non_smooth_cut_in_duration_based_on_side)
        keep(it.sin_wave_intensity_value_cpp == 1.0)
        keep(it.power_value_cpp == 500.0)
        keep(it.width_value_cpp == 1.5)

    # Reducing lateral and longitudinal collision sensitivity of cut_in_vehicle
    keep(cut_in_vehicle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lat
        == 0.1)
    keep(cut_in_vehicle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon
        == 1meter)

    do phase_essence: serial():

        # The cut in vehicle with the help of shape swirls
        # towards the Ego lane and comes back to its start lane
        # Ego drives keeping same lane
        phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_non_smooth_cut_in: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_start: speed(
                    gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_along_at_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_start: along(lane_section, 
                    end_offset: non_smooth_cut_in_default_end_offset, at: start)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_non_smooth_cut_in: keep_lane(
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_non_smooth_cut_in: keep_speed(
                    run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_essence_non_smooth_cut_in: cut_in_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_start: speed(
                    gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                control_cut_in_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_start: lateral(cut_in_vehicle_lateral_distance, 
                    line: center, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_cut_in_vehicle_lane_at_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_start: lane(
                    side_of: sut.car, side: gen_cut_in_side, at: start)
                intent_cut_in_vehicle_along_at_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_start: along(
                    lane_section, end_offset: non_smooth_cut_in_default_end_offset, at: start)
                intent_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_at_phase_essence_non_smooth_cut_in_start: position(
                    time: gen_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_start,
                    time_tolerance: default_time_offset, ahead_of: sut.car, 
                    measure_by: nearest, at: start)
                intent_cut_in_vehicle_shape_at_essence_non_smooth_cut_in: shape(
                    quantity: position, request: both,
                    shape_object: lateral_shift_shape)

        phase_essence_cut_in: vehicle_cut_in(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle, 
            gen_cut_in_lane: gen_cut_in_lane,
            gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end: gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end)
    # Check whether the Ego started to change lanes after the cut_in_vehicle
    # started to change lanes and log this info
    var cut_in_vehicle_lane_change_start: bool = sample(true, 
        @clock if cut_in_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset < 0m)

    event ego_lane_change_start is @sut.car.switch_lane_start
    event ego_lane_change_after_cut_in_vehicle is @ego_lane_change_start\
        if cut_in_vehicle_lane_change_start 

    on @ego_lane_change_after_cut_in_vehicle: 
        call logger.log_info("Ego started to change lanes after the " +
            "cut_in_vehicle started to change lanes")


extend sut.vehicle_cut_in:
    override_intent_ego_speed_at_essence: override(intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence, run_mode: disable)
    in drive_ego_at_essence with:
        keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_intent_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_essence_end: override(intent_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_essence_end, run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_cut_in_vehicle_side_at_essence_start: override(intent_cut_in_vehicle_side_at_essence_start, run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_essence_start: override(intent_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_essence_start, run_mode: disable)
  
extend sut.non_smooth_vehicle_cut_in_test:
    on @phase_post.start:
       emit post_phase_at_start_event

    on @phase_post.end:
        emit post_phase_at_end_event

    on @phase_scenario.phase_essence_cut_in.start:
        emit cut_in_phase_start_event
    
    do phase_test: serial():

        phase_ego_warm_up: vehicle_cut_in_base_ego_warm_up(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle)

        phase_scenario: non_smooth_vehicle_cut_in(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle)

        phase_post: vehicle_cut_in_base_post(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle)
