extend sut.vehicle_cut_in_and_person_crossing_with_obstructing_vehicle:

    event phase_essence_crossing_person_moves_event_start is @phase_essence_crossing_person_moves.start
    event phase_essence_crossing_person_moves_event_end is @phase_essence_crossing_person_moves.end


    var obstructing_stationary_vehicle_global_yaw: angle
    var crossing_person_global_yaw: angle
    var relative_angle: angle
    on @phase_essence_cut_in_event_start:
        if cut_in_vehicle.road_distance(sut.car, center, center, lat, lane) > 0m:
            cut_in_vehicle_side = right
        if cut_in_vehicle.road_distance(sut.car, center, center, lat, lane) < 0m:
            cut_in_vehicle_side = left

    on @start:

        obstructing_stationary_vehicle_category = obstructing_stationary_vehicle.vehicle_category
        cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_start = cut_in_vehicle.get_time_gap(sut.car)
        
        obstructing_stationary_vehicle_global_yaw = obstructing_stationary_vehicle.state.global_position.rotation.yaw
        crossing_person_global_yaw = crossing_person.state.global_position.rotation.yaw
        relative_angle = obstructing_stationary_vehicle_global_yaw - crossing_person_global_yaw

        if relative_angle < 0deg:
            crossing_person_rel_angle_to_road = math.abs(relative_angle + 180deg)
        if relative_angle > 0deg:
            crossing_person_rel_angle_to_road = math.abs(relative_angle - 180deg)

    on @phase_essence_crossing_person_moves_event_start:
        if sut.car.road_distance(crossing_person, center, center, lat, lane) < 0m:
            crossing_person_side = right
        if sut.car.road_distance(crossing_person, center, center, lat, lane) > 0m:
            crossing_person_side = left

    on @phase_essence_crossing_person_moves_event_end:
        crossing_person_move_speed = crossing_person.state.speed

    # This event uses distance_to_point_along_path to retrieve 
    # the distance from the cut_in_vehicle's current 
    # position to the crossing_person position ahead on the path
    event cut_in_vehicle_close_by is cut_in_vehicle.distance_to_point_along_path(
        crossing_person_start_position.lane_position) < move_trigger_distance_to_cut_in_vehicle

    # This event uses distance_to_point_along_path to retrieve 
    # the distance from the EGO's current 
    # position to the crossing_person position ahead on the path
    event ego_close_by is @top.clk if(sut.car.state.speed>0kph) and map.abs_distance_between_positions(
        sut.car.state.msp_pos.road_position,
        crossing_person_start_position.road_position)/(
        sut.car.state.speed)< time_to_crossing_person_move_start      

    obstructing_stationary_vehicle_position : msp_position

    crossing_person_start_position : msp_position

    crossing_person_end_position : msp_position 

    # Specified crossing_person start position and to be on 
    # the drive_ego_at_essence_cut_in path where a drive() occurs
    position_along_drive(crossing_person_start_position ,
        drive_ego_at_essence_crossing_person_moves, 
        lon_offset : crossing_person_start_lon_offset,
        lat_offset : crossing_person_start_lat_offset)

    # Calculated 'crossing_person_end_position' based on 
    # 'crossing_person_move_yaw' and 'move_ref*crossing_person_move_distance'
    # 1) crossing_person_move_yaw -This gives angle at which the 
    #  msp_pos should be located
    # 2) move_ref*crossing_person_move_distance - This gives distance 
    #  at which the 'crossing_person_end_position' is located from 
    #  'crossing_person_start_position'. And 'move_ref' makes the msp pos 
    #  to be relative to drive_ego_at_essence_cut_in      
    keep(crossing_person_end_position == 
        crossing_person_start_position.at_rotated_offset(
        offset :move_ref * crossing_person_move_distance, 
        yaw : crossing_person_move_yaw))

    # Specified obstructing_stationary_vehicle position and to be on 
    # the drive_ego_at_essence_cut_in path where a drive() occurs
    position_along_drive(obstructing_stationary_vehicle_position,
        drive_ego_at_essence_crossing_person_moves,
        lon_offset : obstructing_stationary_vehicle_lon_offset,
        lat_offset : obstructing_stationary_vehicle_lat_offset)

    # Constraining "crossing_person_start_lat_offset",
    # "obstructing_stationary_vehicle_lat_offset",
    # "move_ref" and "crossing_person_move_yaw".
    # If gen_crossing_person_side is left crossing_person_start_lat_offset will be [3..3.5]m
    # and obstructing_stationary_vehicle_lat_offset will be 3m and vice versa for if
    # gen_crossing_person_side is right .And crossing_person_move_yaw will [100..130]deg if 
    # gen_crossing_person_side is left and [60..90]deg if gen_crossing_person_side is right.
    keep(gen_crossing_person_side == left => 
        (crossing_person_start_lat_offset in [3..3.5]m and 
        obstructing_stationary_vehicle_lat_offset == 3.5m and move_ref == -1 and 
        crossing_person_move_yaw == gen_crossing_person_rel_angle_to_road))

    keep(gen_crossing_person_side == right => 
        (crossing_person_start_lat_offset in [-3.5..-3]m and
        obstructing_stationary_vehicle_lat_offset == -3.5m and move_ref == 1 and 
        crossing_person_move_yaw==(gen_crossing_person_rel_angle_to_road - 40deg)))
    
    # The bypass behavior interputs the ability to do aggressive cutins
    keep (cut_in_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)   
    
    do phase_essence: serial():

        # . The cut_in_vehicle cuts in between Ego and the lead_vehicle
        # . The cut_in_vehicle changes lane at the end ofphase_essence_cut_in
        # . The cut_in_vehicle end position at phase_essence_cut_in is
        #   cut_in_vehicle_distance_to_ego_at_phase_essence_cut_in_end ahead of Ego
        # . The lead_vehicle end position at phase_essence_cut_in is 
        #   lead_vehicle_distance_to_ego_at_phase_essence_cut_in_end ahead of Ego 
        phase_essence_cut_in : parallel(overlap : equal):
        # vehicle cut in scenario
            vehicle_cut_in_at_essence: vehicle_cut_in(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle,
            gen_cut_in_side: gen_cut_in_vehicle_side,
            gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start: gen_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_start,
            gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end: cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_cut_in_phase_end)


            drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_cut_in : lead_vehicle.drive() with :
                intent_lead_vehicle_lane_at_essence_cut_in: \
                    lane(same_as : sut.car)
                intent_lead_vehicle_relative_position_at_essence_cut_in_end:\
                    position(lead_vehicle_distance_to_ego_at_cut_in_phase_end,
                        ahead_of : sut.car,
                        at : end, tolerance : lead_vehicle_distance_tolerance_to_ego_at_cut_in_phase_end)   
        with :
            intent_essence_cut_in_duration: duration(cut_in_phase_duration , tolerance : phase_time_tolerance)       

        # . Ego , cut_in_vehicle and the lead_vehicle will drive further
        # . The cut_in_vehicle_close_by event is trigger after 
        #   cut_in_vehicle pass the crossing_person
        # . The ego_close_by event is trigger after Ego 
        #   relative time distance to crossing_person is 
        #   time_to_crossing_person_move_start
        # . Then crossing_person starts moving by blocking Ego path and
        #   ends at predefined position
        phase_essence_crossing_person_moves : parallel(overlap : equal):

            drive_ego_at_essence_crossing_person_moves : sut.car.drive() with :
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_crossing_person_moves:\
                    speed(ego_speed_after_cut_in,run_mode : best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_crossing_person_moves:\
                    keep_lane(run_mode : best_effort)


            drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_crossing_person_moves: cut_in_vehicle.drive() with :
                intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_crossing_person_moves:\
                    speed(cut_in_vehicle_speed_after_cut_in,run_mode : best_effort)
                intent_cut_in_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_crossing_person_moves:\
                    keep_lane()

            drive_lead_vehicle_at_crossing_person_moves: lead_vehicle.drive() with :
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_crossing_person_moves:\
                    speed(lead_vehicle_speed_after_cut_in ,run_mode : best_effort)

                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_crossing_person_moves:\
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    
            obstructing_stationary_vehicle_place_at_crossing_person_moves : obstructing_stationary_vehicle.exists_at(
                obstructing_stationary_vehicle_position) 
                    
            crossing_person_placement : serial():
                wait@cut_in_vehicle_close_by
                wait@ego_close_by
                move : crossing_person.move(crossing_person_end_position,
                    duration : crossing_person_move_duration, 
                    start_position : crossing_person_start_position)     

    in vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_essence with:
        intent_assist_lane_at_essence_end: lane(same_as : sut.car, at : end, run_mode : best_effort)
    override_intent_assist_lead_vehicle_relative_position_at_essence_cut_in_end: \
        override(intent_lead_vehicle_relative_position_at_essence_cut_in_end, run_mode: best_effort)

    keep(gen_cut_in_side == vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.gen_cut_in_side)
    keep(gen_duration_at_essence == vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.gen_duration_at_essence)
    keep(gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence == vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)
    keep(gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start == vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start)
    keep(gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start == vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start)
    keep(gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start == vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start)
    keep(gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end == vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end)
    keep(gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_end == vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_end)

# cuts-in from has traffic that can be non-slow moving (speed > 5kmph).

#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    . gen_ego_speed_at_start (the speed of ego)
#    . cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_cut_in_end (the speed of cut_in_vehicle
#          at the end of cut-in) 
#    . cut_in_side (the side from which vehicle cuts-in)

#          adjacent_lane_traffic vehicles)
#    . number_of_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicles (number of vehicles forming the
#          adjacent_lane_traffic)
#    . cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start (The lateral offset
#          of cut_in_vehicle during the init_drive phase)
#    . gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_end (lateral offset of the
#      cut_in_vehicle at end)

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/vehicle_cut_in/vehicle_cut_in/vehicle_cut_in_top.osc"
scenario sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic inherits vehicle_cut_in_family_base:

    keep(default scenario_str == "vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic")
    # Adjacent lane traffic group attributes
    event cut_in_phase_start_event
    # Vehicle's form the initial part of the adjacent_lane_traffic
    # to enable the cut-in maneuver
    adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1: vehicle
    adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2: vehicle

    # Car group definition
    adjacent_lane_traffic: single_lane_car_group with(
        reference_car: cut_in_vehicle) 

    # Speed of the adjacent_lane_traffic vehicles
    adjacent_lane_traffic_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    var actual_speed_of_adjacent_lane_traffic: speed

    # Time gap between vehicles in the car group
    gen_time_gap_between_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicles: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_other_vehicle)
    var time_gap_between_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicles: time

    default_time_offset: time with:
        keep(default it == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_time_offset)

    cut_in_vehicle_approach_time_gap: range of length with:
        keep(default it in [15..20]m)

    cut_in_out_of_traffic_default_end_offset: range of length with:
        keep(default it in [50..]m)

    cut_in_vehicle_lateral_tolerance: length with:
        keep(default it == 1m)

    # Number of vehicles in the car group
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic.start.number_of_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicles", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic.start.gen_number_of_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicles")
    gen_number_of_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicles: int with:
        keep(default it in [4..10])
    var number_of_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicles: int
        
    # Subtracting 2 since we have used 2 Vehicle's which would be a 
    # part of the adjacent_lane_traffic
    keep(adjacent_lane_traffic.cars.size() == 
        gen_number_of_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicles-2)
    keep(adjacent_lane_traffic.cars.size() in [2..8])

    # Attributes of cut_in_vehicle which is a part of the adjacent_lane_traffic
    # cut_in_vehcile being a part of the traffic 
    # has the same speed as the traffic vehicles
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic.phase_essence_cut_in_end.cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_cut_in_end", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic.start.gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_cut_in_end")
    gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_cut_in_end: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    var cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_cut_in_end: speed

    # Traffic side relative to Ego
    # It is same as 'gen_cut_in_side'
    traffic_side: av_side
    keep(traffic_side == gen_cut_in_side)

    # Road element
    road: one_way_road with:
        keep(it.min_lanes >=2)
        
scenario sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic_ego_warm_up:
    cut_in_vehicle: vehicle
    adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1: vehicle
    adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2: vehicle

    # Car group definition
    adjacent_lane_traffic: single_lane_car_group with(
        reference_car: cut_in_vehicle) 

scenario sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic_post:

    adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2: vehicle

    adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2: vehicle

import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/ftx/ftx_group_driver_model.osc"

extend top.main:

    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon 
        == 1meter)
    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lat
        == 0.1)
    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.min_safety_speed_lon

extend sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic_ego_warm_up:

    gen_ego_speed_at_start : speed with:
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_speed_range)

    driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model
    for car in adjacent_lane_traffic.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == driver_model)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon

    # Road element

        keep(it.min_lanes >=2)
    lane_section: lane_section

    do phase_warm_up: parallel(overlap: equal):
        drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_warm_up: vehicle_cut_in_base_ego_warm_up(

        drive_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1_at_warm_up: vehicle_cut_in_base_ego_warm_up(
            cut_in_vehicle: adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1)
        drive_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2_at_warm_up: vehicle_cut_in_base_ego_warm_up(
            cut_in_vehicle: adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2)
        adjacent_lane_traffic.group_drive()

extend sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic_post:

    # Road element
    road: one_way_road with:
        keep(it.min_lanes >=2)
    driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model
    for car in adjacent_lane_traffic.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == driver_model)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon 
            == 0.8meter)

    keep(drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_post.gen_duration_at_post in [5..10]s)
    in drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_post.drive_ego_at_post with:
        intent_assist_ego_along_at_post: along(outer.road, 
            run_mode: best_effort)
        intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)

    do phase_post: parallel(overlap: equal):
        drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_post: vehicle_cut_in_base_post(
            cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle)
        drive_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1_at_post: vehicle_cut_in_base_post(
            cut_in_vehicle: adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1)
        drive_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2_at_post: vehicle_cut_in_base_post(
            cut_in_vehicle: adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2)
        adjacent_lane_traffic.group_drive()

extend sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic:
    duration_at_essence_approach: time with:
        keep(default it in [1..10]s)

    duration_tolerance_at_essence_approach: time with:
        keep(it == 10s)
    on @start:
        number_of_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicles = adjacent_lane_traffic.cars.size() + 2
    
    on @phase_essence_cut_in.end:
        cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_cut_in_end = cut_in_vehicle.state.speed

    #Sampling the speed of adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1
    on @start: actual_speed_of_adjacent_lane_traffic= adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1.state.speed

    driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model
    for car in adjacent_lane_traffic.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == driver_model)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon 
            == 0.8meter)

    # Speed of the driver model for the adjacent traffic
    keep(driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(default driver_model.target_speed == adjacent_lane_traffic_speed)
    keep(default driver_model.change_lane_eagerness == 0)

    # Initial speed and distance between vehicles of the adjacent traffic
    for member in adjacent_lane_traffic.members_params:
        keep(member.initial_speed_percentage == 0)
        keep(member.lon_distance in [5..30]m) 
     
    lane_section: lane_section

    # Parameters to reduce the sensitivity of the collision avoidance of the 
    # cut_in_vehicle 
    keep(cut_in_vehicle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.\
        safety_distance_lon == 0.8meter)
    keep(cut_in_vehicle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.\
        safety_distance_lat == 0.2)
    keep(cut_in_vehicle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.\
        min_safety_speed_lon == 3kph)

    override_intent_essence_duration: override(vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.intent_essence_duration, 
        run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_ego_speed_at_essence: override(vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence,
        run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_ego_along_at_essence_end: override(
        vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_end, run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: override(
        vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence, run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_cut_in_vehicle_side_at_essence_start: override(
        vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.intent_cut_in_vehicle_side_at_essence_start, run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_cut_in_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start: override(
        vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start, run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_essence_end: override(
        vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.intent_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_essence_end, run_mode: best_effort)

    in vehicle_cut_in_at_essence.drive_ego_at_essence with:
        intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
        intent_ego_along_at_essence: along(outer.road, 
            run_mode: best_effort)
    do phase_essence: serial():
        phase_essence_approach: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_approach: sut.car.drive() with:
                # Added one_way_road to avoid junction
                intent_ego_along_at_essence_approach: along(road)
                intent_ego_along_at_essence_approach_start: along(lane_section, 
                    end_offset: cut_in_out_of_traffic_default_end_offset, at: start)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_approach: keep_speed(
                    run_mode: best_effort) 
                intent_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_approach: keep_lane()
            drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_essence_approach: cut_in_vehicle.drive() with:
                # Position the vehicle, providing enough space for 
                # the cut-in maneuver 
                intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_approach_start: position(
                    cut_in_vehicle_approach_time_gap, behind: adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2, 
                    at: start, measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_cut_in_vehicle_lane_at_essence_approach_start: lane(
                    side_of: sut.car, 
                    side: traffic_side, at: start)
                intent_cut_in_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_approach: keep_lane()
                intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_essence_approach_start: speed(
                    adjacent_lane_traffic_speed, 
                    run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
                intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_approach: keep_speed(
                    run_mode: best_effort) 
                control_cut_in_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_approach: lateral(
                    gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start, 
                    tolerance: cut_in_vehicle_lateral_tolerance)
            drive_adjacent_vehicle_1_at_essence_approach: adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                # Added one_way_road to avoid junction
                intent_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1_along_at_essence_approach_start: along(
                    lane_section, end_offset: cut_in_out_of_traffic_default_end_offset, at: start)
                intent_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1_lane_at_essence_approach_start: lane(
                    side_of: sut.car, side: traffic_side, at: start)
                intent_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1_keep_lane_at_essence_approach: keep_lane()
                intent_assist_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1_speed_at_essence_approach_start: speed(
                    adjacent_lane_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_adjacent_vehicle_2_at_essence_approach: adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                # Added one_way_road to avoid junction
                intent_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2_time_gap_at_essence_approach_start: position(
                    time: gen_time_gap_between_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicles, 
                    behind: adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1, at: start, 
                    measure_by: nearest, time_tolerance: default_time_offset)
                intent_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2_lane_at_essence_approach_start: lane(
                    side_of: sut.car, side: traffic_side, at: start)
                intent_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2_keep_lane_at_essence_approach: keep_lane()
                intent_assist_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2_speed_at_essence_approach: speed(
                    adjacent_lane_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
            adjacent_lane_traffic.group_drive()
        with:
            intent_essence_approach_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_approach, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_approach)
        # In this phase the cut_in_vehicle pulls into ego's lane ahead of it.
        phase_essence_cut_in: parallel(overlap: equal):
            vehicle_cut_in_at_essence: vehicle_cut_in(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle,gen_cut_in_lane: gen_cut_in_lane,
                gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start: gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start,
                gen_cut_in_side: gen_cut_in_side,
                gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start: gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start,
                gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end: gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end)
            drive_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1_at_essence: adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                # Added one_way_road to avoid junction
                intent_assist_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1_speed_at_essence_cut_in: speed(
                    adjacent_lane_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_1_keep_lane_at_essence_cut_in: keep_lane()
            drive_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2_at_essence: adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                 # Added one_way_road to avoid junction
                intent_assist_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2_speed_at_essence_cut_in: speed(
                    adjacent_lane_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_adjacent_lane_traffic_vehicle_2_keep_lane_at_essence_cut_in: keep_lane()
            adjacent_lane_traffic.group_drive()
        with:
            intent_essence_cut_in_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_essence, 
                tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)

# sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base
# This scenario consists of the common parameters, coverage and KPI's of the 
# cut_in scenario family
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/common/scenarios/generic_base_scenario/generic_base_scenario_top.osc"

enum cut_in_variant: [vehicle_cut_in, aborted_cut_in, non_smooth_cut_in,
    cut_in_out_of_traffic, double_cut_in]

scenario sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base inherits generic_base_scenario:

    keep(default scenario_str == "vehicle_cut_in_family_base")

    cut_in_vehicle: vehicle   
    # The variant of the cut_in scenario family
    cut_in_variant: cut_in_variant

    # The side from which vehicle cut's in 
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base.cut_in_start.cut_in_side", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base.start.gen_cut_in_side")
    gen_cut_in_side: av_side with:
        keep(default it in [left,right])
    var cut_in_side: av_side

    gen_cut_in_lane: av_side
    keep(gen_cut_in_side == left => gen_cut_in_lane == right)
    keep(gen_cut_in_side == right => gen_cut_in_lane == left)
    var cut_in_lane: av_side
    
    # The initial speed of cut_in_vehicle
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base.phase_essence_start_event.cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base.start.gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start")
    gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start: speed
    keep(default gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start in 
    [gen_ego_speed_at_start..
        gen_ego_speed_at_start + gen_cut_in_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start])
    # keep(default gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    var cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start: speed = sample(cut_in_vehicle.state.speed, @start if cut_in_vehicle.state != null)

    # The time gap between cut_in_vehicle and Ego at the start of change lane phase
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base.cut_in_start.ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base.start.gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start")
    gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)
    var ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start: time = sample(sut.car.get_time_gap(cut_in_vehicle), @cut_in_start)

    # The time gap between cut_in_vehicle and Ego at the end of change lane phase
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base.cut_in_end.ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base.start.gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end")
    gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)
    var ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end: time = sample(sut.car.get_time_gap(cut_in_vehicle), @cut_in_end)

    # Lateral offset of the cut_in_vehicle at start of the scenario
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base.cut_in_start.cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base.start.gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start")
    gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start: length with:
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_lateral_lane_pos)
    var cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start: length = sample(cut_in_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset, @start if cut_in_vehicle.state != null)

    # Lateral offset of the cut_in_vehicle at end of the scenario
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base.finish.cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_end", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_cut_in_family_base.start.gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_end")
    gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_end: length with:
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_lateral_lane_pos)
    var cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_end: length = sample(cut_in_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset, @end if cut_in_vehicle.state != null)

    gen_cut_in_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start: speed with:
        keep(default it in [-10..10]kph)

struct slow_to_stop_shape inherits any_position_shape:
    deceleration: acceleration
    stopping_vehicle: vehicle
    keep (transform == lane_relative)

    def duration()-> time is only external cpp("duration", "vehicle_cut_in_and_stop_shape.so")
    def compute() is only external cpp("compute", "vehicle_cut_in_and_stop_shape.so")

extend sut.vehicle_cut_in_and_stop:
    
    do phase_essence: serial():

        # vehicle cut in scenario 
        phase_essence_cut_in: vehicle_cut_in(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle, 
            gen_cut_in_side: cut_in_side, kind: self.kind,
            has_stationary_object: self.has_stationary_object)

        # Phase essence slow to stop
        phase_essence_slow_to_stop: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_slow_to_stop: sut.car.drive() 
            drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_essence_slow_to_stop: cut_in_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_lane_same_as_ego_at_essence_slow_to_stop:\
                    lane(same_as: sut.car,run_mode: best_effort) 
                intent_cut_in_vehicle_shape_at_essence_slow_to_stop:\
                    shape(quantity: position, request: both, shape_object: slow_to_stop_shape)
                avoid_collisions(false)

    keep(gen_cut_in_side == phase_essence_cut_in.gen_cut_in_side)
    keep(gen_duration_at_essence == phase_essence_cut_in.gen_duration_at_essence)
    keep(gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence == phase_essence_cut_in.gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)
    keep(gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start == phase_essence_cut_in.gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start)
    keep(gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start == phase_essence_cut_in.gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start)
    keep(gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start == phase_essence_cut_in.gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start)
    keep(gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end == phase_essence_cut_in.gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end)
    keep(gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_end == phase_essence_cut_in.gen_cut_in_vehicle_lat_offset_at_end)

extend sut.vehicle_cut_in_and_stop_test:

    on @phase_post.start:
       emit post_phase_at_start_event

    on @phase_post.end:
        emit post_phase_at_end_event

    on @phase_scenario.phase_essence_cut_in.start:
        emit cut_in_phase_start_event

    do phase_test: serial():

        phase_ego_warm_up: vehicle_cut_in_base_ego_warm_up(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle)

        phase_scenario: vehicle_cut_in_and_stop(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle)

        phase_post: vehicle_cut_in_base_post(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sut::double_vehicle_cut_in
# In this scenario, cut_in_vehicle_1 and cut_in_vehicle_2 both cut in front of the Ego, each on Ego's 
# different side. cut_in_vehicle_1 is further away from Ego than cut_in_vehicle_2
# in front of the Ego and drive at its lane ahead.
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    . gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_side (The side of which cut_in_vehicle_1 cuts in)
#    . gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_side (The side of which cut_in_vehicle_2 cuts in)
#    . gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start (Time distance between Ego and cut_in_vehicle_1 at the start of the lane change )
#    . gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start (Time distance between Ego and cut_in_vehicle_2 at the start of the lane change )
#    . gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_speed_during_cut_in (Speed of cut_in_vehicle_1 during cut_in)
#    . gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_speed_during_cut_in (Speed of cut_in_vehicle_2 during cut_in)
#    . gen_cut_in_vehicles_lat_offset_at_start (Later offset of cut_in_vehicles at the start)
#    . gen_cut_in_vehicles_lat_offset_at_end (Later offset of cut_in_vehicles at the end)

scenario sut.double_vehicle_cut_in inherits generic_base_scenario:

    keep(default scenario_str == "double_vehicle_cut_in")
    cut_in_vehicle_1: vehicle with:
        keep(it.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false) # The first cut_in vehicle
    cut_in_vehicle_2: vehicle  with:
        keep(it.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false) # The second cut_in vehicle

    # The side of which cut_in_vehicle_1 cuts in, left or right
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.start.cut_in_vehicle_1_side", gen_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.start.gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_side")
    gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_side: av_side
    var cut_in_vehicle_1_side: av_side

    # The side of which cut_in_vehicle_2 cuts in, left or right
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.start.cut_in_vehicle_2_side", gen_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.start.gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_side")
    gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_side: av_side
    var cut_in_vehicle_2_side: av_side

    cut_in_vehicle_1_lane: av_side
    keep(gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_side == left => cut_in_vehicle_1_lane == right)
    keep(gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_side == right => cut_in_vehicle_1_lane == left)

    cut_in_vehicle_2_lane: av_side
    keep(gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_side == left => cut_in_vehicle_2_lane == right)
    keep(gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_side == right => cut_in_vehicle_2_lane == left)
    # The speed of cut_in_vehicle_1 during cut_in
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.cut_in_vehicle_1_switch_lane_start.cut_in_vehicle_1_speed_during_cut_in", gen_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.start.gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_speed_during_cut_in")
    gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_speed_during_cut_in: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    var cut_in_vehicle_1_speed_during_cut_in: speed

    # The speed of cut_in_vehicle_2 during cut_in
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.cut_in_vehicle_2_switch_lane_start.cut_in_vehicle_2_speed_during_cut_in", gen_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.start.gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_speed_during_cut_in")
    gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_speed_during_cut_in: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    var cut_in_vehicle_2_speed_during_cut_in: speed

    # The time gap between cut_in_vehicle_1 and Ego at the start of the lane change phase
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.cut_in_vehicle_1_switch_lane_start.cut_in_vehicle_1_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start", gen_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.start.gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start")
    gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)
    var cut_in_vehicle_1_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start: time

    # The time gap between cut_in_vehicle_2 and Ego at the start of the lane change phase
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.cut_in_vehicle_2_switch_lane_start.cut_in_vehicle_2_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start", gen_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.start.gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start")
    gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)
    var cut_in_vehicle_2_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start: time

    # Lateral offset of the cut_in_vehicles at start of the scenario
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.start.cut_in_vehicles_lat_offset_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.start.gen_cut_in_vehicles_lat_offset_at_start")
    gen_cut_in_vehicles_lat_offset_at_start: length with:
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_lateral_lane_pos)
    var cut_in_vehicles_lat_offset_at_start: length

    one_way_road: one_way_road with: keep(it.min_lanes >= 1)
    
    # Lateral offset of the cut_in_vehicles at end of the scenario
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.phase_essence_change_lane_event_end.cut_in_vehicles_lat_offset_at_end", gen_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.start.gen_cut_in_vehicles_lat_offset_at_end")
    gen_cut_in_vehicles_lat_offset_at_end: length with:
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_lateral_lane_pos)
    var cut_in_vehicles_lat_offset_at_end: length
    
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.start.min_lanes", gen_cover: "sut.double_vehicle_cut_in.start.gen_min_lanes")
    gen_min_lanes: int with:
        keep(it == ego_path.min_lanes)
    var min_lanes: int

    cut_in_vehicle_1_time_gap_at_essence_end: time with:
        keep(default it in [1.0..1.5]s)

    cut_in_vehicle_2_time_gap_at_essence_end: time with:
        keep(default it in [3.0..3.5]s)

    ego_path : one_way_road
    
    # For separating coverage when invoked as sub-scenario
    kind: double_cut_in_kind with: keep(default it == double_cut_in)
    has_stationary_object: bool with: keep(default it == false)
    keep(soft cut_in_vehicle_2.color == blue)
    keep(gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_side != gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_side)

scenario sut.double_vehicle_cut_in_ego_warm_up:
    cut_in_vehicle_1: vehicle
    cut_in_vehicle_2: vehicle

scenario sut.double_vehicle_cut_in_post:
    cut_in_vehicle_1: vehicle
    cut_in_vehicle_2: vehicle

scenario sut.double_vehicle_cut_in_test:

    gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_side: av_side  # The side of which cut_in_vehicle_1 cuts in, left or right
    gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_side: av_side  # The side of which cut_in_vehicle_2 cuts in, left or right
    ego_path : one_way_road
    cut_in_vehicle_speed_during_change_lane: speed with :
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    cut_in_vehicle_1: vehicle with:
        keep(it.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false) # The first cut_in vehicle
    cut_in_vehicle_2: vehicle  with:
        keep(it.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false) # The second cut_in vehicle

enum double_cut_in_kind: [double_cut_in]

extend sut.double_vehicle_cut_in:

    event cut_in_vehicle_1_switch_lane_start is @cut_in_vehicle_1.switch_lane_start
    event cut_in_vehicle_2_switch_lane_start is @cut_in_vehicle_2.switch_lane_start
    var cut_in_vehicle_1_switch_lane_start_bool: bool = false
    var cut_in_vehicle_2_switch_lane_start_bool: bool = false

    on @start:
        min_lanes = ego_path.min_lanes
        if cut_in_vehicle_1.road_distance(sut.car, center, center, lat, lane) > 0m:
            cut_in_vehicle_1_side = right
        if cut_in_vehicle_1.road_distance(sut.car, center, center, lat, lane) < 0m:
            cut_in_vehicle_1_side = left

        if cut_in_vehicle_2.road_distance(sut.car, center, center, lat, lane) > 0m:
            cut_in_vehicle_2_side = right
        if cut_in_vehicle_2.road_distance(sut.car, center, center, lat, lane) < 0m:
            cut_in_vehicle_2_side = left

        cut_in_vehicles_lat_offset_at_start = cut_in_vehicle_1.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset

    on @cut_in_vehicle_1_switch_lane_start:
        if not cut_in_vehicle_1_switch_lane_start_bool:
            cut_in_vehicle_1_switch_lane_start_bool = true
            cut_in_vehicle_1_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start = sut.car.get_time_gap(cut_in_vehicle_1)
            cut_in_vehicle_1_speed_during_cut_in = cut_in_vehicle_1.state.speed

    on @cut_in_vehicle_2_switch_lane_start:
        if not cut_in_vehicle_2_switch_lane_start_bool:
            cut_in_vehicle_2_switch_lane_start_bool = true
            cut_in_vehicle_2_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start = sut.car.get_time_gap(cut_in_vehicle_2)
            cut_in_vehicle_2_speed_during_cut_in = cut_in_vehicle_2.state.speed

    on @phase_essence_change_lane_event_end:
        cut_in_vehicles_lat_offset_at_end = cut_in_vehicle_2.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset

    do phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):

        phase_essence_vehicle_cut_in_1: vehicle_cut_in(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle_1,
            essence_phase_end_path: one_way_road, 
            ego_path: ego_path,
            gen_cut_in_side: gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_side,gen_cut_in_lane: cut_in_vehicle_1_lane,
            gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start: gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start,
            cut_in_vehicle_speed_during_change_lane: gen_cut_in_vehicle_1_speed_during_cut_in,
            gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end: cut_in_vehicle_1_time_gap_at_essence_end)
        phase_essence_vehicle_cut_in_2: vehicle_cut_in(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle_2,
            essence_phase_end_path: one_way_road, 
            ego_path: ego_path,
            gen_cut_in_side: gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_side,gen_cut_in_lane: cut_in_vehicle_2_lane, 
            gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start: gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_time_gap_to_ego_at_change_lane_start,
            cut_in_vehicle_speed_during_change_lane: gen_cut_in_vehicle_2_speed_during_cut_in,
            gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end: cut_in_vehicle_2_time_gap_at_essence_end)

extend sut.double_vehicle_cut_in_ego_warm_up:

    do phase_warm_up: parallel(overlap: equal):
        drive_cut_in_vehicle_1_at_warm_up: vehicle_cut_in_base_ego_warm_up(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle_1)
        drive_cut_in_vehicle_2_at_warm_up: vehicle_cut_in_base_ego_warm_up(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle_2)

extend sut.double_vehicle_cut_in_post:

    do phase_post: parallel(overlap: equal):
        drive_cut_in_vehicle_1_at_post: vehicle_cut_in_base_post(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle_1)
        drive_cut_in_vehicle_2_at_post: vehicle_cut_in_base_post(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle_2)

extend sut.vehicle_cut_in:
    pass
    ego_path : one_way_road
    cut_in_vehicle_speed_during_change_lane: speed with :
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    override_intent_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_essence_start: override(intent_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_essence_start, run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_essence_end: override(intent_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_essence_end, run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start: override(intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start, run_mode: disable)
    
extend sut.double_vehicle_cut_in_test:
    
    event phase_post_at_start_event
    event phase_post_at_end_event

    event phase_post_end_event
    
    on @phase_post.start:
       emit phase_post_at_start_event

        override_intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_1_speed_at_essence: override(intent_cut_in_vehicle_1_speed_at_essence, 
            run_mode: best_effort)
    in phase_scenario.phase_essence_vehicle_cut_in_2.drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_essence with:
        intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_2_along_at_essence: along(ego_path, run_mode: best_effort)

extend sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic_from_shoulder_ego_warm_up:

    do phase_warm_up: parallel(overlap: equal):
        drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_warm_up: vehicle_cut_in_base_ego_warm_up(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle)
        drive_front_vehicle_at_warm_up: vehicle_cut_in_base_ego_warm_up(cut_in_vehicle: front_vehicle)

        intent_cut_in_vehicle_along_at_ego_warm_up: along(
            outer.shoulder)
        override_intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_keep_lane_at_ego_warm_up: \

        intent_back_vehicle_along_at_ego_warm_up: along(
            outer.shoulder)   
        intent_assist_back_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up: speed(0kph)

extend sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic_from_shoulder_post:

    do phase_post: parallel(overlap: equal):
        drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_post: vehicle_cut_in_base_post(cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle)
        drive_front_vehicle_at_post: vehicle_cut_in_base_post(cut_in_vehicle: front_vehicle)
        drive_back_vehicle_at_post: vehicle_cut_in_base_post(cut_in_vehicle: back_vehicle)

    in drive_front_vehicle_at_post.drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_post with:
        intent_assist_front_vehicle_along_at_post: along(
            outer.shoulder, run_mode: best_effort)

            outer.shoulder, run_mode: best_effort)
        intent_back_vehicle_speed_at_post: keep_speed()

extend sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic_from_shoulder:

    adjacent_vehicle_speed_at_start: speed with:
        keep(default it == 0kph)
    
    on @start:
        adjacent_vehicle_speed_at_start = front_vehicle.state.speed
        cut_in_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.enable = false 
        cut_in_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.update_config()
    on @end:
        cut_in_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.enable = true 
        cut_in_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.update_config()
    
    # Disable the bypass behavior of cut_in_vehicle
    keep(cut_in_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)

    # Disable the junction entry lane behavior of both the vehicles so as to ensure
    # vehicles doesn't chnage the lane when placed on junction entry
    keep(front_vehicle.ftx_driver.junction_entry_lane_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(back_vehicle.ftx_driver.junction_entry_lane_behavior.enable == false)

    keep(cut_in_vehicle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(front_vehicle.ftx_driver.ending_lane_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(cut_in_vehicle.ftx_driver.stay_on_road_behavior.enable == false)

    override_control_cut_in_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end: override(\
        phase_essence_vehicle_cut_in.control_cut_in_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end, run_mode: disable)
    
    do phase_essence: parallel (overlap: equal):

            cut_in_vehicle: cut_in_vehicle,
            gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start: \
                gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_start,
            gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start: \
                gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_start,
            gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end: \
                gen_ego_time_gap_to_cut_in_vehicle_at_change_lane_end,
            gen_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_start: \
                gen_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_start)

        drive_front_vehicle_at_essence: front_vehicle.drive() with:
            intent_assist_front_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start: speed(
                adjacent_vehicle_speed_at_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_assist_front_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence: keep_speed(
                run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_assist_front_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start: position(
                front_vehicle_dis_to_cut_in_vehicle, ahead_of: cut_in_vehicle, 
                measure_by: nearest, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_front_vehicle_along_at_essence: along(shoulder)
            intent_front_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane()
        drive_back_vehicle_at_essence: back_vehicle.drive() with:
            intent_assist_back_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start: speed(
                adjacent_vehicle_speed_at_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_assist_back_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence: keep_speed(
                run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_assist_back_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start: position(
                back_vehicle_dis_to_cut_in_vehicle, behind: cut_in_vehicle, 
                measure_by: nearest, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_back_vehicle_along_at_essence: along(shoulder)
            intent_back_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
    with:
        intent_essence_cut_in_shoulder_duration: duration(
            gen_duration_at_essence, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)

    in phase_essence_vehicle_cut_in.drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_essence with:
        lane(same_as: sut.car, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)

extend sut.vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic_from_shoulder_test:

    on @phase_scenario.end:
       emit post_phase_at_start_event

    on @phase_post.end:
        emit post_phase_at_end_event

    on @phase_scenario.start:
        emit cut_in_phase_start_event
    do phase_test: serial():
        phase_ego_warm_up: vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic_from_shoulder_ego_warm_up(

            back_vehicle: back_vehicle, shoulder: shoulder,

            shoulder: shoulder, road_near_shoulder: road_near_shoulder)
 
        phase_post: vehicle_cut_in_out_of_traffic_from_shoulder_post(

            back_vehicle: back_vehicle,
            shoulder: shoulder, road_near_shoulder: road_near_shoulder)

            at: start, from: curb)
        intent_ego_along_at_ego_warm_up_start: along(

    in phase_scenario.phase_essence_vehicle_cut_in.drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_essence with:

    keep(gen_ego_speed_at_start == phase_scenario.gen_ego_speed_at_start)

         - 1m - gen_ego_lane_width/2 - max_object_dimension/2 + gen_ego_lane_width - sut.car.get_width()))

         - 1m - gen_ego_lane_width/2 - max_object_dimension/2 + gen_ego_lane_width - sut.car.get_width()))
        keep((main_lane.lanes > 1) =>  (stationed_object_2_group_lat_offset_allowance == gen_stationed_object_group_2_lat_offset))

        reference_car: changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle)
    keep(default changing_lane_vehicle_behind.cars.size() == gen_number_of_lane_changed_vehicles_behind_of_ego)

    # Speed deviation and initial TTC of the changing_lane_vehicle_side vehicles
    for member in changing_lane_vehicle_behind.members_params:
        keep(member.initial_speed_percentage in [90..110])
        keep(default member.min_initial_ttc == gen_traffic_min_initial_ttc)

    # Staying_in_lane_vehicle_group attributes
    keep_lane_lead_vehicle: vehicle
    gen_number_of_staying_in_lane_vehicles: int
    keep(default gen_number_of_staying_in_lane_vehicles in [1..6])
    
    keep_lane_traffic_group: all_lanes_car_group with(
        reference_car: keep_lane_lead_vehicle)
    keep(default keep_lane_traffic_group.cars.size() == gen_number_of_staying_in_lane_vehicles)

    # Speed deviation and initial TTC of the keep_lane_traffic_group vehicles
    for member in keep_lane_traffic_group.members_params:
        keep(member.initial_speed_percentage in [90..110])
        keep(default member.min_initial_ttc == gen_traffic_min_initial_ttc)

    # Set the initial time gap between ego and lead vehicles (reference_car)
    # to prevent early collisions.
    # Constrain the gap to be equal to the number of vehicles in the group,
    # including the reference car, multiplied by the traffic initial ttc.
    ego_init_time_gap_changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle: time
    keep(default ego_init_time_gap_changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle == \
        ((gen_number_of_lane_changed_vehicles_ahead_of_ego +1) / lane_section.lanes) * gen_traffic_min_initial_ttc )

    ego_init_time_gap_changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle: time
    keep(default ego_init_time_gap_changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle == \
        ((gen_number_of_lane_changed_vehicles_behind_of_ego +1) / lane_section.lanes) * gen_traffic_min_initial_ttc )

    ego_init_time_gap_keep_lane_lead_vehicle: time
    keep(default ego_init_time_gap_keep_lane_lead_vehicle == \
        ((gen_number_of_staying_in_lane_vehicles +1) / lane_section.lanes) * gen_traffic_min_initial_ttc )

    post_phase_duration: time
    keep(default post_phase_duration in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_post_phase_duration)

import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/ftx/ftx_group_driver_model.osc"

extend sut.high_traffic_stop_and_go:
    # Road element
    road: one_way_road
    keep(road.min_lanes == 3)
    lane_section: lane_section

    keep_lane_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model 
    normal_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model 

    # Traffic group with normal driver model
    for car in changing_lane_vehicle_ahead.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == normal_driver_model)
    keep(normal_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(normal_driver_model.target_speed == gen_traffic_speed)

    for car in changing_lane_vehicle_side.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == normal_driver_model)
    keep(normal_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(normal_driver_model.target_speed == gen_traffic_speed)

    for car in changing_lane_vehicle_behind.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == normal_driver_model)
    keep(normal_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(normal_driver_model.target_speed == gen_traffic_speed)

    # Traffic group with keep lane normal driver model
    for car in keep_lane_traffic_group.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == keep_lane_driver_model)
    keep(keep_lane_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(keep_lane_driver_model.target_speed == gen_traffic_speed)
    keep(keep_lane_driver_model.change_lane_eagerness == 0)

    do high_traffic_stop_and_go: serial:

        # in the ego warm-up phase, traffic vehicles are holding their lanes and drive at traffic speed
        phase_ego_warm_up: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(middle: true)
                intent_ego_along_road_at_ego_warm_up_start: along(road)
                intent_ego_along_lane_section_at_ego_warm_up_start: along(lane_section, end_offset: [10..]m, at: start)
             
            drive_jam_vehicle_1_at_ego_warm_up: jam_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                intent_assist_jam_vehicle_1_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_jam_vehicle_1_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position([10..20]m, ahead_of: keep_lane_lead_vehicle, 
                    measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_jam_vehicle_1_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(middle: true)
            
            drive_jam_vehicle_2_at_ego_warm_up: jam_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                intent_assist_jam_vehicle_2_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_jam_vehicle_2_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position([-2.5..2.5]m, ahead_of: jam_vehicle_1, 
                    measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_jam_vehicle_2_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(side: left, side_of: jam_vehicle_1)
            
            drive_jam_vehicle_3_at_ego_warm_up: jam_vehicle_3.drive() with:
                intent_assist_jam_vehicle_3_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_jam_vehicle_3_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position([-2.5..2.5]m, ahead_of: jam_vehicle_1, 
                    measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_jam_vehicle_3_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(side: right, side_of: jam_vehicle_1)
            
            drive_changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                # Add 2s to account for vehicle length in the initial time gap
                # between ego and vehicle.
                intent_changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(time:[ego_init_time_gap_changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle..\
                    (ego_init_time_gap_changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle+2s)],
                    ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
            
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_ahead_at_ego_warm_up: changing_lane_vehicle_ahead.group_drive()
            
            drive_changing_lane_side_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: changing_lane_side_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                # Add 2s to account for vehicle length in the initial time gap
                # between ego and vehicle.
                intent_changing_lane_side_lead_vehicle_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(time:[0..0]s,
                    ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_changing_lane_side_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
                intent_assist_changing_lane_side_lead_vehicle_change_lane_at_ego_warm_up: change_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_side_at_ego_warm_up: changing_lane_vehicle_side.group_drive()
            
            drive_changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                # Add 2s to account for vehicle length in the initial time gap
                # between ego and vehicle.
                intent_changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(time:[ego_init_time_gap_changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle..\
                    (ego_init_time_gap_changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle+2s)],
                    behind: sut.car, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
                intent_assist_changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle_change_lane_at_ego_warm_up: change_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_behind_at_ego_warm_up: changing_lane_vehicle_behind.group_drive()
            
            drive_keep_lane_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: keep_lane_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_keep_lane_lead_vehicle_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(side_of: sut.car, side: right, at: start)
                intent_assist_keep_lane_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
                intent_keep_lane_lead_vehicle_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(time:[(ego_init_time_gap_keep_lane_lead_vehicle+2s)..\
                    (ego_init_time_gap_keep_lane_lead_vehicle+5s)],
                    ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_keep_lane_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_ego_warm_up: keep_lane()
            
            drive_keep_lane_traffic_group_at_ego_warm_up: keep_lane_traffic_group.group_drive()
        with:
            intent_ego_warm_up_duration: duration([1..10]s, tolerance: 3s)

        # in the essence slow phase, the jam_vehicles decelerate and lane changing vehicles change their lane
        phase_essence_slow: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_slow: sut.car.drive() 
            
            drive_jam_vehicle_1_at_essence_slow: jam_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                intent_assist_jam_vehicle_1_speed_at_essence_slow_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
                intent_jam_vehicle_1_speed_at_essence_slow_end: speed(0kph, at: end)
                intent_assist_jam_vehicle_1_keep_lane_at_essence_slow: keep_lane()
            
            drive_jam_vehicle_2_at_essence_slow: jam_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                intent_assist_jam_vehicle_2_speed_at_essence_slow_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
                intent_jam_vehicle_2_speed_at_essence_slow_end: speed(0kph, at: end)
                intent_assist_jam_vehicle_2_keep_lane_at_essence_slow: keep_lane()
            
            drive_jam_vehicle_3_at_essence_slow: jam_vehicle_3.drive() with:
                intent_assist_jam_vehicle_3_speed_at_essence_slow_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
                intent_jam_vehicle_3_speed_at_essence_slow_end: speed(0kph, at: end)
                intent_assist_jam_vehicle_3_keep_lane_at_essence_slow: keep_lane()
            
            drive_changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle_at_essence_slow: changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle.drive()
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_ahead_at_essence_slow: changing_lane_vehicle_ahead.group_drive()
            drive_changing_lane_side_lead_vehicle_at_essence_slow: changing_lane_side_lead_vehicle.drive()
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_side_at_essence_slow: changing_lane_vehicle_side.group_drive()
            drive_changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle_at_essence_slow: changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle.drive()
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_behind_at_essence_slow: changing_lane_vehicle_behind.group_drive()
            drive_keep_lane_lead_vehicle_at_essence_slow: keep_lane_lead_vehicle.drive()
            drive_keep_lane_traffic_group_at_essence_slow: keep_lane_traffic_group.group_drive()
        with:
            intent_essence_slow_duration: duration([5..20]s, tolerance: 5s)

        # in the essence stop phase, the jam_vehicles come to stop and block all lanes
        phase_essence_stop: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_stop: sut.car.drive()
            
            drive_jam_vehicle_1_at_essence_stop: jam_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                intent_jam_vehicle_1_speed_at_essence_stop: speed(0kph)
            
            drive_jam_vehicle_2_at_essence_stop: jam_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                intent_jam_vehicle_2_speed_at_essence_stop: speed(0kph)
            
            drive_jam_vehicle_3_at_essence_stop: jam_vehicle_3.drive() with:
                intent_jam_vehicle_3_speed_at_essence_stop: speed(0kph)
            
            drive_changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle_at_essence_stop: changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle.drive()
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_ahead_at_essence_stop: changing_lane_vehicle_ahead.group_drive()
            drive_changing_lane_side_lead_vehicle_at_essence_stop: changing_lane_side_lead_vehicle.drive()
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_side_at_essence_stop: changing_lane_vehicle_side.group_drive()
            drive_changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle_at_essence_stop: changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle.drive()
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_behind_at_essence_stop: changing_lane_vehicle_behind.group_drive()
            drive_keep_lane_lead_vehicle_at_essence_stop: keep_lane_lead_vehicle.drive()
            drive_keep_lane_traffic_group_at_essence_stop: keep_lane_traffic_group.group_drive()
        with:
            intent_essence_stop_duration: duration([4..10]s, tolerance: 5s)

        # in the essence go phase, the jam_vehicles accelerate till gen_traffic_speed and other vehicles continue in same lane
        phase_essence_go: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_go: sut.car.drive() 
            
            drive_jam_vehicle_1_at_essence_go: jam_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                intent_jam_vehicle_1_speed_at_essence_go_end: speed(gen_traffic_speed, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_jam_vehicle_1_keep_lane_at_essence_go: keep_lane()
            
            drive_jam_vehicle_2_at_essence_go: jam_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                intent_jam_vehicle_2_speed_at_essence_go_end: speed(gen_traffic_speed, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_jam_vehicle_2_keep_lane_at_essence_go: keep_lane()
            
            drive_jam_vehicle_3_at_essence_go: jam_vehicle_3.drive() with:
                intent_jam_vehicle_3_speed_at_essence_go_end: speed(gen_traffic_speed, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_jam_vehicle_3_keep_lane_at_essence_go: keep_lane()
            
            drive_changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle_at_essence_go: changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_changing_lane_ahead_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_go_end: speed(gen_traffic_speed, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_ahead_at_essence_go: changing_lane_vehicle_ahead.group_drive()
            
            drive_changing_lane_side_lead_vehicle_at_essence_go: changing_lane_side_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_changing_lane_side_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_go_end: speed(gen_traffic_speed, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_side_at_essence_go: changing_lane_vehicle_side.group_drive()
            
            drive_changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle_at_essence_go: changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_changing_lane_behind_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_go_end: speed(gen_traffic_speed, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_behind_at_essence_go: changing_lane_vehicle_behind.group_drive()
            
            drive_keep_lane_lead_vehicle_at_essence_go: keep_lane_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_keep_lane_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_go_end: speed(gen_traffic_speed, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_keep_lane_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_go: keep_lane()
            
            drive_keep_lane_traffic_group_at_essence_go: keep_lane_traffic_group.group_drive()
        with:
            intent_essence_go_duration: duration(post_phase_duration, tolerance: 3s)

# In this scenario, the Ego drives in the vicinity of decelerating traffic 
# which is approaching a congestion due to which the Ego should adapt 
# its speed, slow down and stop.
#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    . gen_ego_speed_at_start (the initial speed of Ego within [20..40]kph) 
#    . gen_number_of_traffic_vehicles (number of vehicles forming 
#      the traffic_group within [3..10])
#    . gen_number_of_congestion_vehicles (number of vehicles forming the 
#      congestion_group within [3..10])
#    . gen_ego_time_gap_to_traffic_group (initial time gap of ego and foremost vehicle
#      of traffic_group within [10..40]s)
#    . gen_traffic_group_speed (the speed of traffic_group vehicles within [8..48]kph) 
#    . gen_traffic_group_time_gap_to_congestion_group (initial time gap of traffic group
#      lead vehicle and congestion lead vehicle within [2..5]s)
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/common/scenarios/generic_base_scenario/generic_base_scenario_top.osc"

scenario sut.traffic_slows_and_comes_to_stop inherits generic_base_scenario:

    # traffic_group attributes
    gen_number_of_traffic_vehicles: int with:
        keep(default it in [3..10])
    traffic_group_lead_vehicle: vehicle
    traffic_group: all_lanes_car_group with( 
        reference_car: traffic_group_lead_vehicle)
    gen_traffic_group_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in [20..110]kph)
    gen_ego_time_gap_to_traffic_group: time with:
        keep(default it in [2..4]s)
    
    # congestion_group attributes
    gen_number_of_congestion_vehicles: int with:
        keep(default it in [3..10])
    congestion_group_lead_vehicle: vehicle
    congestion_group: all_lanes_car_group with(
        reference_car: congestion_group_lead_vehicle)
    
    # Time gap between congestion group lead vehicle and traffice group lead vehicle
    gen_traffic_group_time_gap_to_congestion_group: time with:
        keep(default gen_traffic_group_time_gap_to_congestion_group in [2..4]s)

    distance_offset: length with:
        keep(it in [gen_ego_speed_at_start * gen_traffic_group_time_gap_to_congestion_group
            - 0.1m..gen_ego_speed_at_start * gen_traffic_group_time_gap_to_congestion_group + 0.1m])


    congestion_vehicle_1: stationary_vehicle
    congestion_vehicle_2: stationary_vehicle
    congestion_vehicle_3: stationary_vehicle

    traffic_group_min_initial_ttc_upper_bound: time with:
        keep(default it == 5s)

    traffic_group_min_initial_ttc_lower_bound: time with:
        keep(default it == 2s)

    congestion_group_min_initial_ttc_upper_bound: time with:
        keep(default it == 2s)

    congestion_group_min_initial_ttc_lower_bound: time with:
        keep(default it == 0.5s)

    post_phase_duration: time
    keep(default post_phase_duration in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_post_phase_duration)

        keep(car.initial_bm == normal_driver_model)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.enabling_policy == always_enabled)
    traffic_group_lead_vehicle_position: length with:
        keep(it == (gen_ego_time_gap_to_traffic_group * gen_ego_speed_at_start) + \
            traffic_group_lead_vehicle.bbox.length)
    for member in traffic_group.members_params:
        keep(member.initial_speed_percentage in [90..110])
        keep(member.min_initial_ttc <= traffic_group_min_initial_ttc_upper_bound)
        keep(member.min_initial_ttc >= traffic_group_min_initial_ttc_lower_bound)

    # congestion_group attributes with stopping driver model
    congestion_vehicle_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model with:
        keep(it.change_lane_eagerness == 0)
    keep(congestion_group.cars.size() == gen_number_of_congestion_vehicles)
    for car in congestion_group.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == congestion_vehicle_driver_model)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.enabling_policy == always_enabled)
    for member in congestion_group.members_params:
        keep(member.use_reference_car_speed == true)
        keep(member.min_initial_ttc <= congestion_group_min_initial_ttc_upper_bound)
        keep(member.min_initial_ttc >= congestion_group_min_initial_ttc_lower_bound)

    distance_between_car_group_vehicles: length with:
        keep(default it in [3..6]m)

    event clock is sut.car.state.msp_pos.road_position != null

    # Attributes when the ego stopped
    var ego_stopped: bool = sample(true, @ego_stopped_event)
    var time_at_ego_stopped : time = sample(top.time, @ego_stopped_event)
    event ego_stopped_event is @clock if sut.car.is_standing_still() \
        and ego_stopped == false
    duration_of_ego_stop: time
    keep(duration_of_ego_stop == 5s)

    var ego_passed_by_congestion_vehicles: bool = sample(
        passed_by_congestion_vehicles(), @clock)

    # The ego stopped for a duration of 5s 
    event scenario_stop_ego_stopped is \
        (ego_stopped and top.time - time_at_ego_stopped >=
            duration_of_ego_stop) 

    # The ego is passed by all vehicles of the congestion_group
    event scenario_stop_ego_passed_by_congestion_vehicles is \
        ego_passed_by_congestion_vehicles

    # Method to determine if ego passed by all vehicles of the congestion group
    # by checking the position between ego and each vehicle of the
    # congestion_group
    def passed_by_congestion_vehicles()-> bool is:
        for car in congestion_group.cars:
            if car.state != null:
               if map.distance_from_ref_position(
                   car.state.msp_pos.road_position,
                   sut.car.state.msp_pos.road_position) < 0m:
                       return false
        return true

    congestion_vehicle_1_msp_position: msp_position
    congestion_vehicle_2_msp_position: msp_position
    congestion_vehicle_3_msp_position: msp_position

    # Positioning the congestion_vehicle_1 relative 
    # To drive_congestion_group_lead_vehicle_at_essence
    congestion_vehicle_1_placement: top.position_along_drive(\
        congestion_vehicle_1_msp_position, 
        drive_congestion_group_lead_vehicle_at_essence, lon_offset: 10m, lat_offset: -3m)

    # Positioning the congestion_vehicle_2 relative 
    # To drive_congestion_group_lead_vehicle_at_essence
    congestion_vehicle_2_placement: top.position_along_drive(\
        congestion_vehicle_2_msp_position, 
        drive_congestion_group_lead_vehicle_at_essence, lon_offset: 10m, lat_offset: 3m)

    # Positioning the congestion_vehicle_3 relative 
    # To drive_congestion_group_lead_vehicle_at_essence
    congestion_vehicle_3_placement: top.position_along_drive(\
        congestion_vehicle_3_msp_position, 
        drive_congestion_group_lead_vehicle_at_essence, lon_offset: 10m, lat_offset: 0m)

    keep(congestion_group_lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)
    
    do traffic_slows_and_comes_to_stop: first_of:
        # In this scenario the ego drives in the vicinity of traffic_group which
        # approaching the stopped congestion_group.
        # The scenario ends either when the ego stops for 5s
        # or passes by the congestion vehicles

        serial():
            # in the ego warm-up phase, the ego drives in the vicinity of traffic_group which approaching the stopped congestion_group
            phase_ego_warm_up: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_ego_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_ego_warm_up: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                
                drive_traffic_group_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: traffic_group_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_traffic_group_lead_vehicle_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(distance: [20m..30m], ahead_of: sut.car,
                        at: start, measure_by: nearest)
                    intent_assist_traffic_group_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up: speed(gen_traffic_group_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                
                drive_traffic_group_at_ego_warm_up: traffic_group.group_drive()
                
                drive_congestion_group_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: congestion_group_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_congestion_group_lead_vehicle_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(distance: [20m..30m], ahead_of: traffic_group_lead_vehicle,
                        at: start, measure_by: nearest)
                
                intent_congestion_vehicle_3_positioning_at_ego_warm_up:  congestion_vehicle_3.exists_at(\
                    congestion_vehicle_3_msp_position)
                intent_congestion_vehicle_2_positioning_at_ego_warm_up:  congestion_vehicle_2.exists_at(\
                    congestion_vehicle_2_msp_position)
                intent_congestion_vehicle_1_positioning_at_ego_warm_up:  congestion_vehicle_1.exists_at(\
                    congestion_vehicle_1_msp_position)  
                
                drive_congestion_group_at_ego_warm_up: congestion_group.group_drive()
            with:
                intent_ego_warm_up_duration: duration([6..10]s)

            # in the essence phase, the traffic group approaches the congestion group and ego follows
            phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_ego_speed_at_essence_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_ego_along_road_at_essence_start: along(road, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                
                drive_traffic_group_lead_vehicle_at_essence: traffic_group_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_traffic_group_lead_vehicle_position_at_essence_start: position(time: gen_ego_time_gap_to_traffic_group, ahead_of: sut.car,
                        at: start, measure_by: nearest, time_tolerance: 2s, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_traffic_group_lead_vehicle_along_road_at_essence_start: along(road, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_traffic_group_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence: speed(gen_traffic_group_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                
                drive_traffic_group_at_essence: traffic_group.group_drive()
                
                drive_congestion_group_lead_vehicle_at_essence: congestion_group_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_congestion_group_lead_vehicle_position_at_essence_start: position(time: [gen_traffic_group_time_gap_to_congestion_group-1s..gen_traffic_group_time_gap_to_congestion_group+1s], ahead_of: traffic_group_lead_vehicle,
                        at: start, measure_by: nearest, time_tolerance: 2s, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_congestion_group_lead_vehicle_lane_at_essence: lane(middle: true, run_mode: best_effort)
                
                drive_congestion_group_at_essence: congestion_group.group_drive()
            with:
                intent_essence_duration: duration([10..15]s, tolerance: 2s)

            # in the post phase, all vehicles maintain their current behaviors
            phase_post: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_post: sut.car.drive() with:
                   intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                   intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                
                drive_traffic_group_lead_vehicle_at_post: traffic_group_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_traffic_group_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                
                drive_traffic_group_at_post: traffic_group.group_drive()
                
                drive_congestion_group_lead_vehicle_at_post: congestion_group_lead_vehicle.drive() 
                
                drive_congestion_group_at_post: congestion_group.group_drive()
            with:
                intent_post_duration: duration(post_phase_duration, tolerance: 2s)
        serial:
            wait @scenario_stop_ego_stopped
            log_info("Ego stopped for $(duration_of_ego_stop) - Stopping scenario")

        serial:
            wait @scenario_stop_ego_passed_by_congestion_vehicles
            log_info("Ego passed by the congestion vehicles - Stopping scenario")

extend sut.ego_approach_congestion:

    #keep(default congestion_drive.duration in [10..20]s)

    # Adding offsets to traffic speed, so we can see the varying speeds of vehicles

        keep( it in [gen_traffic_speed-ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_offset..\
            gen_traffic_speed+ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_offset])
    
    traffic_speed_3: speed with:
