# Copyright (C) 2025 Foretellix Ltd (“Foretellix”)
# This source code file is licensed to you under Foretellix’ End User License
# Agreement, you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You are not allowed to distribute it to any third party without Foretellix’
# written approval.
# If you choose to modify this code (in compliance with the license terms),
# you do it at your own risk, and Foretellix will no longer supply any
# support or maintenance services for this source code.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

extend gen_config:
    set solver1_restart_max_failures = 150

extend gen_config:
    set prevent_unavoidable_collisions = false

extend vehicle:
    keep(ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)
    # The Vehicle's junction behavior is disabled to achieve the distance
    # provided
    keep(ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == false)

extend sut.ego_merge_with_lane_change_vehicle_to_target_lane:

    # Offsets
    distance_offset: length
    keep(default distance_offset == 5m)
    lead_vehicle_distance_offset: length
    keep(default lead_vehicle_distance_offset == 10m)
    distance_tolerance: length
    keep(default distance_tolerance == 40m)
    speed_offset: speed
    keep(default speed_offset == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_offset)
    time_offset: time
    keep(default time_offset == 2s)

    lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_ego_at_end_of_initial_phase: time with:
        keep(default it in [0..5]s)

    lane_change_vehicle_rel_pos_to_lead_vehicle_at_end_of_initial_phase: time with:
        keep(default it in [2..5]s) 

    on @initial_phase.start:
       emit initial_phase_at_start_event

    on @initial_phase.end:
        emit initial_phase_at_end_event

    do first_of:
        ego_merge_with_lane_change_vehicle_to_target_lane: serial():

            # The follow_vehicle and lead_vehicle start to 
            # drive towards a forced_merge_location.
            # The Ego and lane_change_vehicle drive on different 
            # lanes/paths towards the same merge location.
            # The follow_vehicle_group follows the follow_vehicle
            initial_phase: parallel(overlap: equal): 
                lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    speed(gen_lead_vehicle_speed, tolerance: speed_offset,
                        at:start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    distance([((lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start - \
                        lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start) \
                        - distance_offset)..((lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start - \
                        lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start) \
                        + distance_offset)], 
                        tolerance: distance_tolerance)
                    position(time: [lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_ego_at_end_of_initial_phase -1s..\
                        lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_ego_at_end_of_initial_phase + 1s], 
                        ahead_of: sut.car, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                lane_change_vehicle_init_drive: lane_change_vehicle.drive() with:
                    speed(gen_lane_change_vehicle_speed,at: start)
                follow_vehicle_init_drive: follow_vehicle.drive() with:
                    lane(same_as: lead_vehicle,
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                follow_vehicle_group.group_drive()
                ego_init_drive: sut.car.drive() with:
                    speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    distance([(gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                        - distance_offset)..(gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                        + distance_offset)], 
                        tolerance: distance_tolerance)
                    ego_start_offset: along(road_to_force_merge_location, start_offset: [10..20]m, at: end,
                        tolerance: distance_tolerance,run_mode: best_effort)
            with:
               initial_duration: duration([6..25]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            #Conspicuity state of Merge vehicle
            lane_change_vehicle.turn_hazard_lights_state(hazard_light_type)
            lane_change_vehicle.turn_signal_lights_state(turn_signal_state)

            # At the start of this phase the Ego, follow_vehicle, follow_vehicle_group,
            # lead_vehicle and the lane_change_vehicle 
            # approach the merging location on different paths/lanes. 
            # At the end of the phase, the Ego merges into highway and 
            # the lane_change_vehicle merges into the lane of Ego.
            merge_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: start,
                        end_offset: \
                            [lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start - \
                                lead_vehicle_distance_offset..\
                                    lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start + \
                                        lead_vehicle_distance_offset],
                                            run_mode: best_effort)
                    position(time: [lead_vehicle_time_gap_at_post_merge -time_offset ..\
                        lead_vehicle_time_gap_at_post_merge + time_offset], at: end, 
                        ahead_of: sut.car, run_mode: best_effort)         
                lane_change_vehicle_merge_phase_drive: lane_change_vehicle.drive()             
                follow_vehicle_merge_phase_drive: follow_vehicle.drive() with:
                    follow_vehicle_position: position(time: gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_at_post_merge, 
                        behind: sut.car,
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                follow_vehicle_group.group_drive()
                ego_merge_phase: sut.car.drive() with:
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    # This is a workaround to ensure that the lane change happens
                    # This will ensure that the NolaneChange soft constraint 
                    # is overridden
                    change_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            with:
                duration([3..20]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            # In this phase the merge vehicle maintains the position 
            # behind the lead vehicle and 
            # all other traffic continues the drive
            post_merge_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                lane_change_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                follow_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                follow_vehicle_group.group_drive()
                ego_post_drive: sut.car.drive() with:
                    speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_post_phase: along(road_to_force_merge_path.successor_lane, 
                        at: end)
            with:
                duration([1..20]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)
            
        serial:
            wait @ego_stopped
            log_info("$(self): ending scenario after Ego stopped for"+\
                "$(ego_complete_stand_still_time).")
        serial:
            wait @ego_merge_end_condition
            log_info("$(self): The Ego merged successfully into target lane "+\
                "and passed 10s.")

    on @ego_stopped:
        call other_warning(ego_stopped_warning, 
            "Ego was not able to merge into target lane.")
    
    # To ensure the scenario runs long enough, the Ego is expected 
    # to move to the successor lane of road_to_force_merge using the along modifier. 
    # Once the merge is completed, the along modifier is 
    # changed to best_effort, as the intent has been achieved
    on @sut.car.switch_lane_end:
        override(intent_assist_ego_along_at_post_phase,
            run_mode:best_effort)
        call logger.log_info("The Ego performed a lane change, "+\
            "triggering the switch_lane_end event")

extend sut.ego_merge_with_cut_in_vehicle_to_target_lane:
    # Speed deviation and initial TTC of the follow_vehicle_group vehicles
    # follow_vehicle_desired_time_gap is 
    # the TTC provided to car_group which maintains it
    # throughout the scenario
    for member in follow_vehicle_group.members_params:
        keep(member.initial_speed_percentage in [90..110])
        keep(default member.min_initial_ttc == \
            gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start)
    
    # Speed to car group is provided as same as of follow_vehicle
    keep(keep_lane_ftx_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(keep_lane_ftx_model.target_speed in \
        [gen_lead_vehicle_speed - \
            gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start .. 
            gen_lead_vehicle_speed + \
            gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start])

    in lane_change_vehicle_init_drive with:
        position(time: lane_change_vehicle_rel_pos_to_lead_vehicle_at_end_of_initial_phase, 
            behind: lead_vehicle,at: end,run_mode: best_effort)
        lane(side_of: sut.car, lane: [2..])
        distance([(lane_change_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start - (\
            lane_change_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start)) - \
            distance_offset..\
            (lane_change_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start - (\
            lane_change_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start)) + \
            distance_offset], 
            tolerance: distance_tolerance)

    in follow_vehicle_init_drive with:
        position(
            time: gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start, 
            behind: lead_vehicle, at: start)
        speed([gen_lead_vehicle_speed - \
            gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start .. 
            gen_lead_vehicle_speed + \
            gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start], 
            at: start, 
            run_mode: best_effort)

    in lane_change_vehicle_merge_phase_drive with:
        distance(lane_change_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start,
            run_mode:best_effort)
        position(time: lane_change_vehicle_time_gap_at_post_merge, 
            behind: lead_vehicle, 
            at: end, 
            run_mode: best_effort)
        along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end,
            run_mode: best_effort) 

extend sut.ego_merge_with_cut_out_vehicle_from_target_lane:

    follow_vehicle_speed: speed with:
        keep(it in [gen_lane_change_vehicle_speed - \
            gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lane_change_vehicle_at_start .. 
            gen_lane_change_vehicle_speed + \
            gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lane_change_vehicle_at_start])

    for member in follow_vehicle_group.members_params:
        keep(member.initial_speed_percentage in [90..110])
        keep(default member.min_initial_ttc == \
            gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start)
    
    # Speed to car group is provided as same as of follow_vehicle
    keep(keep_lane_ftx_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(keep_lane_ftx_model.target_speed in \
        [follow_vehicle_speed - 5kph..follow_vehicle_speed + 5kph])

    ego_lane_change_side: av_side with:
        keep(default it in [left, right]) 

    in ego_merge_phase with:
        change_lane(side: ego_lane_change_side, run_mode: best_effort)

    override(follow_vehicle_position, run_mode: disable)

    in follow_vehicle_merge_phase_drive with:
        position(time: gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_at_post_merge, 
            behind: sut.car,at: end,
            run_mode: best_effort)
            
    in lane_change_vehicle_init_drive with:
        lane(same_as: lead_vehicle)
        position(time: gen_lane_change_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start, 
            behind: lead_vehicle,at: start)

import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/ftx/ftx_group_driver_model.osc"

# The SUT is unable to reach the forced merge location in time
# due to traffic which is moving slow and stopping for this
# the simulation time is increased to 150s
extend test_config:
    set max_test_time = 150s

extend sut_vehicle:
    # Preventing the SUT from bypassing the other vehicle.
    keep(ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)

extend sut.ego_merge_into_traffic_which_stops_and_go:

    # Disabled bypass behaviour so that give_way_vehicle 
    # doesn't change the lane
    keep(give_way_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(phase_time_tolerance == 30s)

    # Tolerance values
    distance_offset: length
    keep(default distance_offset == 5m)
    distance_tolerance: length with:
        keep(default it == 10m)
    speed_tolerance: speed with:
        keep(default it == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_tolerance)
    time_offset: time
    keep(default time_offset == 1s)
        
    # Number of vehicles in the jam_vehicle_group based on its
    # distance to the give way vehicle (110..250m) and the length of each 
    # vehicle (5m) and a cruise distance of 50m for each vehicle
    follow_vehicle_distance_to_give_way_vehicle: length with:
        keep(it in [110..250]m)

    keep(follow_vehicle_distance_to_give_way_vehicle in [110..164]m => \
        jam_vehicle_group.cars.size() == 1)
    keep(follow_vehicle_distance_to_give_way_vehicle in [165..219]m => \
        jam_vehicle_group.cars.size() == 2)
    keep(follow_vehicle_distance_to_give_way_vehicle in [220..250]m => \
        jam_vehicle_group.cars.size() == 3)

    keep(follow_vehicle_group.cars.size() in \
        ftlx_lib_base_config.default_number_of_vehicles_in_vehicle_group)

    # staying in lane driver model for the vehicles of the car groups
    driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model
    keep(driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(driver_model.change_lane_eagerness == 0)

    for car in jam_vehicle_group.cars: 
        keep(car.initial_bm == driver_model)

    for car in follow_vehicle_group.cars: 
        keep(car.initial_bm == driver_model)

    # Speed deviation and initial TTC of the vehicles of the car groups
    for member in jam_vehicle_group.members_params:
        keep(member.initial_speed_percentage in [90..110])
        keep(member.min_initial_ttc == gen_traffic_min_initial_ttc)
    
    for member in follow_vehicle_group.members_params:
        keep(member.initial_speed_percentage in [90..110])
        keep(member.min_initial_ttc == gen_traffic_min_initial_ttc)

    jam_vehicle_rel_pos_at_end_of_initial_phase: time with:
        keep(default it in [0..5]s)
    lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_ego_at_start: time
    keep(default lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_ego_at_start in [0..3]s)

    on @initial_phase.start:
       emit initial_phase_at_start_event

    on @initial_phase.end:
        emit initial_phase_at_end_event

    do first_of:
        merge_into_traffic_which_stops_and_go: serial():
        # In this phase, Ego drives on the highway entry and the
        # traffic vehicles drive on the highway towards the 
        # forced merge location
            initial_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                sut.car.drive() with:
                    speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    distance([(gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                        - distance_offset)..(gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                        + distance_offset)], 
                        tolerance: distance_tolerance)
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location, at: end, 
                    start_offset: [10..20]m,
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    speed(gen_traffic_vehicles_speed_at_start, 
                        tolerance: speed_tolerance, at: start)
                    position(time: [lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_ego_at_start..\
                        lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_ego_at_start + time_offset], 
                        ahead_of: sut.car, at: start,
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode:best_effort)

                    along(road_to_force_merge_location, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                jam_vehicle.drive() with:
                    speed(gen_traffic_vehicles_speed_at_start, 
                        tolerance: speed_tolerance, at: start)
                    position(follow_vehicle_distance_to_give_way_vehicle, 
                        ahead_of: give_way_vehicle, at: start, measure_by: nearest)
                    keep_lane()
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                jam_vehicle_group.group_drive()
                give_way_vehicle.drive() with:
                    speed(gen_traffic_vehicles_speed_at_start, 
                        tolerance: speed_tolerance, at: start)
                    lane(same_as: jam_vehicle)
                    distance([(give_way_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start \
                    - distance_offset)..(give_way_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start \
                    + distance_offset)], 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                follow_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                # The duration is calculated by,
                # [(min_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ max_ego_speed_at_start)..\
                # 2 * (max_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ max_ego_speed_at_start)]
                # This will ensure that Ego travels the distance and reach at start_offset of 
                # road_to_force_merge_location
                initial_duration: duration([6..25]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            # In this phase, jam_vehicle slows down and comes to stop
            # causing a traffic jam
            slow_down_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                sut.car.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    speed(0kph, at: end)
                    keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                jam_vehicle.drive() with:
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, 
                        at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    speed(0kph, at: end)
                    keep_lane()
                    position(time: jam_vehicle_rel_pos_at_end_of_initial_phase, 
                        ahead_of: lead_vehicle, at: start, measure_by: nearest,
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                jam_vehicle_group.group_drive()
                give_way_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane()
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: start, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                follow_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                duration([5..30]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            # In this phase, the jam_vehicle stops 
            stop_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                sut.car.drive() with:
                    speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    speed(0kph)
                jam_vehicle.drive() with:
                    speed(0kph)
                    keep_lane()
                jam_vehicle_group.group_drive()
                give_way_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane()
                    position(time: [2..3]s, at: end,
                        behind: sut.car, run_mode: best_effort)
                follow_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                duration([1..3]s, tolerance: 5s)

            # In this phase, the jam_vehicle starts to move again
            under_way_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                sut.car.drive() with:
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end,
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    # This is a workaround to ensure that the lane change happens
                    # This will ensure that the NolaneChange soft constraint 
                    # is overridden
                    change_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    speed(gen_traffic_vehicles_speed_at_end, at: end, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end,
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                jam_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane()
                    speed(gen_traffic_vehicles_speed_at_end, at: end, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                jam_vehicle_group.group_drive()
                give_way_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane()
                    speed(gen_traffic_vehicles_speed_at_end, at: end, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                follow_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                duration([1..20]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            # In this phase, all the vehicles continue to move in their lanes
            end_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                sut.car.drive() with:
                    speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_post_phase: along(road_to_force_merge_path.successor_lane, 
                        at: end)
                lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                jam_vehicle.drive() with:
                    # The lane can end which jam_vehicle is travelling
                    # so to avoid incomplete in such a situation the keep
                    # lane is made as best effort
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                jam_vehicle_group.group_drive()
                give_way_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane()
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    position(time: give_way_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_end, at: end,
                        behind: sut.car, run_mode: best_effort)
                follow_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                duration([10..40]s, tolerance: 50s)

        serial:
            wait @ego_stopped
            log_info("$(self): ending scenario after Ego stopped for"+\
                "$(ego_complete_stand_still_time).")
        serial:
            wait @ego_merge_end_condition
            log_info("$(self): The Ego merged successfully into target lane "+\
                "and passed 10s.")

    on @ego_stopped:
        call other_warning(ego_stopped_warning, 
            "Ego was not able to merge into target lane.")
    
    # To ensure the scenario runs long enough, the Ego is expected 
    # to move to the successor lane of road_to_force_merge using the along modifier. 
    # Once the merge is completed, the along modifier is 
    # changed to best_effort, as the intent has been achieved
    on @sut.car.switch_lane_end:
        override(intent_assist_ego_along_at_post_phase,
            run_mode:best_effort)
        call logger.log_info("The Ego performed a lane change, "+\
            "triggering the switch_lane_end event")

extend gen_config:
    set use_old_no_overtake = true # disable dynamic NoOvertake constraint to increase solving performance

                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: start)
                    speed(speed: [gen_average_vehicle_group_speed - average_vehicle_group_speed_offset..\ 
                        gen_average_vehicle_group_speed + average_vehicle_group_speed_offset])
                vehicle_group.group_drive()                    
            with:
                duration([6..26]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            merge: parallel(overlap: equal):
                sut.car.drive() with:
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end,
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    # This is a workaround to ensure that the lane change happens
                    # This will ensure that the NolaneChange soft constraint 
                    # is overridden
                    change_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                lead_vehicle_for_vehicle_group.drive() with:
                    position(time: lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego, ahead_of: sut.car, 
                        at: start, run_mode: best_effort)    
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                duration([5..40]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)
            
            post_merge: parallel(overlap: equal):
                sut.car.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode:best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_post_phase: along(road_to_force_merge_path.successor_lane, 
                        at: end)
                lead_vehicle_for_vehicle_group.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode:best_effort)
                vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                duration([1..5]s,tolerance:phase_time_tolerance)
        
        scenario_end: serial():
            wait @ego_stopped
            log_info("Ego speed was slower than $(standstill_threshold) for +\
                longer than $(ego_complete_stand_still_time)")

        serial():
            wait @ego_merge_end_condition
            log_info("$(self): The Ego merged successfully into target lane "+\
                "and passed 10s.")

    on @ego_stopped:
        call other_warning(ego_stopped_warning, 
            "Ego was not able to merge into the target lane.")
    
    # To ensure the scenario runs long enough, the Ego is expected 
    # to move to the successor lane of road_to_force_merge using the along modifier. 
    # Once the merge is completed, the along modifier is 
    # changed to best_effort, as the intent has been achieved
    on @sut.car.switch_lane_end:
        override(intent_assist_ego_along_at_post_phase,
            run_mode:best_effort)
        call logger.log_info("The Ego performed a lane change, "+\
            "triggering the switch_lane_end event")

# In this scenario the Ego is driving towards a forced merge location at 
# which it must merge into a gap between adjacent vehicles. The lead_vehicle,
# follow_vehicle_1, follow_vehicle_2 with its car_group form a group 
# that drive on a lane/path other than Ego towards the merge location. 
# Forced merge locations are locations, where vehicles 
# need to merge onto an adjacent lane and/or into adjacent traffic as they are 
# prevented from continuing on the same lane or path. These locations include 
# lane endings, highway on-ramp. 
#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    gen_ego_speed_at_start (Ego speed at start [0..33]mps)
#    gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start (
#    Ego lon lane distance to start of merge location at start)
#    gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge (Lead vehicle speed [0..40]mps)
#    gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start 
#    (Lead vehicle time gap to forced merge location at start [3..15]s)
#    gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start 
#    (Lead vehicle time 
#    gap to forced merge location at merge phase start [1..5]s)
#    gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_initial_phase 
#    (follow vehicle time gap
#    to lead vehicle at initial phase [1..5]s)
#    gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego (follow vehicle time gap to 
#    Ego maintained in
#    and post merge phase [1..3]s)
#    gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start (follow 
#    vehicle relative speed to lead vehicle at start [-5..5]mps
#    gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_merge_phase_start 
#    (follow vehicle time gap
#    to lead vehicle at merge phase start [1..5]s)
#    gen_number_of_vehicles_in_vehicle_group( Number of vehicles follow 
#    follow_vehicle_2 -> 10)

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/ego_merge/ego_merge_common/ego_merge_common_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/common/ego_with_traffic_on_side/ego_with_traffic_on_side_top.osc"

scenario sut.ego_merge_at_characteristic_forced_merge_locations inherits ego_merge_common:


    # Ego attributes

            [(gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge*gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start - \
            lead_vehicle.get_length()/2)..\
            (gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge*gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start + \

    gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start: time with:
        keep(default it in [3..15]s)
        keep(it > gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start)
    lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start: length
    keep(lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start in
        [(gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge*gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start - \
            lead_vehicle.get_length()/2)..\
            (gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge*gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start + \

    gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
        keep(it > gen_ego_speed_at_start)

    # follow vehicle 1 attributes   
    follow_vehicle_1: vehicle

    gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start: speed

    # follow vehicle 2 attributes

# Copyright (C) 2025 Foretellix Ltd (“Foretellix”)
# This source code file is licensed to you under Foretellix’ End User License
# Agreement, you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You are not allowed to distribute it to any third party without Foretellix’
# written approval.
# If you choose to modify this code (in compliance with the license terms),
# you do it at your own risk, and Foretellix will no longer supply any

# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

import "$FTX/tool/events/highway_merge_tracking.osc"
extend sim_config:
    set default_tl_color = green

extend sut.ego_merge_at_characteristic_forced_merge_locations:

    # The lead_vehicle junction behavior is disabled to achieve the distance
    # provided
    keep(lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == false)
    
    # Offset used in scenario
    distance_offset: length
    keep(default distance_offset == 20m)
    distance_tolerance: length
    keep(default distance_tolerance == 20m)
    speed_offset: speed
    keep(default speed_offset == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_offset)
    
    ego_lon_distance_to_vehicle: length

    # The native method is to find the closest ahead and behind vehicle
    # of Ego after it merges between the traffic
    # Conditions applied are:
    # 1. One by one the vehicle is checked whether it is Ego and its
    # positioned is initialized
    # 2. The relative distance is calculated between Ego and each vehicle
    # This distance is then compared with 0m and max value(can be assumed as 1000m)
    # If the distance matches condition then the vehicle is assigned
    # and returned by method 
    def check_closest_behind_vehicle_of_ego() -> vehicle is:
        var closest_behind_vehicle: vehicle = null
        var min_dist: length = -1000m
        for vehicle in traffic.cars:
            if not vehicle.is_dut and vehicle.state != null:
                ego_lon_distance_to_vehicle = map.distance_from_ref_position(\
                        sut.car.state.msp_pos.road_position,
                            vehicle.state.msp_pos.road_position)
                if(ego_lon_distance_to_vehicle < 0m and ego_lon_distance_to_vehicle > min_dist):
                    min_dist = ego_lon_distance_to_vehicle
                    closest_behind_vehicle = vehicle
        return closest_behind_vehicle

    def check_closest_ahead_vehicle_of_ego() -> vehicle is:
        var closest_ahead_vehicle: vehicle = null
        var min_dist: length = 1000m
        for vehicle in traffic.cars:
            if not vehicle.is_dut and vehicle.state != null:
                ego_lon_distance_to_vehicle = map.distance_from_ref_position(\
                        sut.car.state.msp_pos.road_position,
                            vehicle.state.msp_pos.road_position)
                if(ego_lon_distance_to_vehicle > 0m and ego_lon_distance_to_vehicle < min_dist):
                    min_dist = ego_lon_distance_to_vehicle
                    closest_ahead_vehicle = vehicle
        return closest_ahead_vehicle

    # Speed deviation and initial TTC of the follow_vehicle_2_group vehicles
    # gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_initial_phase is 
    # the TTC provided to car_group which maintains it
    # throughout the scenario
    for member in follow_vehicle_2_group.members_params:
        keep(member.initial_speed_percentage in [90..110])
        keep(default member.min_initial_ttc == \
            gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_initial_phase)
    
    # Driver model is provided to car group which will maintain
    # the initial lane
    keep_lane_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model with:
        keep(it.change_lane_eagerness == 0)   
    for vehicle in follow_vehicle_2_group.cars:
        keep(vehicle.initial_bm == keep_lane_driver_model)
    keep(keep_lane_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)

    # Speed to car group is provided as same as of follow_vehicle_1
    # and follow_vehicle_2
    keep(keep_lane_driver_model.target_speed in \
        [gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge - \
            gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start..
                    gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge + \
                        gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start])

    # Sampled the native method at each step
    var closest_behind_vehicle_at_each_step_time := \
        sample(check_closest_behind_vehicle_of_ego(), @top.clk)
    var closest_ahead_vehicle_at_each_step_time := \
        sample(check_closest_ahead_vehicle_of_ego(), @top.clk)

    lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_ego_at_end_of_initial_phase: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)

    on @phase_essence_initial.start:
       emit initial_phase_at_start_event

    on @phase_essence_initial.end:
        emit initial_phase_at_end_event

    do phase_essence: first_of:
        ego_merge_at_characteristic_forced_merge_locations: serial():

            # In this phase the Ego starts to drive with ego_start_at_speed,
            # and covers distance of gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start
            # from the merge location.
            # The lead_vehicle starts  on a lane/path other than the ego at a distance
            # lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start from the merge
            # location with a speed gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge.
            # The follow_vehicle_1, follow_vehicle_2 and its car group
            # starts on the same lane as the lead_vehicle at a distance
            # of gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_initial_phase
            # behind the lead_vehicle and a relative speed of
            # gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start.
            phase_essence_initial: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_initial: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_lead_vehicle_distance_at_essence_initial: distance([((lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start - \
                        lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start) \
                        - distance_offset)..((lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start - \
                        lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start) \
                        + distance_offset)], 
                        tolerance: distance_tolerance)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_initial: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_initial_start: speed([gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge..\
                        gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge + speed_offset],
                        at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_position_at_essence_initial_end: position(time: lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_ego_at_end_of_initial_phase, 
                        ahead_of: sut.car, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_follow_vehicle_1_at_essence_initial: follow_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                    intent_follow_vehicle_1_position_at_essence_initial_start:\
                        position(time: gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_initial_phase, 
                            at: start, behind: lead_vehicle)
                    intent_follow_vehicle_1_lane_at_essence_initial_start: lane(same_as: lead_vehicle,at: start)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_1_keep_lane_at_essence_initial: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_follow_vehicle_1_speed_at_essence_initial_start: speed([gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge - \
                        gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start..
                        gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge + \
                        gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start], at: start)
                drive_follow_vehicle_2_at_essence_initial: follow_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                    intent_follow_vehicle_2_position_at_essence_initial_start:\
                        position(time: gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_initial_phase, 
                            at: start, behind: follow_vehicle_1)
                    intent_follow_vehicle_2_lane_at_essence_initial_start: lane(same_as: lead_vehicle,at:start)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_2_keep_lane_at_essence_initial: keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                    intent_follow_vehicle_2_speed_at_essence_initial_start: speed([gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge - \
                        gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start..
                        gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_merge + \
                        gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start], at: start)
                drive_follow_vehicle_2_group_at_essence_initial: follow_vehicle_2_group.group_drive()
                drive_ego_at_essence_initial: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_initial_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_initial: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_initial: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_ego_distance_at_essence_initial: distance([(gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                        - distance_offset)..(gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                        + distance_offset)], 
                        tolerance: distance_tolerance)
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_initial_end: along(road_to_force_merge_location, at: end, 
                        start_offset: [10..20]m,
                                run_mode: best_effort)
            with:
                # The duration is calculated by,
                # [(min_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ 
                # max_ego_speed_at_start)..\
                # 2 * (max_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ 
                # max_ego_speed_at_start)]
                # This will ensure that Ego travels the distance and reach
                # at start_offset of  road_to_force_merge_location
                intent_essence_initial_duration: duration([6..25]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            # At the start of this phase the Ego, follow_vehicle_1
            # follow_vehicle_2, its car group and lead_vehicle
            # approach the merging location from different paths/lanes.
            # At the end of the phase, the Ego merges into the lane of lead vehicle.
            phase_essence_merge: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_merge: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_along_at_essence_merge_start: along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, 
                        end_offset: [lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start -\
                        distance_offset..lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start +\
                        distance_offset],
                        at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_follow_vehicle_1_at_essence_merge: follow_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_1_position_at_essence_merge_start:\
                        position(time: gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_merge_phase_start,
                        behind: lead_vehicle, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_1_keep_lane_at_essence_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_1_position_at_essence_merge_end:\
                        position(time: gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego,
                        behind: lead_vehicle, at: end, track: actual, measure_by: nearest,
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_follow_vehicle_2_at_essence_merge: follow_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_2_position_at_essence_merge_start:\
                        position(time: gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_merge_phase_start,
                            behind: follow_vehicle_1, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_2_keep_lane_at_essence_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_2_position_at_essence_merge_end:\
                        position(time: gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego,
                        behind: follow_vehicle_1, at: end, track: actual, measure_by: nearest,
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_follow_vehicle_2_group_at_essence_merge: follow_vehicle_2_group.group_drive()
                drive_ego_at_essence_merge: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_merge_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_merge_end: along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                    # This is a workaround to ensure that the lane change happens
                    # This will ensure that the NolaneChange soft constraint 
                    # is overridden
                    intent_assist_ego_change_lane_at_essence_merge: change_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            with:
                intent_essence_merge_duration: duration([3..20]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            # In this phase the Ego, follow_vehicle_2, its car_group
            # and lead vehicle continue driving and follow_vehicle_1
            # maintains gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego with Ego
            phase_essence_post_merge: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_post_merge: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_post_merge: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_post_merge: keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                drive_follow_vehicle_1_at_essence_post_merge: follow_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_1_keep_lane_at_essence_post_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_1_keep_speed_at_essence_post_merge: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_follow_vehicle_2_at_essence_post_merge: follow_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_2_keep_lane_at_essence_post_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_2_keep_speed_at_essence_post_merge: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_follow_vehicle_2_group_at_essence_post_merge: follow_vehicle_2_group.group_drive()
                drive_ego_at_essence_post_merge: sut.car.drive() with:

            wait @ego_stopped

                "$(ego_complete_stand_still_time).")

            log_info("$(self): The Ego merged successfully into target lane "+\
                "and passed 10s.")

# This scenario consists of the common coverage parameters of the merging scenarios
extend sut.ego_merge_common:
    event initial_phase_at_start_event

    event  initial_phase_at_end_event

    phase_time_tolerance: time
    keep(default phase_time_tolerance == 20s)
   
    # If the road to force merge length is less than 100m then
    # the ego_complete_stand_still_time will be 5s
    def ego_stopper_timer(road : road_to_force_merge) -> time is:
        var ego_complete_stand_still_time_offset: time
        if road.length > 100m:
            ego_complete_stand_still_time_offset = 10s
            return ego_complete_stand_still_time_offset
        else:
            ego_complete_stand_still_time_offset = 5s
            return ego_complete_stand_still_time_offset

    # The Ego will be compared with this value and if 
    # Ego being slower than standstill_threshold for longer than 10s
    # then the scenario will end
    var ego_complete_stand_still_time: time = sample(\
        ego_stopper_timer(road_to_force_merge_location),
        @start)
    
    standstill_threshold: speed with:
        keep(default it == 1kph)

    # Ego state is not null
    event clock is (sut.car.state != null)

    # The Event checks the following:
    # 1. Egos speed is less than standstill_threshold
    # 2. Egos previous state was not null and also prev state speed 
    # was greater than standstill_threshold to ensure that timer should reset if Ego 
    # speed goes above standstill_threshold after slowing.
    event ego_stopped_event is @clock if (sut.car.state.speed < standstill_threshold \
        and sut.car.prev_state != null 
        and sut.car.prev_state.speed > standstill_threshold)

    var ego_stopped_time: time = sample(top.time, @ego_stopped_event)
    var ego_stopped_bool: bool = sample(true, @ego_stopped_event)
    set ego_stopped_bool = false
    
    # Ego stopped event
    # Checks if Ego is slower than standstill_threshold for a delay of 
    # 'ego_complete_stand_still_time'
    event ego_stopped is @clock if (ego_stopped_bool == true and top.time \
        > (ego_stopped_time + ego_complete_stand_still_time))

    # Event to reset the timer once Ego speeds up after slowing down
    event ego_stops_and_moves is @clock if (sut.car.state.speed > standstill_threshold \
        and sut.car.prev_state != null 
        and sut.car.prev_state.speed < standstill_threshold)
    
    on @ego_stops_and_moves:
        set ego_stopped_time = 0s
        set ego_stopped_bool = false

    var ego_switched_lane_simulation_time: time = sample(top.time, 
        @sut.car.switch_lane_end)
    var ego_switched_lane: bool = sample(true, @sut.car.switch_lane_end)
    set ego_switched_lane = false
    
    # Event has following condition:
    # 1. If Ego switch lane where switch_lane_end is being used.
    # 2. If Ego has travelled more than 10s after merge into highway
    event ego_merge_end_condition is @top.clk if (\
        ego_switched_lane == true and top.time >= \
        ego_switched_lane_simulation_time + 10s)

    # The Ego will be compared with this value and if

    time_delay: time with:
        keep(default it == 10s)

       emit initial_phase_at_start_event

    on @phase_essence_initial.end:
        emit initial_phase_at_end_event

    do phase_essence: first_of:
        # In this phase the ego does two forced merges in short succession.
        # The scenario ends in between if the ego stops for 5s.

        consecutive_ego_mergeing_phases: serial():

            phase_essence_initial: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_essence_initial: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_ego_speed_at_essence_initial_start:\
                        speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, tolerance: 18kph, at: start)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_initial: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_ego_along_at_essence_initial_start: along(highway_entry, end_offset: \
                        gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start, 
                            tolerance: 10m, at: start)
                drive_lane_1_lead_vehicle_at_essence_initial: lane_1_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lane_1_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_initial: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lane_1_traffic_vehicle_at_essence_initial: lane_1_traffic_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lane_1_traffic_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_initial: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lane_2_lead_vehicle_at_essence_initial: lane_2_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lane_2_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_initial: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lane_2_traffic_vehicle_at_essence_initial: lane_2_traffic_vehicle.drive()
            with:
                intent_essence_initial_duration: duration(initial_phase_duration, tolerance: initial_phase_tolerance)
            # This phase begins when vehicles enter the area that 
            # is marked by first_merging_phase.
            # Vehicles are driving with a steady speed of traffic_speed. 
            # The ego starts with gen_ego_speed_at_start.
            # First and second lane vehicles are positioned with
            # gen_time_gap_between_lane_1_vehicles and gen_time_gap_between_lane_2_vehicles gap.
            phase_essence_first_merging: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_essence_first_merging: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_ego_along_first_merge_road_at_essence_first_merging_start: along(first_merge_road, at: start)
                    intent_ego_along_at_essence_first_merging_start: along(traffic_road, at: start)
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_first_merging_end: along(traffic_road, at: end, 
                        end_offset: first_merge_road.force_merge_offset_from_end, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_change_lane_at_essence_first_merging: change_lane(1, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lane_1_lead_vehicle_at_essence_first_merging: lane_1_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_lane_1_lead_vehicle_along_at_essence_first_merging_start: along(traffic_road, at: start)
                    intent_lane_1_lead_vehicle_lane_at_essence_first_merging_start: lane(lane: 2, from: curb, at: start)
                    intent_assist_lane_1_lead_vehicle_position_at_essence_first_merging_start:\
                        position(time: ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_first_merging_phase_start, 
                            ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lane_1_traffic_vehicle_at_essence_first_merging: lane_1_traffic_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_lane_1_traffic_vehicle_along_at_essence_first_merging_start: along(traffic_road, at: start)
                    intent_assist_lane_1_traffic_vehicle_lane_at_essence_first_merging_start: lane(same_as: lane_1_lead_vehicle, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lane_1_traffic_vehicle_position_at_essence_first_merging_start:\

                    intent_assist_lane_1_traffic_vehicle_position_at_essence_first_merging_end:\

                drive_lane_2_lead_vehicle_at_essence_first_merging: lane_2_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_lane_2_lead_vehicle_along_at_essence_first_merging_start: along(traffic_road, at: start)
                    intent_lane_2_lead_vehicle_lane_at_essence_first_merging_start: lane(left_of: lane_1_traffic_vehicle, at: start)
                    intent_assist_lane_2_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_first_merging_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lane_2_traffic_vehicle_at_essence_first_merging: lane_2_traffic_vehicle.drive() with:

        # This phase drive is in between the first and second merge area.
            phase_essence_highway_traffic: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_essence_highway_traffic: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_highway_traffic_start: along(highway_drive, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lane_1_lead_vehicle_at_essence_highway_traffic: lane_1_lead_vehicle.drive() with:

                    intent_assist_lane_1_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_highway_traffic: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lane_1_lead_vehicle_lane_at_essence_highway_traffic_end: lane(same_as: lane_2_lead_vehicle, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                    
                drive_lane_1_traffic_vehicle_at_essence_highway_traffic: lane_1_traffic_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lane_1_traffic_vehicle_speed_at_essence_highway_traffic: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                    
                drive_lane_2_lead_vehicle_at_essence_highway_traffic: lane_2_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lane_2_lead_vehicle_along_at_essence_highway_traffic_end: along(highway_drive, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lane_2_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_highway_traffic: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lane_2_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_highway_traffic: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lane_2_traffic_vehicle_at_essence_highway_traffic: lane_2_traffic_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lane_2_traffic_vehicle_position_at_essence_highway_traffic:\
                        position(time: gen_time_gap_between_lane_2_vehicles, 
                            behind: lane_2_lead_vehicle, run_mode: best_effort)
            with:
                intent_essence_highway_traffic_duration: duration(highway_traffic_drive_duration, tolerance: highway_traffic_drive_tolerance)

        # This phase begins when vehicles enter the are from more number of lanes to less number of lanes.
            phase_essence_second_merging: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_essence_second_merging: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_second_merging_end: along(second_merge_road, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lane_1_lead_vehicle_at_essence_second_merging: lane_1_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lane_1_lead_vehicle_position_at_essence_second_merging_end:\
                        position(time: gen_combined_lane_time_gap, 
                            behind: lane_2_lead_vehicle, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lane_1_traffic_vehicle_at_essence_second_merging: lane_1_traffic_vehicle.drive()
                drive_lane_2_lead_vehicle_at_essence_second_merging: lane_2_lead_vehicle.drive()
            with:
                intent_essence_second_merging_duration: duration(merging_phase_duration, tolerance: initial_phase_tolerance)

        with:
                intent_ego_distance: sut.car.distance([gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start..])

        serial:
            wait @ego_stopped
            log_info("$(self): ending scenario after Ego stopped for"+\
                "$(ego_complete_stand_still_time).")

    on @ego_stopped:
        call other_warning(ego_stopped_warning, 
            "Ego was not able to merge into target lane.")
        
    # In order to ensure the scenario executes long enough for having a merge,
    # a distance modifier is used or ensuring ego drives the entire road to 
    # force merge location. one merge happened, the distance modifier is set 
    # to best_effort since intent is met
    on @sut.car.switch_lane_end:
        override(intent_ego_distance,run_mode:best_effort)

# sut::ego_merge_at_zipper_merge
# In this scenario, both the Ego vehicle and the merge vehicle are 
# approaching a forced merge location, where they must perform a 
# zipper merge by alternately merging into a gap between adjacent vehicles. 
# The lead_vehicle, middle_vehicle, and follow_vehicle, along with its 
# car_group, form a separate group of vehicles that are driving on a different 
# lane or path than the Ego and merge vehicles, all heading 
# towards the merge location.
# Forced merge locations are specific points on the road where vehicles 
# are required to merge onto an adjacent lane or into adjacent 
# traffic because they are unable to 
# continue on the same lane or path. These locations include 
# lane endings and highway on-ramps. 
#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    gen_ego_speed_at_start(Ego speed at start)
#    gen_ego_time_gap_to_merge_vehicle_at_start(Ego time gap 
#    to merge vehicle at start)
#    gen_lead_vehicle_speed(Lead vehicle speed)
#    gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start
#    (Lead vehicle time gap to forced merged location at start)
#    gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start
#    (Lead vehicle time gap to forced merged location at vehicle merge 
#    phase start)
#    gen_merge_vehicle_speed(Merge vehicle speed)
#    merge_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start
#    (Merge vehicle time gap to forced merged location at start)
#    gen_merge_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase
#    (Merge vehicle time gap to lead vehicle at ego merge phase)
#    gen_middle_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start
#    (Middle vehicle time gap to lead vehicle at start)
#    gen_middle_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start
#    (Middle vehicle relative speed to lead vehicle at vehicle 
#    merge phase start)
#    gen_middle_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start
#    (Middle vehicle time gap to lead vehicle at vehicle merge phase 
#    start)
#    gen_middle_vehicle_desired_time_gap(Middle vehicle desired time gap)
#    gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_start
#    (follow vehicle time gap to middle vehicle at start)
#    gen_follow_vehicle_desired_time_gap(follow vehicle 
#    desired time gap)
#    gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_middle_vehicle_at_start
#    (follow vehicle relative speed to middle vehicle at start)
#    gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase_start
#    (follow vehicle time gap to middle vehicle at ego merge phase
#    start)
#    gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type(Merge vehicle 
#    conspicuity_state_type)
#    gen_number_of_vehicles_in_vehicle_group(Number of vehicles in 
#    follow_vehicle_car_group)
#    gen_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start (Merge vehicle 
#    lon lane distance to merge location at start)

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/ego_merge/ego_merge_common/ego_merge_common_top.osc"
import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/ftx/ftx_group_driver_model.osc"

enum conspicuity_state_list: [hazard_lights_on, left_indicator_on, 
    right_indicator_on, no_lights]


scenario sut.ego_merge_at_zipper_merge inherits ego_merge_common:

    # Ego attributes

    gen_ego_time_gap_to_merge_vehicle_at_start: time
    keep(default gen_ego_time_gap_to_merge_vehicle_at_start in [7..40]s)

    # Lead vehicle attributes
    lead_vehicle: vehicle
    gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start: time with:
        keep(default it in [1..25]s)
    gen_lead_vehicle_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start)
    lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start: length with:
        keep(default it in [gen_lead_vehicle_speed * \
        gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start - \
        (lead_vehicle.get_length()/2) ..\
        gen_lead_vehicle_speed * gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start + \
        (lead_vehicle.get_length()/2)])
    lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start: length with:
        keep(it in [gen_lead_vehicle_speed * \
        gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start - \
        (lead_vehicle.get_length()/2) ..\
        gen_lead_vehicle_speed * \
        gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start + \
        (lead_vehicle.get_length()/2)])

    # Merge vehicle attributes
    merge_vehicle: vehicle
    gen_merge_vehicle_speed: speed
    keep(default gen_merge_vehicle_speed in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    gen_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start: length with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location)
    gen_merge_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase: time
    keep(default gen_merge_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase in \
        ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_other_vehicle)

    # Merge vehicle conspicuity
    gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type: conspicuity_state_list with:
        keep(it in [hazard_lights_on, left_indicator_on, right_indicator_on,
            no_lights])
    hazard_light_type: av_state
    turn_signal_state: turn_signal_state
    keep(gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type == \
        hazard_lights_on => hazard_light_type == active)
    keep(gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type == \
        left_indicator_on => turn_signal_state == left_on)
    keep(gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type == \
        right_indicator_on => turn_signal_state == right_on)
    keep(gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type == \
        no_lights => (turn_signal_state == off and hazard_light_type == off))

    # Middle vehicle attributes
    middle_vehicle: vehicle
    gen_middle_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_other_vehicle)
    gen_middle_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_relative_traffic_speed_range)
    middle_vehicle_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in [gen_lead_vehicle_speed..
            gen_lead_vehicle_speed + gen_middle_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start])
    gen_middle_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_other_vehicle)
    gen_middle_vehicle_desired_time_gap: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_other_vehicle)

    # Follow vehicle attributes   
    follow_vehicle: vehicle
    gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_start: time
    keep(default gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_start in \
        ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_other_vehicle)
    gen_follow_vehicle_desired_time_gap: time
    keep(default gen_follow_vehicle_desired_time_gap in \
        ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)
    gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_middle_vehicle_at_start: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_relative_traffic_speed_range)
    gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase_start:time with:
        keep(default it in [4..10]s)

     # Car group followed by follow_vehicle attributes
    gen_number_of_vehicles_in_vehicle_group: int with:
        keep(default it in \
            ftlx_lib_base_config.default_number_of_vehicles_in_vehicle_group)
    follow_vehicle_group: single_lane_car_group with(
        reference_car: follow_vehicle):
        keep(it.cars.size() == gen_number_of_vehicles_in_vehicle_group)

# Copyright (C) 2025 Foretellix Ltd (“Foretellix”)
# This source code file is licensed to you under Foretellix’ End User License
# Agreement, you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You are not allowed to distribute it to any third party without Foretellix’
# written approval.
# If you choose to modify this code (in compliance with the license terms),
# you do it at your own risk, and Foretellix will no longer supply any
