# Copyright (C) 2025 Foretellix Ltd (“Foretellix”)
# This source code file is licensed to you under Foretellix’ End User License
# Agreement, you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You are not allowed to distribute it to any third party without Foretellix’
# written approval.
# If you choose to modify this code (in compliance with the license terms),
# you do it at your own risk, and Foretellix will no longer supply any
# support or maintenance services for this source code.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
extend person:
   keep(physical.max_yaw_rate == 90degree_per_second)

extend cyclist:
   keep(physical.max_yaw_rate == 45degree_per_second)

extend sut.vru_group_crossing_marked_crosswalk:

  # Calculating number of lanes using Ego car current state
  number_of_lanes: int
  keep(number_of_lanes == road_to_crosswalk.one_way_road.max_lanes)

  #protection against unsupported combination
  keep ((gen_vru_initial_position == nearside_behind and \
    gen_vru_final_position == farside_ahead) or \
      (gen_vru_initial_position == farside_ahead and \
        gen_vru_final_position == nearside_behind ))
  
  # Offset for approximating position of crosswalk on
  # 'road_on_crosswalk'
  road_crosswalk_offset: length with:
    keep(it == 7m)

  # Road definition
  # The road_on_crosswalk is the path where the vru cross the
  # road and the road_to_crosswalk is the road which has crosswalk.
  road_on_crosswalk: road_on_crosswalk
  farside_road_on_crosswalk: road_on_crosswalk

  keep(road_on_crosswalk.kind == on_two_way)
  keep(road_on_crosswalk.crosswalk_id == \
    farside_road_on_crosswalk.crosswalk_id)
  keep(road_on_crosswalk.id != farside_road_on_crosswalk.id)

  road_to_crosswalk: road_to_crosswalk
  keep(road_to_crosswalk.road_on_crosswalk_id == road_on_crosswalk.id)

  farside_road_to_crosswalk:road_to_crosswalk
  keep(farside_road_to_crosswalk.road_on_crosswalk_id == \
    farside_road_on_crosswalk.id)

  vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_start:road_to_crosswalk
  keep(gen_vru_initial_position == nearside_behind => vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_start == road_to_crosswalk)
  keep(gen_vru_initial_position == farside_ahead => vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_start == farside_road_to_crosswalk)

  vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_end:road_to_crosswalk
  keep(gen_vru_initial_position == nearside_behind => vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_end == farside_road_to_crosswalk)
  keep(gen_vru_initial_position == farside_ahead => vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_end == road_to_crosswalk)

  vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_start:road_on_crosswalk
  keep(gen_vru_initial_position == nearside_behind => vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_start == road_on_crosswalk)
  keep(gen_vru_initial_position == farside_ahead => vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_start == farside_road_on_crosswalk)

  vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_end:road_on_crosswalk
  keep(gen_vru_initial_position == nearside_behind => vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_end == farside_road_on_crosswalk)
  keep(gen_vru_initial_position == farside_ahead => vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_end == road_on_crosswalk)

  # Road length ahead crosswalk
  vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_start_length: length with:
    keep(it == vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_start.length)

  vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_end_length: length with:
    keep(it == vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_end.length)

  # The lane width is assumed to be 3.5m on the road in which
  # Ego is moving
  lane_width: length with:
    keep(default it == 3.5m)

  # The latitudinal offset of vru to road where Ego is nearside
  # is kept negative such that the vru is moving on the sidewalk
  # which is situated on the right side of Ego
  vru_lat_offset_to_road_at_ego_nearside: length with:
    keep(it == -1 * lane_width + gen_vru_group_road_lat_offset_at_start_position)

  # The latitudinal offset of vru to road where Ego is farside
  # is calculated by taking the number of lanes and their width
  # as the distance the VRU would need to cross the road and reach
  # the side walk on the farside post crossing
  vru_lat_offset_to_road_at_ego_farside: length with:
    keep(it == ((2*number_of_lanes)*(lane_width)))


  # The pre cross distance is calculated by taking vru group speed
  # and the time gap between VRU and the crosswalk, this distance
  # would be covered by the VRU between its start and first position
  # while moving on the sidewalk
  vru_sidewalk_dist_pre_cross: length with:
    keep(it == gen_vru_group_speed*gen_vru_rel_time_gap_to_crosswalk_at_start)
  vru_pre_cross_duration : time with:
    keep(it in [2..5]second)
    keep(it in [((vru_sidewalk_dist_pre_cross/gen_vru_group_speed)\
      -1s)..((vru_sidewalk_dist_pre_cross/gen_vru_group_speed)+1s)])

  # VRU cross duration will impact the  distance that VRU will cover while
  # it crosses the crosswalk, it is the distance between the first
  # and the second position of the VRU
  vru_cross_duration : time with:
    keep(it in [2..8]second)
    keep(it in [((vru_lat_offset_to_road_at_ego_farside/gen_vru_group_speed)\
      -1s)..((vru_lat_offset_to_road_at_ego_farside/gen_vru_group_speed)+1s)])

  # This distance is calculated using the time gap between the second
  # and the final position. This distance will be covered by VRU while
  # moving from second to final position on the sidewalk
  vru_sidewalk_dist_post_cross: length with:
    keep(it == gen_vru_group_speed*gen_vru_time_gap_to_end_pos_after_crossing)

  # Add a factor of 3 seconds due to the fact that
  # we need to take into account that we are walking from somewhere in the road_on_crosswalk 
  # edge and not directly starting from road_to_crosswalk
  # and we also need to consider the time it takes the VRU to rotate
  vru_post_cross_duration : time with:
    keep(it in [gen_vru_time_gap_to_end_pos_after_crossing+2s..\
      gen_vru_time_gap_to_end_pos_after_crossing+3s])

  # Vru start position longitudinal offset
  vru_start_pos_lon_offset: length with:
    keep(it == vru_sidewalk_dist_pre_cross \
      + vru_sidewalk_dist_post_cross - road_crosswalk_offset)

  # Starting position of VRU
  # At this position VRU will initially start walking on the sidewalk
  # to reach the first position
  vru_group_start_position: msp_position
  vru_group_start_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
    keep(it.min_distance_between_objects==1m)
    keep(it.max_distance_between_objects==2m)
    keep(it.min_lat_offset == -1m)
    keep(it.max_lat_offset == 1m)

  # First position of VRU after starting position
  # At this position VRU has covered 'gen_vru_rel_time_gap_to_crosswalk_at_start'
  # and is laterally placed to cross the road on the marken crosswalk
  vru_group_first_position: msp_position
  vru_group_first_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
    keep(it.min_distance_between_objects==1m)
    keep(it.max_distance_between_objects==2m)
    keep(it.min_lat_offset == -1m)
    keep(it.max_lat_offset == 1m)

  # Second position of VRU after first position
  # This is the position on the opposite sidewalk which the VRU will reach
  # after crossing the marked crosswalk
  vru_group_sec_position: msp_position
  vru_group_sec_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
    keep(it.min_distance_between_objects==1m)
    keep(it.max_distance_between_objects==2m)
    keep(it.min_lat_offset == -1m)
    keep(it.max_lat_offset == 1m)

  # Final position of VRU
  # This is the position at which VRU finishes its journey after crossing
  # the marked crosswalk and covering the 'gen_vru_time_gap_to_end_pos_after_crossing'
  # at the same sidewalk
  vru_group_end_position: msp_position
  vru_group_end_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
    keep(it.min_distance_between_objects==1m)
    keep(it.max_distance_between_objects==2m)
    keep(it.min_lat_offset == -1m)
    keep(it.max_lat_offset == 1m)

  # Start position latitudinal and longitudinal
  # offset with respect to road_to_crosswalk
  start_pos_lat_offset : length
  start_pos_lon_offset : length

  # End position latitudinal and longitudinal
  # offset with respect to road_to_crosswalk
  end_pos_lat_offset : length
  end_pos_lon_offset : length

  # For a VRU starting from the nearside behind the crosswalk and 
  # ending its path at the farside ahead of the crosswalk,
  # we start the VRU from the nearside at vru_start_pos_lon_offset, 
  # behind the crosswalk moving
  # towards the first position at vru_lat_offset_to_road_at_ego_nearside 
  # and then laterally move to cross the road with  
  # vru_lat_offset_to_road_at_ego_farside to reach the second position
  # and then travel to the end position traversing vru_start_pos_lon_offset 
  # reaching the farside from the initial position, ahead of the crossroad
  keep (gen_vru_initial_position == nearside_behind and \
    gen_vru_final_position == farside_ahead => start_pos_lon_offset == \
      vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_start_length - vru_start_pos_lon_offset \
        and start_pos_lat_offset == vru_lat_offset_to_road_at_ego_nearside and\
          end_pos_lon_offset == vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_end_length - \
            vru_sidewalk_dist_post_cross \
              and end_pos_lat_offset == road_crosswalk_offset)

  keep (gen_vru_initial_position == \
    farside_ahead and gen_vru_final_position == \
      nearside_behind => start_pos_lon_offset == \
        vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_start_length - vru_start_pos_lon_offset \
          and start_pos_lat_offset == vru_lat_offset_to_road_at_ego_nearside and \
            end_pos_lon_offset == vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_end_length - \
              vru_sidewalk_dist_post_cross \
                and end_pos_lat_offset == road_crosswalk_offset)

  on @start:
    call logger.log_info("road_to_crosswalk: $(vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_start_length) lon offset $(start_pos_lon_offset) , lat offset $(start_pos_lat_offset)")

  vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_start_length: length with:
    keep(it == vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_start.length)
  vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_end_length: length with:
    keep(it == vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_end.length)

  vru_group_lon_offset_at_first_position: length with:
    keep(gen_vru_initial_position == farside_ahead => it == vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_start_length*(1.0 - (gen_vru_group_lon_offset_percentage_at_first_position*0.01)))
    keep(gen_vru_initial_position == nearside_behind => it == vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_start_length*(gen_vru_group_lon_offset_percentage_at_first_position*0.01))

  vru_group_lon_offset_at_sec_position: length with:
    keep(gen_vru_initial_position == farside_ahead => it == vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_end_length*(gen_vru_group_lon_offset_percentage_at_sec_position*0.01))
    keep(gen_vru_initial_position == nearside_behind => it == vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_end_length*(1.0 - (gen_vru_group_lon_offset_percentage_at_sec_position*0.01)))

  # Positioning of VRU along the road on which Ego is moving
  top.position_along_road(vru_group_start_position, 
    vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_start,
    lon_offset: start_pos_lon_offset, rightmost_lane: true, 
      lat_reference: right, lat_offset: -gen_vru_group_road_lat_offset_at_start_position)

  top.position_along_road(vru_group_first_position, vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_start,
    lon_offset: vru_group_lon_offset_at_first_position, 
      rightmost_lane: true, lat_reference: right, lat_offset: -gen_vru_group_road_lat_offset_at_first_position)

  top.position_along_road(vru_group_sec_position, vru_road_on_crosswalk_at_end,
    lon_offset: vru_group_lon_offset_at_sec_position, 
      rightmost_lane: true, lat_reference: right, lat_offset: -gen_vru_group_road_lat_offset_at_sec_position)

  top.position_along_road(vru_group_end_position, vru_road_to_crosswalk_at_end,
    lon_offset: end_pos_lon_offset, rightmost_lane: true, 
      lat_reference: right, lat_offset: -gen_vru_group_road_lat_offset_at_end_position)

  # Positioning the VRU group as per reference position
  top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(\
    vru_group_start_position_params, vru_group,vru_group_start_position)
  top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(\
    vru_group_first_position_params, vru_group, vru_group_first_position)
  # End positions are on the opposite side of the road, so we should rotate them by 180deg
  vru_group_sec_position_rotated: msp_position with:
    keep(it == vru_group_sec_position.at_rotated_offset(0m,180deg))
  top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(\
    vru_group_sec_position_params, vru_group, vru_group_sec_position_rotated)
  vru_group_end_position_rotated: msp_position with:
    keep(it == vru_group_end_position.at_rotated_offset(0m,180deg))
  top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(\
    vru_group_end_position_params, vru_group, vru_group_end_position_rotated)

  # Sample longitudinal distance (in seconds) between Ego and vru group
  # If the Ego speed is 0kph then the time to meet Ego is infinite.
  # So making up to this infinite time, value is given as 10000s as there
  # is no term as such as max_duration
  # The vru_group time to meet to Ego should be
  # calculated by vru distance to Ego.
  def get_distance_to_meet_ego(to_object: physical_object )->length is:
      var distance:length = 2147483647m
      var distance_road:length = math.abs(sut.car.road_distance(to_object,
        closest_compound,closest_compound,lon,lane))
      var distance_global:length = math.abs(sut.car.global_distance(to_object,
        closest_compound,closest_compound))
      if distance_global>distance_road or distance_road>=distance:
          distance = distance_global
      else:
          distance = distance_road
      return distance
        
  def vru_time_to_meet_ego()-> time is:
    var vru_group_time_to_meet_to_ego: time = 10000s
    if sut.car.state != null and sut.car.state.speed != 0kph:
        vru_group_time_to_meet_to_ego =  \
          get_distance_to_meet_ego(vru_group.objects[0])/ sut.car.state.speed
    logger.log_info("vru_group_crossing_marked_crosswalk: vru_group_time_to_meet_to_ego = $(vru_group_time_to_meet_to_ego)")
    return vru_group_time_to_meet_to_ego

  var vru_group_time_to_meet_to_ego := \
    sample(vru_time_to_meet_ego(), @top.clk)

  event post_drive_start
  var ego_distance_to_crosswalk_for_stopping_scenario:length = -10m
  var ego_distance_to_crosswalk:length = sample(map.distance_from_ref_position(
                sut.car.state.msp_pos.road_position, 
                road_on_crosswalk.get_position_on_road(\
                road_on_crosswalk.length)),@top.clk)
  
  # The event triggers when vru_group_time_to_meet_to_ego <
  # <= gen_time_to_trigger
  event vru_group_trigger_movement_event is @top.clk if \
      (vru_group_time_to_meet_to_ego <= gen_time_to_trigger)

  keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.enable == false)
  keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.ending_lane_behavior.enable == false)

  event vru_reached_cross_walk
  event vru_cross_start
  event vru_cross_end
  ego_distance_at_essence: length with:
        keep(default it in [100..]m)

scenario sut.vru_group_crossing_marked_crosswalk_without_random_vehicles \
  inherits vru_group_crossing_marked_crosswalk(random_vehicle_traffic_type == \
    without_random_vehicle):
  
  do phase_essence: first_of:
    # The Ego drives on a road with a crosswalk, meanwhile
    # the VRU group crosses the road.
    # Ego is moving on.
    phase_essence_vru_approaching_crosswalk: parallel(overlap: any, start_to_start: 0s):
      # Ego drives with gen_ego_speed_at_start towards the end it moves
      # along the road_to_crosswalk where VRU will cross
      # the road , Ego continues to move with the current speed.
      phase_essence_ego_drive: serial:
        drive_ego_at_essence_1: sut.car.drive() with:
          intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_ego_drive_start: speed(speed: gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start,
            run_mode: best_effort)
          intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_ego_drive: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
          intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_ego_drive_start: along(road_to_crosswalk, at: start, 
            end_offset: [80..]m, run_mode: best_effort)
          intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_ego_drive_end: along(road_on_crosswalk, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)

        drive_ego_at_essence_2: sut.car.drive() with:
          intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_ego_drive: speed(speed: gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start,
            run_mode: best_effort)
          intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_ego_drive_2: keep_speed(run_mode:best_effort)
          intent_assist_ego_distance_at_essence_ego_drive: distance(ego_distance_at_essence, run_mode: best_effort)
      with:
        intent_drive_ego_at_essence_duration:\
         duration(gen_ego_drive_duration_at_essence, tolerance: gen_ego_drive_duration_tolerance_at_essence)
      # The VRU starts moving from the start_position and reaches the first_position for the duration of 
      # 'vru_pre_cross_duration', and waits for the 'vru_group_trigger_movement_event'. The VRU
      # then crosses the road to move from the first_position to the second_position for
      # the duration of 'vru_cross_duration'. After crossing the road the VRU finishes
      # its path by travelling from the second_position to the end_position for the duration of 'vru_post_cross_duration'
      # 'vru_post_cross_duration',
      phase_essence_vru_move: serial():
        vru_start_move_at_essence_vru_move: vru_group.group_move(\
            vru_group_first_position_params,duration: vru_pre_cross_duration,\
              start_position_params: vru_group_start_position_params)
        emit vru_reached_cross_walk
        wait_vru_group_trigger_movement_event: wait @vru_group_trigger_movement_event
        vru_cross_move_at_essence_vru_move: serial():
          emit vru_cross_start
          vru_cross_move: vru_group.group_move(vru_group_sec_position_params,duration: vru_cross_duration)
          emit vru_cross_end
        vru_end_move_at_essence_vru_move: vru_group.group_move(\
            vru_group_end_position_params, duration: vru_post_cross_duration)

    with: 
      intent_vru_approaching_crosswalk_essence_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_essence, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)
      
    phase_essence_scenario_stopper: serial:
      post_drive_start_wait: wait @post_drive_start
      check_ego_passed_crosswalk_after_vru: wait ego_distance_to_crosswalk < ego_distance_to_crosswalk_for_stopping_scenario 
      log_info("Ending scenario since Ego passed the crosswalk after VRU crossed it")

scenario sut.vru_group_crossing_marked_crosswalk_with_random_vehicles \
  inherits vru_group_crossing_marked_crosswalk(random_vehicle_traffic_type == with_random_vehicle):

  # Setting parameters for ftx_driver

  # Setting the behavior model of each vehicle in random traffic

  for car in random_vehicle_group.cars:

  do phase_essence: first_of:
    # Phase - Ego drives through road with crosswalk, meanwhile

    phase_essence_vru_approaching_crosswalk: parallel(overlap: any, start_to_start: 0s):
        # The Ego drives at a speed of gen_ego_speed_at_start

        drive_ego_at_essence_2: sut.car.drive() with:
          intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_ego_drive: speed(speed: gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start,
            run_mode: best_effort)

      with:

         duration(gen_ego_drive_duration_at_essence, tolerance: gen_ego_drive_duration_tolerance_at_essence)
      drive_random_vehicle_group_at_essence: random_vehicle_group.group_drive()
        # The VRU starts driving from the start_position and reaches the first_position for the duration of 
        # 'vru_pre_cross_duration', and waits for the 'vru_group_trigger_movement_event'. The VRU
        # then crosses the road to move from the first_position to second_position for
        # the duration of 'vru_cross_duration', after crossing the road VRU finishes
        # its path by travelling from second_position to end_position for the duration
        # 'vru_post_cross_duration',
      phase_essence_vru_move: serial():
        vru_start_move_at_essence_vru_move: vru_group.group_move(\
            vru_group_first_position_params,duration: vru_pre_cross_duration,\
              start_position_params: vru_group_start_position_params)
        emit vru_reached_cross_walk
        wait_vru_group_trigger_movement_event: wait @vru_group_trigger_movement_event
        vru_cross_move_at_essence_vru_move: serial():
          emit vru_cross_start
          vru_cross_move: vru_group.group_move(vru_group_sec_position_params,duration: vru_cross_duration)
          emit vru_cross_end
        vru_end_move_at_essence_vru_move: vru_group.group_move(\
            vru_group_end_position_params, duration: vru_post_cross_duration)
    with: 
      intent_vru_approaching_crosswalk_essence_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_essence, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)

    phase_essence_scenario_stopper: serial:
      post_drive_start_wait: wait @post_drive_start
      check_ego_passed_crosswalk_after_vru: wait ego_distance_to_crosswalk < ego_distance_to_crosswalk_for_stopping_scenario 
      log_info("Ending scenario since Ego passed the crosswalk after VRU crossed it")

extend sut.ego_drive_with_vru_group_crossing_road:

    # Road where the ego will drive
    drive_road: one_way_road 
    # Events for coverage and KPI
    event vru_group_moves_end

    #  Defining start and end msp position's for the VRU
    vru_start_pos: msp_position
    vru_end_pos: msp_position

    vru_group_end_pos: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(default it.max_distance_between_objects==1m)
    vru_group_start_pos: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(default it.max_distance_between_objects==1m)

    # The number of vehicle in random_traffic_vehicle_group is assigned
    random_vehicle_group: common_route_car_group with(reference_car: sut.car):
        keep(it.cars.size() == gen_number_of_vehicles_in_random_traffic)
        #slight randomization of initial position of ego. note that if the reference_car_index will >1, there is a higher chance of 
        #vru to collide with the car group vehicles
        keep(it.reference_car_index in [0..1]) 
    random_vehicle_group_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model

    # Setting parameters for ftx_driver
    keep(random_vehicle_group_driver_model.change_lane_eagerness == 20)
    keep(random_vehicle_group_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(random_vehicle_group_driver_model.target_speed in [gen_ego_speed_at_start - 5mps..\
    gen_ego_speed_at_start + 5mps])

    # Setting the behavior model of each vehicle in random traffic
    # vehicle group as ftx_driver 
    for vehicle in random_vehicle_group.cars:
        keep(vehicle.initial_bm == random_vehicle_group_driver_model)

    # Reference int for constraining the VRU move direction
    move_ref: int

    # Constraining of 'move_ref'
    # Referencing 'move_ref' with respect to gen_vru_group_lat_offset_to_ego_at_start
    # to configure 'vru_end_pos'
    keep(gen_vru_group_lat_offset_to_ego_at_start<0m => move_ref==1)
    keep(gen_vru_group_lat_offset_to_ego_at_start>0m => move_ref==-1)
    keep(gen_vru_group_lat_offset_to_ego_at_start==0m => move_ref in [-1,1])

    # Angle parameter for VRU, which is calculated based on
    # 'gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road' and 'gen_vru_group_lat_offset_to_ego_at_start'
    vru_move_yaw: angle

    # Constraining of 'vru_move_yaw'
    # Configuring the 'vru_move_yaw' with respect to
    # 'gen_vru_group_lat_offset_to_ego_at_start' to configure angle at which VRU moves
    keep(gen_vru_group_lat_offset_to_ego_at_start<0m => vru_move_yaw== \
        gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road)
    keep(gen_vru_group_lat_offset_to_ego_at_start>0m => vru_move_yaw== \
        (180degree-gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road))
    keep(gen_vru_group_lat_offset_to_ego_at_start==0m => vru_move_yaw==90degree)

    # Positioning of the VRU's start position relative to ego drive using
    # 'position_along_drive'
    sp: top.position_along_drive(vru_start_pos,drive_ego_at_essence, \
        lon_offset: (gen_vru_group_lon_offset_to_ego_at_start+\
            sut.car.compound_object.get_length()/2)\
        ,lat_offset:gen_vru_group_lat_offset_to_ego_at_start+sut.car.\
            compound_object.get_width()/2)

    # Calculated 'vru_end_pos' based on 'vru_move_yaw' and
    # 'move_ref*gen_vru_group_move_dist'
    # 1) vru_move_yaw - This gives angle at which the msp_pos should be located
    # 2) move_ref*gen_vru_group_move_dist - This gives distance at which the 'vru_end_pos'
    # is located from 'vru_start_pos'. And 'move_ref' makes the msp pos to be
    # relative to ego drive (gen_vru_group_lat_offset_to_ego_at_start to be more precise)

    keep(vru_end_pos == vru_start_pos.at_rotated_offset( \
        offset:move_ref*gen_vru_group_move_dist , yaw: vru_move_yaw))

    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(vru_group_start_pos,
        vru_group, vru_start_pos)
    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(vru_group_end_pos,
        vru_group, vru_end_pos)

    # VRU group actual move time from start pos to end pos
    vru_group_actual_move_time: time
    keep(vru_group_actual_move_time*gen_vru_group_speed==gen_vru_group_move_dist)

    # VRU group move time to be a multiple of simulation step time
    vru_group_move_time: time with:
        # TODO: Replace step_time*step_count with top.step_size
        keep(it in [vru_group_actual_move_time..vru_group_actual_move_time+ \
            config.test.step_time - 1ms])

    # Distance parameter to configure scenario stopping condition
    # Multiplying the maximum distance between objects by the gen_number_of_vrus
    # to obtain the total length of the VRU group
    # Added 12m as a reference value since there was no defined value
    # in requirements
    scenario_end_dist: length
    keep(scenario_end_dist == -1*(sut.car.compound_object.get_length()/2 + \
        (vru_group_end_pos.max_distance_between_objects * gen_number_of_vrus)+ 12m))
    # Constraining the lon offset with respect to ego speed
    # For lower values of lon offset 'gen_vru_group_lon_offset_to_ego_at_start'
    # if the gen_ego_speed_at_start ig high, VRU would not cross the ego
    # trajectory.
    keep(gen_vru_group_lon_offset_to_ego_at_start<10m=>gen_ego_speed_at_start<20kph)

    # Event definition to define the sampling clock
    event clock is (sut.car.state != null \
        and vru_object_closest_to_ego.state != null)
    # Conditional clock to end scenario once ego passes VRU
    event scenario_ends is @clock if sut.car.road_distance_to_global_coordinates(\
        vru_object_closest_to_ego.state.global_position.coord, center, lon, lane) < scenario_end_dist
    
    # Sample longitudinal distance (in seconds) between SUT and person
    var time_to_meet: time = sample(
        (sut.car.state == null or sut.car.state.speed == 0kph) ? 10000s :
            (sut.car.distance_to_point_along_path(
                vru_start_pos.lane_position) / sut.car.state.speed),
        @top.clk)
    set time_to_meet = 10000s
    event move_trigger_event is @top.clk if (time_to_meet < gen_trigger_time)

    # Drive should not start in junction
    initial_road: one_way_road

    # First_of - Once 'scenario_ends' event is true, scenario stops
    # otherwise the simulation continues to run
    # Main scenario - Parallel with config 'start_to_start = 0s'
    # All the three phases start at same time but might not end
    # at the same time.    
    do phase_essence: first_of: 

        phase_essence_ego_drive_with_vru_group_crossing_road: parallel(overlap: any, start_to_start:0s):
            drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_start: along(drive_road, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_start:\
                    speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at:start,run_mode: best_effort)
                #Make sure that ego drives and reach the vru group
                intent_assist_ego_distance_at_essence: \
                    distance([gen_vru_group_lon_offset_to_ego_at_start..],run_mode:best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_random_vehicle_group_at_essence: random_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            vru_group_move_at_essence: serial:
                vru_group_exists_at_essence: vru_group.group_exists(vru_group_start_pos) with:
                    group_rotation(max_yaw: vru_move_yaw)
                wait_move_trigger_event: wait @move_trigger_event
                vru_group_end_position_at_essence: vru_group.group_move(vru_group_end_pos, \
                    duration:vru_group_move_time, \
                    start_position_params: vru_group_start_pos)
                emit vru_group_moves_end
        with:
            intent_essence_duration:\
                duration(gen_duration_at_essence, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)  

        # Scenario stopping condition
        phase_essence_scenario_stopper: serial:
            wait @scenario_ends
            log_info("Ending scenario since Ego drive passed VRU")

    trace(ego_dist_to_closest_vru, expression:math.abs(sut.car.\
        road_distance_to_global_coordinates(vru_object_closest_to_ego.state.\
            global_position.coord, center, lon, lane)),
            unit_string: ftlx_lib_base_config.default_distance_unit)
    
    def modify_collision_error_to_warning(issue: issue_struct) is:

extend sut.crossing_person:
    # Duration (in seconds) between SUT and person (based on SUT speed and longitudinal distance) 
    # When person starts crossing
    trigger_time: time
    lon_offset: length with:
        keep(default it == 0m)
    gen_move_person_duration: time with:
        keep(default it in [2..10]s)
    gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_start: length
    gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_end: length
    keep(gen_person_side_at_start == nearside =>
            (gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_start in [-5..-1.5]meter
                and gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_end in [1.5..5]meter))
    keep(gen_person_side_at_start == farside => 
            (gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_start in [1.5..5]meter
                and gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_end in [-5..-1.5]meter))
    keep(default trigger_time in [2..5]second)
    keep(gen_drive_path_fraction in [0..100])
    keep(gen_person_side_at_start == nearside => gen_person_initial_yaw == 90degree)
    keep(gen_person_side_at_start == farside => gen_person_initial_yaw == 270degree)
    
    # Total move distance of the person
    move_distance: length with:
        keep(gen_person_side_at_start == nearside => 
                (it == (-gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_start) + gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_end))
        keep(gen_person_side_at_start == farside => 
                (it == (-gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_end) + gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_start))
                
    # Compute the person speed to get a realistic movement
    person_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in [1..10]kph)
        keep(it == move_distance / gen_move_person_duration)
        
    # Distance between person initial placement and reference vehicle's trajectory.
    distance_to_trajectory: length with:
        keep(gen_person_side_at_start == nearside => it == -gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_start)
        keep(gen_person_side_at_start == farside => it == gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_start)
        
    # Used for synchronizing when the person reaches
    # the vehicle trajectory when it is planned to reach the person
    keep(distance_to_trajectory / person_speed 
        in [trigger_time-0.5s..trigger_time+0.5s])

    # If Ego is slower than standstill_threshold for longer than time_delay,
    # The scenario will end.
    time_delay: time with:
        keep(default it == 10s)
    
    standstill_threshold: speed with:
        keep(default it == 0.25mps)

    # The Event checks the following:
    # 1. Ego's speed is less than standstill_threshold
    # 2. Ego's previous state was not null and also prev state speed 
    # was greater than standstill_threshold to ensure that timer should reset if Ego 
    # speed goes above standstill_threshold after slowing.
    event ego_stopped_event is @top.clk if (sut.car.state.speed < standstill_threshold \
        and sut.car.prev_state != null 
        and sut.car.prev_state.speed > standstill_threshold)
    var ego_stopped_time: time = sample(top.time, @ego_stopped_event)
    var ego_stopped_bool: bool = sample(true, @ego_stopped_event)
    set ego_stopped_bool = false

    # Ego stopped event
    # Checks if Ego is slower than standstill_threshold for a delay of 'time_delay'
    event ego_standing_still is @top.clk if (ego_stopped_bool == true and top.time \
        > (ego_stopped_time + time_delay))

    # Event to reset the timer once Ego speeds up after slowing down
    event ego_stops_and_moves is @top.clk if (sut.car.state.speed > standstill_threshold \
        and sut.car.prev_state != null 
        and sut.car.prev_state.speed < standstill_threshold)
    
    on @ego_stops_and_moves:
        set ego_stopped_time = 0s
        set ego_stopped_bool = false

    # Sample longitudinal distance (in seconds) between SUT and person
    var time_to_meet: time = sample(
        (sut.car.state == null or sut.car.state.speed == 0kph) ? 10000s :
            (sut.car.distance_to_point_along_path(
                start_position.lane_position) / sut.car.state.speed),
        @top.clk)
    set time_to_meet = 10000s
    
    event move_trigger_event is @top.clk if (time_to_meet < trigger_time or ego_standing_still.event_occurred() == true)
    
    position_along_drive(start_position, ref_drive, path_fraction: gen_drive_path_fraction, 
        lat_offset: gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_start, lon_offset: lon_offset)
    position_along_drive(end_position, ref_drive, path_fraction: gen_drive_path_fraction, 
        lat_offset: gen_ego_lat_offset_to_person_at_end, lon_offset: lon_offset)

    do phase_essence: serial():
        move_trigger: wait @move_trigger_event
        person_move_at_essence: person.move(end_position, duration: gen_move_person_duration, 
            start_position: start_position)

extend sut.vehicle_cut_out:
    # For separating coverage when invoked as sub-scenario
    has_stationary_object: bool with: 
        keep(default it == false)

    # Connect @phase_essence.start implementaton to the base event phase_essence_start_event
    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event 
    # Connect @phase_essence.end implementaton to the base event phase_essence_end_event
    on @phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event 

    # Start the essence phase
    do phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):

        # EGO is expected to drive on the same lane with a constant speed
        drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive() with:
            intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_essence_start, run_mode: best_effort)

        # cut-out vehicle performs cut-out
        drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_essence: cut_out_vehicle.drive() with:

            # at: start cut-out vehicle must get to the initial lane() and position()
            # it tries to get to the targeted relative speed and lateral position
            intent_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_start:\
                lane(same_as: sut.car, at: start)
            intent_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start:\
                position(time: gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start, time_tolerance: gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start_tolerance, ahead_of: sut.car, measure_by: nearest, at: start)
            intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start:\
                speed(gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start, faster_than: sut.car, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
            control_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_start:\
                lateral(gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_start, line: center, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

            # at: end cut-out vehicle must get to the final lane() and position()
            # it tries to get to the targeted relative speed and lateral position
            intent_cut_out_vehicle_lane_side_of_ego_at_essence_end:\
                lane(side_of: sut.car, side: gen_cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end, at: end)
            intent_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end:\
                position(time: gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end, time_tolerance: gen_cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end_tolerance, ahead_of: sut.car, measure_by: nearest, track: projected, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end:\
                speed(gen_cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end, faster_than: sut.car ,at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
            control_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end:\
                lateral(gen_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end, line: center, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)

     # intent duration modifier to ensure minimal time for a cut-out, with a large tolerance
    with: intent_essence_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_essence_generic, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)

        cut_out_vehicle_is_not_ahead_of_ego_cut_out_maneuver_starts, ego_change_lane,
        cut_out_vehicle_did_not_maintain_lane_after_aborted_cut_out, no_lane_change]
        
extend sut.vehicle_cut_out_family_base:

    #Events and booleans

    var lane_change_started: bool = sample(true, @cut_out_vehicle.switch_lane_start)
    var lane_change_ended: bool = sample(true, @cut_out_vehicle.switch_lane_end)

    var phase_essence_started : bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_start_event)
    set phase_essence_started = false
    var phase_essence_ended : bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_end_event)
    set phase_essence_ended = false
    
    # The event is triggered when cut out vehicle starts to change lane
    # and end when cut out vehicle reaches target lane.
    event lane_change_event_start is @cut_out_vehicle.switch_lane_start
    event lane_change_event_end is @cut_out_vehicle.switch_lane_end
    event lane_change_active is lane_change_started and not lane_change_ended
    event sample_clk is cut_out_vehicle.state != null
    
    event phase_essence_active is (phase_essence_started and \
    not phase_essence_ended)

    var lane_changed: bool = false
    event lane_change_active_occurred is @lane_change_event_end if (lane_changed == true)

    event check_for_near_collision is @top.clk if \
        sut.car.get_min_ttc_info_to_objects(traffic.physical_objects) != null

    # Event - cut_out_vehicle geometric center passes the center of the first
    # lane marking
    event cut_out_vehicle_passes_lane_marking  is @sample_clk if \
        (0.5 * map.get_lane_width(cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lane,
        cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lon_offset) - \
        math.abs(cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset) \
        < 0.1meter) and cut_out_vehicle_passes_lane_marking_sampled == false

    # Metrics

    var ego_lon_distance_to_cut_out_vehicle_before_lane_change: length = sample(
        sut.car.road_distance(cut_out_vehicle,front_center,back_center,lon,road),
            @phase_essence_start_event)

    var ego_lat_distance_to_cut_out_vehicle_before_lane_change: length = sample(
        sut.car.road_distance(cut_out_vehicle,center,center,lat,lane),
            @phase_essence_start_event)

    var cut_out_vehicle_passes_lane_marking_sampled: bool = sample(true,
        @cut_out_vehicle_passes_lane_marking)
    set cut_out_vehicle_passes_lane_marking_sampled = false


    var phase_essence_start_time: time
    var phase_essence_end_time: time
    var cut_out_vehicle_thw_to_ego_at_essence_start: time
    var cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_end: speed
    var cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start: speed
    var cut_out_vehicle_distance_to_ego_at_essence_start: length
    var cut_out_vehicle_distance_to_ego_at_essence_end: length
    var cut_out_vehicle_lat_dist_to_lane_marking_at_essence_end: length
    var cut_out_vehicle_width: length
    var lane_width_at_vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_end : length
    var ego_changed_lane: bool
    var cut_out_vehicle_changed_lane: bool

    cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence_statistics: statistics(sample_type: acceleration, measurement: average)
    var cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence: acceleration


    cut_out_vehicle_average_lateral_speed_record: statistics(sample_type: speed, measurement: average)
    var cut_out_vehicle_average_lateral_speed_at_lane_change: speed

    on @start:
        cut_out_vehicle_category = cut_out_vehicle.vehicle_category
        cut_out_vehicle_color = cut_out_vehicle.color

    on @top.clk:
        if sut.car.lane_shifts != 0:
            ego_changed_lane = true

        if cut_out_vehicle.lane_shifts != 0:
            cut_out_vehicle_changed_lane = true

    on @lane_change_active:
        lane_changed = true
        cut_out_vehicle_average_lateral_speed_record.add_sample(cut_out_vehicle.state.local_speed.lat)

    on @phase_essence_start_event:
        cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start = cut_out_vehicle.state.speed
        cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start = math.abs(sut.car.state.speed - cut_out_vehicle.state.speed)
        cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_start = cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset
        cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start = cut_out_vehicle.get_time_gap(sut.car)
        cut_out_vehicle_distance_to_ego_at_essence_start = cut_out_vehicle.road_distance(sut.car,closest_compound,closest_compound,lon,lane)
        phase_essence_start_time = top.time
        cut_out_vehicle_thw_to_ego_at_essence_start = sut.car.get_time_headway(cut_out_vehicle)

    on @phase_essence_active:
        cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence_statistics.add_sample(cut_out_vehicle.state.local_acceleration.lon)

    on @phase_essence_end_event:
        cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end = cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset
        cut_out_vehicle_average_lateral_speed_at_lane_change = cut_out_vehicle_average_lateral_speed_record.compute()
        phase_essence_end_time = top.time
        duration_at_essence = phase_essence_end_time - phase_essence_start_time
        cut_out_vehicle_speed_at_essence_end = cut_out_vehicle.state.speed
        cut_out_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end = math.abs(sut.car.state.speed - cut_out_vehicle.state.speed)
        cut_out_vehicle_side_at_essence_end= map.center_side()
        cut_out_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end = cut_out_vehicle.get_time_gap(sut.car)
        cut_out_vehicle_distance_to_ego_at_essence_end = cut_out_vehicle.road_distance(sut.car,closest_compound,closest_compound,lon,lane)
        cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence = cut_out_vehicle_mean_acceleration_at_essence_statistics.compute()
        cut_out_vehicle_width = cut_out_vehicle.bbox.width
        lane_width_at_vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_end = map.get_lane_width(cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lane, cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lon_offset)
        cut_out_vehicle_lat_dist_to_lane_marking_at_essence_end = math.abs(cut_out_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end) + 0.5*(cut_out_vehicle_width-lane_width_at_vehicle_cut_out_at_essence_end)

    #Checks

    # The check will trigger when the relative lon distance is < 0m which
    # means the cut_out_vehicle is behind the Ego before the lane change
    # The relative lat distance should be > 3m (absolute)
    # The check will nullify if Ego changed lane before cut out
    ego_to_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_threshold: length
    keep(default ego_to_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_threshold == 3m)

    var inf := 9223372036.854775807m

    on @phase_essence_start_event if \
        math.abs(ego_lat_distance_to_cut_out_vehicle_before_lane_change) > \
            ego_to_cut_out_vehicle_lateral_threshold and \
            ego_lat_distance_to_cut_out_vehicle_before_lane_change < inf and \
            sut.car.switch_lane_start.event_occurred() == false:
        call other_error(\
            cut_out_vehicle_is_not_in_same_lane_before_cut_out_maneuver_starts,
                "The cut_out_vehicle was not in the same lane as the Ego" +\
                " before the cut-out maneuver started")

    on @phase_essence_start_event if \
        ego_lon_distance_to_cut_out_vehicle_before_lane_change < 0m and\
            ego_lon_distance_to_cut_out_vehicle_before_lane_change < inf and \
            sut.car.switch_lane_start.event_occurred() == false:
        call other_error(\
            cut_out_vehicle_is_not_ahead_of_ego_cut_out_maneuver_starts,
                "The cut_out_vehicle was not ahead of the Ego" +\
                " before the cut-out maneuver starts")



    # The event will ensure that the cut_out_vehicle has atleast done a
    # lane change
    event post_lane_change_cut_out_vehicle_phase is @top.clk if \
        cut_out_vehicle.behavior_watcher.lane_change_watcher_call.number_of_lane_changes_completed!=0 and \
        cut_out_vehicle.state != null

    event post_lane_change_ego_phase is @top.clk if \
        sut.car.behavior_watcher.lane_change_watcher_call.number_of_lane_changes_completed!=0 and \
        sut.car.state != null

    # The check will trigger when after cut out the lane is
    # not maintained
    # The number of lane changes prior to the cut out maneuver is captured for making sure that only the
    # target cut out manuever itself is checked
    var number_of_lane_changes_at_essence_start_event:int
    on @phase_essence_start_event:
        number_of_lane_changes_at_essence_start_event = cut_out_vehicle.behavior_watcher.lane_change_watcher_call.number_of_lane_changes_completed

    # on @post_lane_change_cut_out_vehicle_phase:
    #     var number_of_cut_outs:int =  cut_out_vehicle.behavior_watcher.lane_change_watcher_call.number_of_lane_changes_completed  \
    #     - number_of_lane_changes_at_essence_start_event

    #     if number_of_cut_outs > 1 and (cut_out_scenario_type != aborted_cut_out) and (cut_out_scenario_type != reconsidered_cut_out):
    #         call other_error(cut_out_vehicle_did_not_maintain_lane_after_cut_out,
    #             "Cut out vehicle did not maintain lane after the cut-out")

    on @post_lane_change_ego_phase:
        call other_warning(ego_change_lane,
            "The Ego changed lane")

    # A variable to determine if 'no_lane_change' check is required
    check_for_lane_change: bool with:
        keep(default it == true)

    # on @phase_essence_end_event if not cut_out_vehicle_changed_lane and check_for_lane_change:
    #     call other_error(no_lane_change,"Cut out vehicle did not perform lane change")

    const lat_distance_difference: float = 1.0

    event post_essence_event is @top.clk if phase_essence_ended

    event post_essence_lane_change is @top.clk if(phase_essence_ended and ((cut_out_vehicle_lat_distance_to_ego_at_post_phase < \
            (lat_distance_difference)) or \
               (cut_out_vehicle_lat_distance_to_ego_at_post_phase > \
                (-1 * (lat_distance_difference)))))

    var check_are_vehicles_in_same_lane_bool: bool = sample(\
        check_are_vehicles_in_same_lane(sut.car,cut_out_vehicle),
        @top.clk)

    var cut_out_vehicle_lat_distance_to_ego_at_post_phase: float = sample(
        map.get_lateral_distance_along_route(cut_out_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position, 
            sut.car.state.msp_pos.lane_position, cut_out_vehicle.planned_path), 
                @post_essence_event if sut.car.state!= null and\
                cut_out_vehicle.state!=null)

    on @top.clk if post_essence_lane_change.event_occurred() and (cut_out_scenario_type == aborted_cut_out) and\
        sut.car.behavior_watcher.lane_change_watcher_call.number_of_lane_changes_completed == 0 and \
               check_are_vehicles_in_same_lane_bool == false:
        call other_error(cut_out_vehicle_did_not_maintain_lane_after_aborted_cut_out,
            "Cut out vehicle did not maintain lane after aborting the cut out")

    # The get_relative_time_gap is native method defined to calculate the
    # distance in time between two vehicles. The distance between two
    # vehicle is calculated and divided by the speed of behind_vehicle
    # Here it is mandatory to follow the order of inputs. For example:
    # Inputs:
    # behind_vehicle -> First input
    # ahead_vehicle -> Second input
    def get_relative_time_gap(behind_vehicle: vehicle, ahead_vehicle: vehicle)-> time is:
        var relative_time_gap : time = 0s
        var distance_between_vehicles : length
        if behind_vehicle.state != null and behind_vehicle.state.speed != 0kph and \
            ahead_vehicle.state != null and ahead_vehicle.state.speed != 0kph:
            distance_between_vehicles = top.map.distance_from_ref_position(\
            behind_vehicle.state.msp_pos.road_position,ahead_vehicle.state.msp_pos.road_position)\
            -(behind_vehicle.get_length()/2) + (ahead_vehicle.get_length()/2)
            relative_time_gap = distance_between_vehicles/behind_vehicle.state.speed

        return relative_time_gap

# Define Ego warm up scenario for the cut out family
# During this phase Ego and the cut_out_vehicle are expected to be on the same lane
# This scenario can be used by each scenario family member as part of the <>_main scenario
extend sut.vehicle_cut_out_family_base_ego_warm_up:

    do phase_ego_warm_up: parallel(overlap: equal):

            drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_ego_warm_up: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)

            drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: cut_out_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_lane_at_ego_warm_up: lane(same_as: sut.car, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_keep_lane_at_ego_warm_up: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)

    # duration intent modifier to ensure minimum time is achieved with high tolerance
    with: intent_ego_warm_up_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_ego_warm_up, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_ego_warm_up)

# Define post scenario for the cut out family
# During this phase Ego and the cut_out_vehicle are expected to be on the same lane
# This scenario can be used by each scenario family member as part of the <>_main scenario
extend sut.vehicle_cut_out_family_base_post:

    do phase_post: parallel(overlap: equal):

            drive_ego_at_post: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)

            drive_cut_out_vehicle_at_post: cut_out_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_cut_out_vehicle_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)

    # duration intent modifier to ensure minimum time is achieved with high tolerance
    with: intent_post_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_post, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_post)

extend sut.ego_traverse_roundabout:
    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event 
    on @phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event 

    gen_ego_entry_internal_road: internal_road with:
        keep(it.id == gen_ego_entry.internal_road_id)
    gen_ego_road_to_entry: one_way_road with:
        keep(it.id == gen_ego_entry_internal_road.in_one_way_road_id)

    gen_ego_exit_internal_road: internal_road with:
        keep(it.id == gen_ego_exit.internal_road_id)
    gen_ego_road_from_exit: one_way_road with:
        keep(it.id == gen_ego_exit_internal_road.out_one_way_road_id)

    top.roundabout_entry_exit_direction(gen_ego_entry, gen_ego_exit, gen_ego_traversal_direction)

    do phase_essence: serial:
        emit phase_essence_start_event

        phase_essence_enter: serial:
            drive_ego_at_essence_enter: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_ego_along_at_essence_enter_end: along( 
                    gen_ego_entry,
                    at: end,
                    end_offset: 0m,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_enter_start: along( 
                    gen_ego_road_to_entry,
                    at: start,
                    end_offset: gen_ego_offset_from_entry_at_essence_enter_start,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_enter_start: speed(
                    gen_ego_speed_at_start,
                    at: start,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_enter: keep_speed(
                    run_mode: best_effort)
        with: 
            intent_essence_enter_duration: duration(
                gen_essence_enter_duration,
                tolerance : gen_duration_tolerance)

        phase_essence_exit: serial:
            drive_ego_at_essence_exit: sut.car.drive() with:
                # intent_ego_along_at_essence_exit_end: along( 
                #     gen_ego_road_from_exit,
                #     at: end,
                #     start_offset: gen_ego_offset_from_exit_at_essence_exit_end,
                #     run_mode: best_effort)  
                intent_ego_along_at_essence_exit_end: along( 
                    gen_ego_road_from_exit,
                    at: end,
                    start_offset: gen_ego_offset_from_exit_at_essence_exit_end,
                    tolerance: 2m)  ## Frank: remove best_effort
                intent_ego_speed_at_essence_exit: keep_speed( 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
        with: 
            intent_essence_exit_duration: duration(
                gen_essence_exit_duration,
                tolerance : gen_duration_tolerance)

        emit phase_essence_end_event

extend sut.ego_traverse_roundabout_with_crossing_vru:
    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event 
    on @phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event 

    # Configuring parameters for the crossing VRU group scenario
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_size_group == gen_vru_group_size)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_group_side_at_start == gen_vru_group_1_side_at_start)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_trigger_time == gen_trigger_time)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start == vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end == vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.vru_group_end_position_params.min_lat_offset == 0m)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.vru_group_end_position_params.max_lat_offset == 0m)

    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_size_group == gen_vru_group_size)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_group_side_at_start == gen_vru_group_2_side_at_start)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_trigger_time == gen_trigger_time)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start == vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end == vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.vru_group_end_position_params.min_lat_offset == 0m)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.vru_group_end_position_params.max_lat_offset == 0m)

    # Relative VRU move angle to road at the start
    vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start: angle with:
        keep(default it in [90..150]degree)

    # Relative VRU move angle to road at the end
    vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end: angle with:
        keep(default it in [30..90]degree)
    
    # VRU group move duration
    vru_group_move_duration: time 
    keep(default vru_group_move_duration in [3..5]s)

    # Trigger event for move of VRU group to start
    event move_trigger_event_1 is (sut.car.state.speed > 1kph)
    event move_trigger_event_2 is @ego_traverse_roundabout_at_essence.\
        ego_at_exit_start if sut.car.state.speed > 1kph

    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_group_lon_offset_to_ego_start_at_crossing in \
        [gen_ego_offset_from_entry_at_essence_enter_start - 2m \
        ..gen_ego_offset_from_entry_at_essence_enter_start + 2m])

    # Longitudinal distance of vru_group_2 to ego
    vru_group_2_lon_offset_to_ego_at_start: length with:
        keep(default it in \
        [gen_ego_offset_from_exit_at_essence_exit_end - 2m \
        ..gen_ego_offset_from_exit_at_essence_exit_end + 2m])

    position_along_drive(crossing_vru_group_2.pos_start_ref_drive, crossing_vru_group_2.ref_drive, path_fraction: 100, lon_offset: -vru_group_2_lon_offset_to_ego_at_start, 
        lat_offset: crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_group_lat_offset_to_ego_path_at_crossing, force_on_road: true)

    # Enable collision avoidance for Ego
    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.enabling_policy == \
        always_enabled)

    intent_assist_vehicle_distance_at_essence_approach: in ego_traverse_roundabout_at_essence.drive_ego_at_essence_enter with:
        distance([outer.crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_group_lon_offset_to_ego_start_at_crossing..], run_mode: best_effort)

    intent_assist_vehicle_distance_at_essence_exit: in ego_traverse_roundabout_at_essence.drive_ego_at_essence_exit with:
        distance([outer.vru_group_2_lon_offset_to_ego_at_start..], run_mode: best_effort)

    do first_of:
        phase_essence: serial:
            phase_essence_ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru: parallel(overlap: start):
                ego_traverse_roundabout_at_essence: ego_traverse_roundabout(
                    gen_ego_entry: gen_ego_entry,
                    gen_ego_exit: gen_ego_exit,
                    gen_ego_traversal_direction: gen_ego_traversal_direction,
                    gen_ego_speed_at_start: gen_ego_speed_at_start,
                    gen_ego_offset_from_entry_at_essence_enter_start: gen_ego_offset_from_entry_at_essence_enter_start,
                    gen_ego_offset_from_exit_at_essence_exit_end: gen_ego_offset_from_exit_at_essence_exit_end,
                    gen_essence_enter_duration: gen_essence_enter_duration,
                    gen_essence_exit_duration: gen_essence_exit_duration)

                crossing_vru_group_1_at_essence: serial:
                    wait @move_trigger_event_1
                    crossing_vru_group_1: top.crossing_vru_group(ref_drive: \
                        ego_traverse_roundabout_at_essence.\
                        drive_ego_at_essence_enter)

                crossing_vru_group_2_at_essence: serial:
                    wait @move_trigger_event_2
                    crossing_vru_group_2: top.crossing_vru_group(ref_drive: \
                        ego_traverse_roundabout_at_essence.\
                        drive_ego_at_essence_exit)

        phase_essence_scenario_stopper: serial:
            wait @ego_traverse_roundabout_with_crossing_vru_scenario_stopper

# This file implements vehicle_cut_in and vehicle_cut_in_test scenarios
# vehicle_cut_in one phase, called essence. Maneuver modifiers are called at:start and at:end
# The scenario generated parameters are used as the parameters to the maneuver modifiers
# It uses intent lane() and position() modifiers at:start and at:end, to define the required position
# It uses intent_assist speed() modifiers at:start and at:end, to define the relative speed
# It uses control lateral() modifier  at:start and at:end, to define the lateral position
# The phase uses the intent duration() modifier
# vehicle_cut_in_test invokesegowarm up, vehicle_cut_in and the post phases
# End user can choose between invoking vehicle_cut_in independantly
#     or with vehicle_cut_in_test that includesegowarm up and post

extend sut.vehicle_cut_in:

    # Connect @phase_essence.start implementaton to the base event phase_essence_start_event
    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event 
    # Connect @phase_essence.end implementaton to the base event phase_essence_end_event
    on @phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event 

    # Start the essence phase
    do phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):

        # EGO is expected to drive on the same lane with a constant speed
        drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive() with:
            intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_essence_start, run_mode: best_effort)

        # cut-in vehicle performs cut-in
        drive_cut_in_vehicle_at_essence: cut_in_vehicle.drive() with:
            # at: start cut-in vehicle must get to the initial lane() and position()
            # it tries to get to the targeted relative speed and lateral position
            control_cut_in_vehicle_avoid_collisions: avoid_collisions(gen_cut_in_vehicle_avoid_collisions)
            intent_cut_in_vehicle_side_at_essence_start:\
                lane(side_of: sut.car, side: gen_cut_in_vehicle_side_at_essence_start, at: start)
            intent_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_essence_start:\
                position(time: gen_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start, time_tolerance: gen_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start_tolerance, ahead_of: sut.car, measure_by: nearest, at: start)
            intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start:\
                speed(gen_cut_in_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_start, faster_than: sut.car, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start: \
                speed(gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start, at: start, tolerance: 10kph, run_mode: best_effort)
            control_cut_in_vehicle_lateral_distance_at_essence_start:\
                lateral(gen_cut_in_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_start, line: center, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

            # at: end cut-in vehicle must get to the final lane() and position()
            # it tries to get to the targeted relative speed and lateral position
            intent_cut_in_vehicle_lane_same_as_ego_at_essence_end:\
                lane(same_as: sut.car, at: end)
            intent_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_essence_end:\
                position(time: gen_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end, time_tolerance: gen_cut_in_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_end_tolerance, ahead_of: sut.car, measure_by: nearest, at: end)
            intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end:\
                speed(gen_cut_in_vehicle_rel_speed_at_essence_end, faster_than: sut.car ,at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_assist_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_essence_end: \
                speed(gen_cut_in_vehicle_speed_at_essence_end, at: end, tolerance: 10kph, run_mode: best_effort)
            control_cut_in_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end:\
                lateral(gen_cut_in_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end, line: center, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)

    with: intent_scenario_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_essence_generic, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence_generic)

# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

extend sut.ego_merge:

    # Offset used in scenario
    distance_offset: length
    keep(default distance_offset == 20m)

    var phase_essence_started := sample(true, @phase_essence.start)
    
    # SDM-required events for phase_essence
    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event
    on @phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event

    do ego_merge: first_of:
        main_scenario: serial():
            # In this phase, the Ego is coming from the highway entry
            phase_ego_warmup: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_warmup: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_speed_at_warmup: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_travel_distance_at_warmup: distance([(gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                    - distance_offset)..(gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                    + distance_offset)], run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_warmup: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_along_at_warmup: along(road_to_force_merge_location, at: end, 
                        start_offset: [10..20]m,run_mode:best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_warmup: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                
            with:
                # The duration is calculated by,
                # [(min_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ 
                # max_ego_speed_at_start)..\
                # 2 * (max_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ 
                # max_ego_speed_at_start)]
                # This will ensure that the Ego travels the distance and reaches
                # the start_offset of the road_to_force_merge_location
                intent_warmup_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_warmup,run_mode: best_effort)


            phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_along_at_essence: along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end, run_mode:best_effort)
                    # This is a workaround to ensure that the lane change happens
                    # This will ensure that the NolaneChange soft constraint 
                    # is overridden
                    intent_ego_change_lane_at_essence: change_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                
            # In this phase the both vehicles maintain speed and lane
            phase_post: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_post: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_post: along(road_to_force_merge_path.successor_lane, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
            with: intent_post_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_post,run_mode: best_effort)
        
        serial:
            wait @ego_stopped
            log_info("$(self): ending scenario after Ego stopped for"+\
                "$(ego_complete_stand_still_time).")
        serial:
            wait @ego_merge_end_condition
            log_info("$(self): The Ego merged successfully into target lane "+\
                "and passed 10s.")

    on @ego_stopped:
        call other_warning(ego_stopped_warning, 
            "Ego stopped and was not able to merge into target lane.")
    
    # To ensure the scenario runs long enough, the Ego is expected 
    # to move to the successor lane of road_to_force_merge using the along modifier. 
    # Once the merge is completed, the along modifier is 
    # changed to best_effort, as the intent has been achieved
    on @sut.car.switch_lane_end:
        override(intent_assist_ego_along_at_post,
            run_mode:best_effort)
        call logger.log_info("The Ego performed a lane change, "+\
            "triggering the switch_lane_end event")

extend sut.lead_vehicle_changing_speed:

    keep(default sut.car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.enabling_policy == always_enabled)


    do lead_vehicle_changing_speed: serial():
        emit phase_warmup_start_event
        phase_warmup: parallel(overlap:equal):
            drive_ego_at_warmup: sut.car.drive() with:
                # per B.1
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_warmup: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_along_one_way_road_at_warmup_start: along(road, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_along_one_way_road_start_offset_at_warmup_start: \
                    along(lane_section, end_offset: [100..]m, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                # per B.2
                intent_assist_ego_disable_avoid_collisions_at_warmup: avoid_collisions(false)
                # per C.1
                control_ego_speed_at_warmup_start: speed(speed: gen_ego_speed_at_warmup_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                # per C.2
                control_ego_lateral_offset_at_warmup_start: \
                    lateral(distance: gen_ego_lat_offset_at_warmup_start, line: center, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

            drive_lead_vehicle_at_warmup: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                # per B.3
                intent_lead_vehicle_lane_same_as_ego_at_warmup_start: lane(same_as: sut.car, at:start, run_mode: best_effort) 
                           
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_warmup: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort) 
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_along_one_way_road:along(road, run_mode: best_effort)
                # per C.5
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_time_gap_at_warmup_start: position(time: gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_warmup_start, 
                    ahead_of: sut.car, measure_by: nearest, at: start, run_mode:best_effort)

                # per C.3
                control_lead_vehicle_speed_at_warmup: speed(gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_warmup, run_mode: best_effort) 
                # per C.4
                control_lead_vehicle_lateral_offset_at_warmup_start: lateral(distance: gen_lead_vehicle_lat_offset_at_warmup_start, line: center, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
        with: 
            initial_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_warmup, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_warmup)
        emit phase_warmup_end_event

        emit phase_essence_start_event
        phase_essence: parallel(overlap:equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive() with:
                # per A.4
                intent_assist_ego_disable_avoid_collisions_at_essence: avoid_collisions(false)
                # per B.1
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                # per B.2
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)

            drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                # per A.1
                intent_lead_vehicle_lane_same_as_ego_at_essence_start: lane(same_as: sut.car, at:start)  
                # per A.2
                intent_lead_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_start: position(time: gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_essence_start, 
                    ahead_of: sut.car, measure_by: nearest, at: start, time_tolerance: lead_vehicle_position_tolerance)
                # per A.1
                intent_lead_vehicle_change_speed_at_essence: change_speed(gen_lead_vehicle_speed_change, tolerance: lead_vehicle_speed_tolerance)

                # per B.3
                # intent_assist_essence_lead_vehicle_lane_at_end: lane(same_as: sut.car, at:end, run_mode: best_effort)
                # per B.3
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)  

                # per C.4
                control_lead_vehicle_lateral_offset_at_essence_start: lateral(distance: gen_lead_vehicle_lat_offset_at_essence_start, line: center, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
        
        # per B.5
        with: duration(gen_duration_at_essence_generic, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence_generic)
        emit phase_essence_end_event

        emit phase_post_start_event_generic
        phase_post: parallel(overlap:equal):
            drive_ego_at_post: sut.car.drive() with:
                # per B.1
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                # per B.2
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                # per B.2
                intent_assist_ego_disable_avoid_collisions_at_post: avoid_collisions(false)

            drive_lead_vehicle_at_post: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                # per B.3
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_lane_same_as_ego_at_post: lane(same_as: sut.car, run_mode: best_effort)
                # per B.3
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)    
                # per B.4
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)

                # per C.4
                control_lead_vehicle_lateral_offset_at_post: lateral(distance: gen_lead_vehicle_lat_offset_at_post_start, \
                    line: center, run_mode: best_effort)
        with: 
            duration(gen_duration_at_post, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_post)
        emit phase_post_end_event_generic
